jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings.
jobs.companyName: Accelerated Digital Media - an OuterBox company
jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.

Job Responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Set the Product Vision: Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
  • Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
  • Build Products for Our Delivery Teams: Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
  • Lead Direct-to-Market Products: Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
  • Lead the Product Management Team: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
  • Turn Development Talent into Great Products: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
  • Drive Effective Execution: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
  • Measure & Report Product Effectiveness: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
  • Evaluate Emerging Technology: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
  • Additional duties, as assigned.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
  • A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
  • Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
  • Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.
  • Working knowledge of how digital marketing agencies deliver services
  • Fluency in product process, including PRDs and acceptance criteria, prioritization, and pilot and rollout programs, with credible participation in architecture and build decisions alongside technology leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent).
  • Strong product design and user-experience judgment, grounded in user research, feedback programs, and adoption measurement (interviews, NPS, surveys).
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, AI-accelerated environment, with working familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) and cloud-native platforms (Google Cloud Platform).

Benefits

Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.

Boxer Benefits

Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.

  • Health Insurance
  • 401(k) & Retirement Savings
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Scheduling
  • Remote-First Culture
  • Professional Development
  • Employee Referral Program
  • And more!

Salary Description: $140,000 - $160,000

Our Company Values

Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.

At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.

Growth At OuterBox

We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.

Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.

﻿Physical Demands

  • Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.
  • Requires a high level of mental focus and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Good manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and the ability to use a computer for extended periods are required.

Utilizes required organization-provided tools, such as project management systems, artificial intelligence (AI) applications, reporting and analytics programs, and other business software, as directed by management in the regular course of business. Use of such tools ensures accuracy, accountability, and continuity across projects, supports collaboration among team members, and allows the organization to maintain visibility into work product and progress.

Work Authorization/Requirements

Must be located in the USA.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Affirmative Action/EEO Statement

Our company is an equal-opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

OuterBox may use AI-assisted tools to support the hiring process. Human review is involved in all employment decisions.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us: Prometric is a leading provider of technology-enabled testing and assessment solutions to many of the world’s most recognized licensing and certification organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies.
jobs.description:
About Us: Prometric is a leading provider of technology-enabled testing and assessment solutions to many of the world’s most recognized licensing and certification organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies. We support more than 7 million test takers annually at our testing locations in 180 countries around the world. With over three decades of experience working with clients of all sizes across a multitude of industry sectors, our mission is to design and deliver the highest quality and most innovative testing solutions anytime, anywhere.

JOB TITLE: Business Development Manager REPORTS TO: VP, Account Management DEPARTMEN: Account Management LOCATION: Remote in U.S

Job Overview:

Prometric is seeking a high-performing Business Development Manager to expand our presence across multiple industries by introducing organizations to our market-leading assessment and credentialing solutions. As demand continues to grow for secure, flexible, and location-agnostic testing experiences, this role will be instrumental in identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.

Working from both marketing-generated leads and self-sourced prospects, you will engage senior decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and position Prometric's solutions to deliver value, improve access, strengthen test security, and support workforce and credentialing objectives. Success in this role requires a consultative sales mindset, strong prospecting skills, and the ability to translate customer needs into compelling business outcomes.

COMPANY BACKGROUND

Prometric (www.prometric.com) is a trusted test development and delivery provider to more than 300 organizations worldwide. Prometric serves as an industry gatekeeper, ensuring that people legitimately earn the credentials they seek to achieve, and thereby guaranteeing a fair testing experience for all who come through our doors.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive new business growth by identifying, pursuing, and closing opportunities across Prometric's target markets and industry verticals.
  • Lead complex sales engagements from prospecting through contract execution, including competitive pursuits, executive presentations, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, challenges, and business objectives to position high-value assessment and credentialing solutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, influencers, and strategic partners serving as strategic advisors throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership, to develop customer centric solutions and winning proposals.
  • Execute consultative sales strategies that align customer needs with Prometric's assessment, testing, and credentialing capabilities.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a robust sales pipeline while delivering accurate forecasts and revenue projections.
  • Represent Prometric at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer engagements to enhance market presence and generate new business opportunities.
  • Monitor industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities and inform commercial strategy.
  • Utilize Salesforce and other sales tools to effectively manage opportunities, customer engagement, and pipeline performance.
  • Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations to secure profitable, long-term customer relationships.
  • Successfully navigate complex buying cycles, differentiate Prometric's value proposition, and advance opportunities through the sales process.
  • Achieve or exceed annual bookings, revenue targets, and pipeline objectives while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer satisfaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of successful consultative, solution-based sales experience with a demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles and strategic customer relationships.
  • Proven track record of selling to C-level executives and senior decision-makers within medium to large organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced business, technology, or related professional certifications are preferred.
  • Demonstrated success generating new business, penetrating new markets, and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience leading competitive sales pursuits, including RFP responses, executive presentations, and multi-stakeholder evaluation processes.
  • Proven ability to identify, develop, negotiate, and close enterprise-level opportunities in highly competitive markets.
  • Experience selling technology, SaaS, assessment, credentialing, education, workforce development, or other business-to-business solutions.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience developing proposals, pricing strategies, business cases, and return-on-investment justifications.
  • Ability to negotiate complex agreements involving procurement, legal, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand customer challenges and develop tailored, value-driven solutions.
  • Self-starter with a results-oriented mindset and a history of achieving ambitious sales, pipeline, and growth objectives.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior leadership and executive teams.
  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with product, operations, technology, finance, legal, and leadership teams to develop and deliver winning solutions.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously while maintaining a customer-first focus.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and other sales enablement tools for pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity tracking.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 35% to support customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and business development activities.

Prometric is an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate in hiring based on sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, and local law.

Title: Growth Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Klaviyo (AI-First)
Type: Full-time contractor
Seniority: Mid-level
Salary: USD 55,000–70,000/year + performance bonus
Location: Remote — Worldwide, excluding the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Western Europe. Candidates must be available for at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time.

About Nectar Life. We're a vertically integrated bath and body brand: handmade, vegan and cruelty-free. We make everything in our own 26,000 sq ft Las Vegas factory and sell it in our own stores on the Las Vegas Strip, Downtown Disney, Universal CityWalk and Waikiki, and online through Shopify.

The role. We're bringing growth in-house. You'll replace our paid-ads agency and own customer acquisition and retention end to end, reporting to the CEO. Your work will move sales visibly, and you'll help build our AI creative workflows from the ground up.

Must-haves (we screen for both first):

  • 3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads Manager work for ecommerce or DTC brands: you built, tested and scaled the campaigns yourself and can show spend, ROAS and CPA.

  • Hands-on Klaviyo: email and SMS flows, segmentation and campaigns you built, with revenue to show for them.

What you'll do:

  • Run Meta and TikTok ads: budgets, audiences, creative testing, scaling winners.

  • Run Klaviyo retention: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase and win-back flows, plus weekly sends.

  • Produce ad creative with AI tools (image, video, copy), then edit it to match our brand and keep product details accurate.

  • Report weekly on what worked, what didn't and what's next.

You'll stand out if you: have beauty, skincare, fragrance or gifting experience; edit short-form video; build automations with Claude, n8n or Make.

Hours: at least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm US Pacific.

Application questions:

  1. Upload a Meta Ads Manager screenshot of campaigns you ran (spend, purchases, ROAS visible).

  2. Upload a screenshot of a Klaviyo flow you built, with its revenue or conversion stats.

  3. Link one ad you made with AI tools and name the tools.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.

The Medical Bill Review Specialist serves as a primary liaison between clients, Service Operations, and internal business partners to support the delivery of Workers' Compensation medical bill review services. This position is responsible for maintaining client relationships, supporting operational performance, implementing program enhancements, resolving service issues, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to improve service delivery, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to:

  • Balance client expectations with operational priorities while maintaining a high level of service.
  • Use data, technology, and sound judgment to support informed decision-making.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting clients in Texas, California, Utah, Florida, Pennsylvania, Nevada, New York, and Illinois.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.excerpt: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not.
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Oromo. Your expertise will directly shape how Grok speaks and understands Oromo, from pronunciation and natural phrasing to cultural nuance. You will see your work show up in a product used by people around the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Annotate, label, and provide feedback on multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, and speech samples using proprietary tools.
  • Translate and localize text (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other content) from English into Oromo, with attention to accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural fit.
  • Help produce clear, natural audio data that accurately captures linguistic and prosodic details such as intonation, rhythm, and accent.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to refine annotation guidelines and tools for handling accents, background noise, speech variation, and multilingual audio.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proficiency in Oromo at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • English proficiency at CEFR B2 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Native proficiency in Oromo.
  • English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Advanced transcription or audio annotation, with strong attention to accents, prosody, disfluencies, and variable recording quality.
    • Translation or localization work (especially UI, product copy, or conversational text) between English and Oromo.
    • Voice recording, voice acting, podcasting, or related audio production that demonstrates clear delivery and attention to sound quality.
    • Background in linguistics, phonetics, speech sciences, or hands-on work with speech/audio datasets and AI training data.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • This is a remote role which may be performed from the following countries:
    • United States
    • United Kingdom
    • Canada
    • Australia
  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position, depending on role / business needs and candidate availability. Full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.
  • Positions are typically offered as fixed-term employment contracts of 6 months. Extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs.
  • For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • Travel to a SpaceXSI site may be required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: HNW Residential Property Advisor (Risk Manager) - Western Region (Remote/Travel)
jobs.excerpt: About the Role PURE Risk Managers perform independent risk assessments to evaluate complex property exposures and support underwriting and loss prevention strategies for our members who are owners of the finest built homes.
jobs.description:
About the Role


PURE Risk Managers perform independent risk assessments to evaluate complex property exposures and support underwriting and loss prevention strategies for our members who are owners of the finest built homes. Risk Managers apply professional judgment, technical expertise, and discretion to assess risk and determine replacement cost.


Risk Managers work with a high degree of autonomy, interfacing directly with our members to communicate findings on underlying risk factors identified in their homes, recommending mitigation solutions that impact business operations, underwriting decisions, and loss exposure.


This remote position requires extensive travel throughout the Western United States to conduct in-home risk assessments. The ideal candidate will be based in a location with convenient access to a major airport. Preferred locations include Las Vegas, NV; Phoenix, AZ; Bozeman, MT; Boise, ID; and Reno, NV.


Depending on the candidate’s location, 70%-100% of the homes they will see may be located outside of their home state.


What You'll Do


  • Perform PURE 360 Risk assessments by evaluating complex and varied property conditions across regions, construction types, and environmental factors, assessing risk exposure.
  • Analyze and interpret findings to assess loss probability and severity, using professional judgment to determine appropriate recommendations.
  • Recommend loss prevention strategies by identifying practical solutions and prioritizing actions based on risk impact.
  • Using professional judgment, technical expertise, and discretion, this role assesses property conditions, evaluates replacement cost considerations, identifies material risk factors, and determines the significance of exposures that may affect underwriting decisions, loss potential, and business operations.
  • Partner with Underwriting and internal stakeholders to provide insight that supports risk selection and business decisions.
  • Evaluate unique site conditions and risk factors by applying technical knowledge and experience to geographic and peril-specific scenarios.
  • Operate independently in the field with flexibility in approach and execution, adapting methods based on property-specific conditions.
  • Travel regularly throughout the Western United States to conduct in-home assessments and engage directly with members.
  • Communicate assessment results and recommendations clearly, including the rationale behind decisions and potential risk implications.
  • Serve as a trusted representative of the PURE brand in members’ homes, building credibility through thoughtful, knowledgeable engagement while bringing humility, professionalism, and genuine care to every interaction – delivering a service experience that reflects our commitment to excellence.

What You'll Need


  • Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required – relevant field experience is highly valued
  • 3+ years of experience as a Risk Manager at an insurance carrier, or in a related insurance role with exposure to property risk assessment and broader risk management practices
  • OR 5+ years of experience in high-value home construction, skilled trades (e.g., plumbing, electrical, HVAC), home inspection, appraisal, or a related field
  • Strong interpersonal and oral and written communication skills are a must
  • Demonstrated ability to apply independent judgment and discretion in complex situations
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Professional, trustworthy and passionate about helping others
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the Western United States.

The base salary for this role can range from $80k-100k, based on a full-time work schedule. An individual’s ultimate compensation will vary depending on job-related skills and experience, geographic location, alignment with market data, and equity among other team members with comparable experience.

‌

What We Do

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity: Join TopDog Law and Build Something MeaningfulThis role is an opportunity to:• Join a rapidly growing national firm at a formative stage • Make a visible, measurable impact on a rapidly growing business • Grow your skills, responsibility, and influence as the firm scales • Work alongside high-caliber, mission-driven teammates who care deeply about doing great work We are looking for people who don’t just want a job, they want purpose and impact.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: Join TopDog Law and Build Something Meaningful

This role is an opportunity to:

  • Join a rapidly growing national firm at a formative stage
  • Make a visible, measurable impact on a rapidly growing business
  • Grow your skills, responsibility, and influence as the firm scales
  • Work alongside high-caliber, mission-driven teammates who care deeply about doing great work

We are looking for people who don’t just want a job, they want purpose and impact.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Case Evaluation: Review and assess the merits of clients’ Personal Injury claims by analyzing records, documents, and evidence to determine liability and potential value
  • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients
  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement effective strategies to protect clients’ rights and interests. Conduct legal research, analyze medical records, gather evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies to achieve favorable settlements
  • Client Communication: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing updates, explaining legal processes, and advising them on their rights and options
  • Medical and Vocational Assessment: Collaborate with medical and vocational experts to evaluate the extent of injuries, their impact on clients’ ability to work, and appropriate future treatment requirements
  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

At TopDog Law, everyone is expected to think critically, communicate clearly, and take ownership of their work.

How This Role Drives the Business

This role is critical to our success because it:

  • Maximizes case value through strong case development, sound evaluation, and effective negotiation prior to litigation
  • Moves cases efficiently through the pre-litigation lifecycle, supporting faster resolutions and improved cash flow
  • Identifies cases that should be escalated to litigation early, enabling better strategy, resource allocation, and outcomes
  • Enhances client satisfaction and trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-through
  • Reduces risk and rework by spotting issues early, making decisive recommendations, and ensuring alignment across teams
  • Supports scale by holding case managers accountable to performance metrics and ensuring consistent, high-quality work product
  • Strengthens operational efficiency by reinforcing clear workflows between case managers and the medical records team to avoid delays in case development

Your ability to balance speed, strategy, and quality ensures clients are well-served, teams stay aligned, and the firm continues its rapid, disciplined growth.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

  • You independently manage a robust pre-litigation caseload, moving matters efficiently from intake through resolution while maintaining high quality and attention to detail
  • You consistently maximize case value through strong case evaluation, strategic guidance, and effective negotiation
  • You identify cases that require escalation to litigation and make timely, well-reasoned recommendations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • You collaborate closely with case managers, holding them accountable to performance metrics by setting clear expectations, reviewing work product, and ensuring deadlines are met
  • You take ownership of outcomes by maintaining the same level of accountability you expect from your case managers
  • You review, refine, and approve demand packages prepared by case managers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strong positioning for negotiation
  • You ensure case managers are effectively coordinating with the medical records team to obtain all necessary records and bills in a timely manner
  • You maintain proactive, consistent communication with clients, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout the process
  • You identify issues early, make timely recommendations, and help prevent bottlenecks
  • You build strong cases that, if needed, can be taken into litigation and through trial

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active admission to the Georgia Bar
  • 5 - 10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust case load independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Georgia laws, regulations, and procedures required
  • Must be located in or near the State of Georgia
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Nice to Have:

  • Active Admission to one or more districts of the Georgia Federal Court
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Experience in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

About TopDog Law

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling, fully integrated, personal injury law firm with strong partner relationships across the country. We are building for impact, excellence, and growth.
We are building a high-performance, high-trust, no-ego culture where talented people do meaningful work, grow quickly, and take pride in what they build together. This is not a legacy law firm.

This is a rocket ship, and we’re assembling the team that will take it to the next level.
If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love taking ownership and being held accountable, and want to be part of something you can help shape, not just maintain, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we’ve grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what’s possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now, we’re applying that same discipline and innovation to law firm operations, case management, and execution as we scale nationally and fully integrate.

We are intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams needed to scale at a national level—without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability. This is still the early stage of that journey, which means the people who join now have a real opportunity to help shape how the firm operates for years to come.

Who Thrives Here

We don’t hire based on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

You will thrive at TopDog Law if you:

Embrace Change

  • You have a growth mindset and seek continuous improvement
  • You welcome feedback and adapt quickly
  • You ask “What’s next?” rather than “That’s not my job”

Are Committed to the Organization

  • You care deeply about doing great work
  • You have your teammates’ backs
  • You’re here to build something meaningful and long-lasting

Bring an Upbeat, No-Ego Energy

  • You show up positive, professional, and solutions-oriented
  • You enjoy the work and respect the people around you
  • You leave drama, negativity, and ego at the door

Take Ownership

  • You do what you say you’ll do
  • You follow through and communicate early when something’s off track
  • You treat the business like it’s yours

Fast & Hungry

  • You move with urgency and sound judgment
  • You prioritize progress over perfection
  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-expectation environments
  • You seek feedback, stretch assignments, and more responsibility
  • You’re motivated by growth, impact, and building something bigger than yourself

Why TopDog Law

  • Real growth: As the firm grows, so do opportunities for advancement and leadership
  • High standards, real support: Clear expectations, coaching, and accountability
  • Culture that matters: Trust, respect, speed, and integrity, without sacrificing humanity
  • Meaningful work: Helping people through some of the hardest moments of their lives

Ready to Build With Us?

If you’re excited by ownership, accountability, growth, and the chance to help build something exceptional from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of TopDog Law.

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:At Wagepoint, we're good people.  It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Teamby collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kindby challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The Role:

We’re looking for a talentedPrincipal Software Development Engineer - Applied AI, who enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada.You’ll set the technical strategy for AI Products at Wagepoint, authoring thearchitecture decision records that define platform boundaries, persistence standards, and quality gates for every team building AI features, and setting the guardrails that let Engineering teams experiment with agentic AI.You will report directly to our VP, Engineering.

Your decisions are the ones other engineers’ proposals must cite and align to. Other teams’ roadmaps depend on getting your calls right. You’ll keep Wagepoint’s AI platform choices current against a fast-moving landscape, articulate tradeoffs in terms leadership can act on, and multiply the org through mentorship, pairing with and unblocking the engineers building on your standards.

Like every Principal Engineer at Wagepoint, you also carry broad architectural leadership beyond AI, including well-architected, highly performant distributed systems, and AI-augmented development practices across the SDLC.

Like every engineer at Wagepoint, you do not write software by hand. You’re a major contributor to the software factory, the agentic pipeline of specs, agent implementation, agent review, and human approval that produces our software. You’ll own specific agents within it and work with your teammates to constantly improve the factory itself.

Wagepoint’s goal is Level 4 on our agentic development ladder (engineers approve the spec, agents implement and review, engineers approve the PR), advancing toward Level 5 over time, without ever compromising quality in our highly regulated payroll and tax reporting environment. You are responsible for making that transition possible.

85% of your focus is customer-facing AI products and the platform beneath them. The rest goes to building Wagepoint’s internal use of AI and our software factory.

This role is measured by scope of influence, not just personal output.

What You'll Be Expected To Own:

  • Author the decision records that define how AI gets built org-wide, and resolve cross-team ambiguity with written, cited decisions.

  • Define and maintain the boundary between AI services and the product stack, and own the shared service kit.

  • Make quantified platform calls (evals, observability, persistence) against named vendors with cost models.

  • Define how every AI team gates quality: eval standards in CI/CD, drift monitoring, release criteria.

  • Set resource-isolation and agentic-workflow guardrails, and own the responsible AI and audit posture org-wide.

  • Keep platform choices current against the landscape, and publish dated verification notes and revisit triggers.

  • Lead design of large-scale, distributed, customer-facing systems where AI intersects the product stack, and apply DDD to define domain boundaries.

  • Be a go-to technical resource across teams, unblock high-impact initiatives, and shape engineering-wide standards through RFCs and reviews.

  • Set the org-wide path from today’s baseline to Level 4 of the agentic development ladder and beyond toward Level 5, while holding the quality and compliance bar required in payroll and tax reporting.

What You Bring To The Table:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with progressively increasing impact, including multiple years designing and operating production LLM/agentic systems at Staff-level scope or above.

  • Proven technical leadership designing distributed systems and microservices for complex domains, with working knowledge of DDD and Clean Architecture principles applied to build highly performant, well-architected systems (prior DDD project experience not required).

  • Full-stack breadth, spanning modern front-end frameworks and a Python back-end, sufficient to lead architecture across the entire product stack, not just AI services. .NET/C# experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Track record of authoring architecture standards adopted beyond your own team, producing decision records that other senior engineers review, cite, and build on.

  • Demonstrated quantified build-vs-buy decisions against named vendors (e.g., eval/observability platforms, vector stores), with cost models and explicitly rejected alternatives.

  • Deep fluency in the current AI platform landscape: stateful agent orchestration, MCP and inter-agent (A2A) interoperability, eval-gated CI/CD, and vector-enabled persistence (PostgreSQL/pgvector, DiskANN-class indexing, managed offerings).

  • A considered point of view on where Wagepoint’s model strategy should be in two years, including whether and where to adopt fine-tuned small language models versus frontier APIs, grounded in cost, latency, and control tradeoffs.

  • Experience defining platform boundaries between AI stacks and an existing product stack (e.g., Python AI services alongside .NET), including shared service-kit libraries other teams consume.

  • Security and governance leadership: resource isolation, agentic workflow guardrails, responsible AI in a regulated, money-movement domain.

  • Executive communication, articulating platform tradeoffs in terms leadership can act on, covering cost, risk, and optionality, not just engineering detail.

  • A high degree of agency, building net-new systems and optimizing API performance where no established pattern exists, forging the path rather than waiting for one, with demonstrated ability to bring other engineers along that path.

  • Demonstrated multiplier effect through mentorship: pairing with, unblocking, and growing senior engineers.

  • A passionate and key contributor to Wagepoint’s software factory, directing and reviewing agentic development while maintaining and improving our high quality and compliance bar.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

Call for Experts – Technical and Writing Support Services

IESC is a nonprofit organization dedicated to equitable, sustainable economic growth in developing countries. IESC believes that a robust private sector is a foundation for resilient nations and strong communities. Since 1964 IESC has helped to grow small and medium enterprises around the world and strengthened the systems and institutions that support them. By deploying a mix of technical assistance and volunteer expert support, IESC works with emerging industries, financial institutions, and governments to stabilize economic environments, increase opportunity, and promote growth.

IESC is seeking technical specialists/writers in various technical fields, particularly in trade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment, to assist with new business/proposal development and program reports on a consulting basis. The technical specialists/writers will work closely with IESC’s new business team and the relevant technical team to respond to RFPs/RFAs issued by USAID and other donors as assigned as well as contribute to program reporting. The consultants will offer in-depth knowledge in relevant technical fields and will be responsible for providing background information as well as applicable solutions in the target technical areas. The consultants will serve as lead or support technical writers for proposals and programmatic reports and develop feasible and relevant strategies and implementation plans in response to solicitations and programmatic needs.

Duties:

The Specialists/Writers will undertake some or all of the following specific tasks for proposal development:

  • Write the technical approach or specific technical proposal sections, as requested
  • Absorb desk research provided by IESC and conduct independent desk research, as needed
  • Review and analyze the solicitation and identify and highlight issues/questions that require further research
  • Offer options for effective approaches to achieve the goals of the program
  • Develop annotated outlines within designated page allotment (planned per subsection) responsive to bid document that follows IESC provided templates
  • Participate in design meetings with IESC, as requested
  • Design the program approach and key activities, including guidance on the cost of activities.

  • Work closely with, and incorporate technical input from local resource people and partners as appropriate including local technical advisors
  • Incorporate written and oral comments/recommendations from Proposal Review Panels
  • Recommend feasible organizational structure and assist with recruiting expat and local consultants and staff, as needed

The Specialists/Writers may provide some or all of the following support for programmatic reporting:

  • Design and create knowledge products, such as case studies, toolkits, resource/best practices guides, etc.
  • Contribute in writing programmatic reports, particularly mid-term and final project reports.
  • Conduct and report on desk level research and secondary market research reports to complement field-based knowledge and to share examples and ideas of similar project ideas in other parts of the world.

The technical fields where we seek talent include, but are not limited to:

  • Value chain/Agribusiness analysis and development
  • Enterprise development
  • Workforce development
  • Youth strategies related totrade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment
  • Gender strategies related totrade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment

  • Value chain/Agriculture finance
  • Impact/Emerging market investing
  • Digital Finance/mobile banking
  • Private sector approaches in Clean Power/Energy, Health care, and Tourism

The relevant knowledge and skill sets where we seek talent include, but are not limited to:

  • Excellent writing skills and proven capabilities in proposal development.
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge in the fields of economic growth and development finance are required. However, it is not required that each specialist/writer have expertise in all categories.
  • Applicants should have a minimum five years of experience working in international development and experience with USAID and other donor proposal and procurement processes.
  • On-the-ground technical implementation experience is preferred.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills: Ability to work under pressure in order to meet deadlines, attention to detail, thoroughness and accuracy are critical.
  • Excellent team communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills - including written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in English language is required.
  • Knowledge of other languages, such as French and Arabic is a plus.
  • U.S. citizen or eligibility to work in the U.S.

Job Description

The Network Security Architect will design and build the network security architecture our environment runs on, from firewall and segmentation design through cloud network architecture, and will stay engaged through implementation alongside engineering, not hand off a design and move on.

The Network Security Architect role sits within the Chief Information Security Officer Office, reporting to the Director of Security Architecture and Engineering (SA&E).

Essential Functions

· Designs network security architecture from the ground up: firewall policy and configuration, network segmentation, Zero Trust access design, and cloud network architecture in Microsoft Azure.

· Leads technical migrations end to end: assesses the current environment, designs the target state, builds the configuration, and manages the cutover.

· Works directly alongside engineering through the build and implementation phase of every project they design, adjusting the design in real time when engineering encounters something the design did not account for. This role is expected to close the gap between architecture and engineering, not operate on one side of it.

· Reviews existing network security architecture, identifies gaps, and designs the remediation, including hands on work to resolve technical debt in legacy configurations.

· Assesses, scopes, and estimates the work and hours required to deliver security architecture components of larger projects and programs.

· Serves as the technical expert and trusted advisor to engineering, IT, and business partners on network security design questions.

· Documents and diagrams architecture in both conceptual and physical form, including the underlying configuration, not just high level diagrams.

· Works assigned Request Security Architecture (RSA) tickets and related efforts in ServiceNow.

· Stays current on emerging network security technologies and threats and incorporates them into architecture as needed.

Additional Responsibilities

· Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities

· Demonstrated ability to take a loosely defined problem, perform the discovery work independently, and produce an implementable design, not just a conceptual recommendation.

· Advanced, hands on knowledge of network technologies: protocols, design concepts, segmentation, and access control.

· Advanced, hands on knowledge of security technologies: encryption, data protection, access privilege design.

· Direct configuration experience with firewall platforms, not solely policy or diagram level experience.

· Comfortable working side by side with engineers through build and cutover, including off hours implementation windows when required.

· Strong communication skills, able to explain technical design decisions clearly to both engineers and non technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required Computer Science, Information Security, or related field
  • Seven (7) years or more Experience in an Information Security Architect role required
  • Seven (7) years or more Experience with regulatory compliance and information security frameworks (NIST 800/CSF, ISO 27001, COBIT, etc.) required

  • Security technologies including encryption, data protection, access privileges advanced required

  • Experience working with internal business customers, architecting, deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting infrastructure security products

Overall Tasks and Responsibilities

The manager interprets and applies company-wide policies within the context of engineering delivery, driving effective execution and continuous improvement. They collaborate closely with Product, business leaders, and senior stakeholders to translate complex compensation and advisor needs into well-designed technical solutions. The team maintains and builds highly integrated products and experiences, requiring cross-functional collaboration across Thrivent.

Designing Solutions

Learning and applying new techniques

DevOps

Coaching Engineers

  • Provides constructive feedback, guidance and coaching to help engineers grow their skills and experience.
  • Provides career planning advice to engineers and creates development plans to help them achieve their career goals which leverages their skills and capabilities and provides them with learning opportunities.

Recruiting/building talent

  • Planning in advance for future people needs for the product groups, collaborate with the other teams on the recruitment process
  • Recruits, develops, and sustains a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.

Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.

jobs.excerpt: About North Star NetworkNorth Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.
jobs.description:
About North Star Network

North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.

Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

Role Summary

North Star Network are looking for a site coordinator to oversee the daily editorial and operational performance of Chilean sports site Al Aire Libre, ensuring high-quality, timely, and audience-focused content across the site.

Reporting to the Head of Media, this role is responsible for coordinating local editorial operations, managing contributors, monitoring content performance, and ensuring that editorial output aligns with the company's overall strategy, SEO objectives, and quality standards.

The Site Coordinator serves as the bridge between the central media department and the Chilean editorial team, maintaining high editorial standards while ensuring local relevance through a strong understanding of the domestic football landscape.

This role requires excellent organizational and people management skills, sound editorial judgement, effective communication, and a data-driven mindset.

Key Responsibilities

1. Editorial Coordination & Planning

  • Manage the day-to-day editorial calendar of Al Aire Libre.

  • Align local editorial planning with central media strategy, audience objectives, and traffic targets.

  • Ensure content reflects the site's editorial identity while maintaining a strong focus on Chilean football and topics relevant to the local audience.

  • Coordinate assignments with Writers, Editors, SEO, Tipsters and Social Media teams to maintain an efficient publishing workflow.

  • Greater integration of value-adding AI-led/assisted content into editorial workflow.

  • Identify key sports news stories, evergreen opportunities, and priority pages requiring regular updates based on editorial value, audience demand, and SEO performance.

  • Ensure content planning balances breaking news, analysis, features, evergreen, and search-driven content.

2. Workflow & Team Management

  • Supervise the day-to-day workflow of local editorial contributors and freelance writers.

  • Distribute assignments, monitor deadlines, and ensure all content meets editorial and publishing standards.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the Chilean editorial team, providing guidance, feedback, coaching, and performance follow-up.

  • Identify staffing or resource requirements.

  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and development of new editorial contributors where required.

  • Serve as the primary communication link between the Chilean editorial team and headquarters.

3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor key performance indicators including traffic, engagement, search visibility, rankings, and publishing output.

  • Use tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio to evaluate editorial performance.

  • Collaborate with Media Data Analyst to produce regular reports highlighting successes, opportunities, and recommended improvements.

4. Quality Control & SEO

  • Ensure all published content meets editorial, SEO, Anti-Spam and compliance standards.

  • Review articles for accuracy, clarity, readability, consistency, and adherence to editorial guidelines.

  • Ensure writers apply SEO best practices, including headline writing, metadata, internal linking, keyword optimisation, and content structure.

  • Coordinate with the Head of Social Media to maximise distribution and visibility of priority content.

  • Maintain publishing standards, templates, formatting consistency, and internal workflows.

Candidate Profile

  • Native-level Spanish speaker with excellent written and editorial skills.

  • Working proficiency in English, enabling effective communication with international teams.

  • Excellent knowledge of Chilean football, including the domestic leagues, clubs, players, and football media landscape.

  • Previous experience coordinating editorial teams or managing digital content operations.

  • Strong understanding of digital publishing workflows and editorial planning.

  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals and best practices for editorial content.

  • Comfortable with data, and experience using analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or Looker Studio.

  • Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced sports news environment.

Out of Scope / Role Boundaries

The Site Coordinator is responsible for editorial coordination, operational management, and content performance for the Chilean site.

The role does not include:

  • Defining global editorial or media strategy.

  • Ownership of overall SEO strategy beyond implementation and coordination.

  • Commercial, advertising, or partnership negotiations.

  • Commercial decision-making, although some collaboration with NSN business teams will be required

Success Indicators

  • Sustainable growth in site authority/notoriety, traffic, audience engagement, and search performance.

  • Consistent delivery of high-quality content aligned with editorial calendars.

  • Strong SEO implementation across editorial output.

  • Positive collab with contributors and central media teams.

  • Effective leadership and development of the local editorial team.

  • Clear communication and collaboration between Chile and headquarters.

  • Strong editorial coverage of Chilean football, delivering relevance, authority, and audience growth.

Ready to join us ?

If you're passionate about digital publishing, Chilean football, editorial excellence, and audience growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now by sending us your CV in English along with a brief introduction explaining why you're interested in joining North Star Network.

Join North Star Network and help shape the future of sports media for millions of fans across Latin America.

This role is a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst on the Finance – Reinsurance Reporting team, focused on reinsurance accounting and financial analysis for life and annuity products. Functioning independently, the BTA analyzes complex system incidents, identifies root causes, reviews business impacts, and formulates practical solutions that minimize operational disruption. Employing systems, data analysis, automation, and business knowledge, the BTA collaborates with Operations, Product, and Technology teams to restore service, improve system performance, and refine the user experience.

Beyond incident management, the BTA translates business needs into clear technical requirements. They support solution design and testing, develop productivity tools, and find opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: Our Vision & MissionWe envision a world in which all people have access to high quality and enduring solutions to improve and maintain their health and well-being.
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Mission

We envision a world in which all people have access to high quality and enduring solutions to improve and maintain their health and well-being. MCD Global Health aspires to be a premier partner of choice and a recognized leader, innovator, and trusted partner in healthcare and public health program development, implementation and evaluation. Our mission is to improve the health and well-being of people worldwide through enduring, high-quality, cost-effective, and universally accessible public health solutions. MCD operates impactful programs both in the U.S.A. and internationally.

MCD seeks a Digital Health Program Manager for its new program that leads the administration and implementation of technology and innovation initiatives under the state of Maine’s new Rural Health Transformation Program.

This position is a remote position based in Maine; relocation expenses will not be provided. Some travel within the State of Maine will be required.

Requirements

Digital Health Program Managers

Grade Level: 6

Anticipated Salary: $74,000-$88,000

Reporting Relationship: Director, Digital Health Initiative

The Digital Health Program Managers will partner with sub-awardees and contractors to implement digital health projects and programs in varying topic areas and technical approaches, including but not limited to: telehealth integration in schools, long-term care facilities, acute care, oral health, maternal and perinatal behavioral health, implementation of peer-to-peer telehealth models, remote patient monitoring programs and digital health navigation. This will include provision of technical assistance and training where relevant and ensuring that sub-awardees are achieving project milestones on time and within budget allowances.  

The essential functions of the position include:

Program Management:

  • Support sub-awardees and contractors in implementing digital health projects across multiple domains. 

  • Provide technical assistance and training to ensure effective adoption of digital health tools. 

  • Monitor and report on project milestones, budgets, and deliverables. 

  • Facilitate integration of telehealth and digital health solutions into diverse healthcare environments. 

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation in Maine’s digital health initiatives. 

Teamwork:

  • Participate in relevant workgroups and/or committees

  • Participate in MCD Global Health strategic planning as required.

  • Lead by example, foster a sense of teamwork, inspire a sense of personal and professional accountability and promote positive morale that supports productivity and high quality of work for the individual team, the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

  • Work to ensure that project activities and planning are directed toward the advancement of the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

Business Development:

  • Partner with the US Programs Business Development team to assist in the development and submission of grant and contract requests to sustain and grow MCD activities pertaining to telehealth and other areas of interest, including both US Programs and international.

  • Stay current in the field by participating in available trainings related to current grants and contracts, reading and reviewing relevant literature, and subscribing to relevant listserv(s) as appropriate. Strive to ensure that project implementation is responsive to the latest research and innovations and facilities growth in MCD Global Health's portfolio.

  • Participate regularly in conferences and meetings to develop and maintain relationships with current and prospective donors, clients, contractors, or government officials while keeping abreast of trends in the field.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. 

  • Training or certification in project/program management (e.g., PMP, CAPM) preferred. 

  • Familiarity with digital health technologies and telehealth integration strongly desired. 

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of experience in program management within healthcare, public health, or digital health initiatives. 

  • Demonstrated success managing multi-stakeholder projects with contractors, sub-awardees, and provider organizations. 

  • Experience implementing telehealth programs across diverse settings (schools, long-term care, acute care, oral health, maternal/perinatal behavioral health). 

  • Background in providing technical assistance and training to healthcare organizations or community partners.

jobs.description:
The Accounts Payable Executive – Finance role is part of Sage’s Global Services Finance Accounts Payable Team. The team is responsible for supporting the wider Finance function by ensuring the accurate processing of supplier invoices, timely payments, and effective management of accounts payable activities. The role plays a critical part in maintaining strong supplier relationships, ensuring compliance with internal controls, and supporting the organization’s financial operations through efficient and accurate transaction processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and support established Accounts Payable processes, controls, and procedures to ensure compliance with company policies and financial standards.

  • Accurately process supplier invoices in Epicor and ensure purchase orders are correctly matched with related invoices through Proactis (P2P) in accordance with Sage service standards.

  • Prepare draft payment runs and refund payments for review and approval.

  • Maintain and update supplier and customer master data, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of records.

  • Perform supplier statement reconciliations and investigate, resolve, and clear reconciling items in a timely manner.

  • Adhere to agreed Accounts Payable month-end close schedules and ensure all activities are completed within defined timelines.

  • Respond to supplier inquiries and resolve payment and invoice-related queries within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Sage to effectively resolve invoice, payment, and account-related issues.

  • Support management in implementing new processes, systems, and controls, while actively contributing to process improvement initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service quality within the Accounts Payable function.

  • Ensure compliance with internal financial controls, company policies, and regulatory requirements.

Skills, Knowledge & Competencies

Functional Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes and financial transaction management.

  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial controls.

  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy in data processing and reconciliation activities.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Effective organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team environment.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proactive approach to identifying process improvement opportunities and driving operational efficiency.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

  • 1–2 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Accounts Payable, or a related finance function.

  • Understanding of double-entry accounting principles and familiarity with US GAAP and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is preferred.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and data analysis techniques.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word and PowerPoint.

  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms (e.g., Proactis) is desirable.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with changing priorities.

  • Prior experience in a shared services or global finance environment would be an advantage.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

Our success is driven by a shared commitment to hard work, freedom with responsibility, continuous improvement, and excellence. We believe in giving our people the freedom to work independently while holding ourselves accountable for delivering meaningful results.

Your work will support our expanding operations and ensure seamless product launches.

  • Import new products into our Shopify store, ensuring accurate product details, pricing, and inventory levels.

  • Create and optimize product pages with compelling descriptions, images, and attributes to enhance customer engagement and conversions.

  • Monitor and update inventory levels, coordinating with relevant teams for restocking when needed.

  • Maintain high accuracy in imports and QA checks, minimizing errors to ensure seamless product data integration.

Your Team When You Join Us

jobs.title: BTW specialist
jobs.excerpt: Over StaxxerE-commerce is groeiende en daarmee ook het aantal ambitieuze e-commerce verkopers.
jobs.description:
Over Staxxer

E-commerce is groeiende en daarmee ook het aantal ambitieuze e-commerce verkopers. Omdat je als e-commerce verkoper groter denkt dan je eigen land, wil je al snel de grens over. Daar komen complexe Europese btw-vraagstukken bij kijken. Ons doel? Internationale verkoop makkelijk maken, door de hele backoffice te automatiseren. We onderscheiden onszelf van het traditionele (vaak stoffige) imago van accounting en boekhouding door het nét even anders aan te pakken.

Dit doen wij door ons toegankelijk op te stellen, en informele communicatie zonder poespas. Wij nemen onder andere de btw-vraagstukken van onze klanten van A tot Z uit handen. Hiervoor maken wij gebruik van onze eigen slimme software en service. De oprichters van Staxxer zijn geen fiscalisten, juristen of btw-experts, maar komen uit de e-commerce wereld. Daardoor weten wij goed wat de e-commerce verkoper nodig heeft en voorzien daarin met goede service en snelle, informele communicatie.

Over de functie

In deze veelzijdige rol als administratief medewerker ben jij verantwoordelijk voor btw-verplichtingen in Europa van onze klanten. Als onderdeel van het Compliance Team krijg jij je eigen (internationale) klanten, waarvoor jij een deel van de Europese btw-zaken afhandelt, en je een deel van de Europese btw-zaken coördineert met onze btw-partners. Deze komen bijvoorbeeld uit Spanje, Italië of Tsjechië. Bij het indienen van de Europese btw-aangiften word je geholpen door onze software, die precies uitrekent hoeveel btw de klant in ieder land verschuldigd is.

Een dag bij ons bestaat uit veel én veelzijdig klantcontact. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor jouw klanten, en je wordt indien nodig met vraagstukken bijgestaan door onze fiscalisten, accountmanagers of techafdeling.

Wij zoeken:

  • Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid neemt over zijn/haar taken;

  • Een zelfstandige houding;

  • Een flexibele instelling: in een een scale-up wil er namelijk nog wel eens wat veranderen;

  • Een actieve houding: we horen graag wat je denkt!

  • Iemand met basiskennis over btw;

Jij krijgt:

  • De flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid om te werken waar en wanneer je wil;

  • Een salaris afhankelijk van achtergrond en ervaring (€2.500 - €3.200);

  • Een onbeperkt aantal vakantiedagen, uiteraard in overleg met je collega's;

  • Hands-on begeleiding in het Europese btw-systeem, gewoon door het te doen;

  • Een MacBook en iPhone van de zaak;

  • Interessante klanten met grote ambities en natuurlijk leuke collega's;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te groeien binnen een snelgroeiende scale-up en jezelf persoonlijk te ontwikkelen;

  • De ruimte om jouw ideeën uit te voeren en het team te versterken;

  • Een tof kantoor in het centrum van Nijmegen, 15 minuten lopen van het CS (met gezellige bijkomende borrels). Werk je liever vanuit huis? Geen probleem! Kom je toch naar kantoor? Alleen maar gezellig. De keuze is aan jou.

Requirements

Je hebt/bent:

  • Een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding op het gebied van boekhouding, controlling, administratie of accounting;

  • Werkervaring is een pré, maar niet vereist;

  • Basiskennis over btw is een vereiste;

  • Secuur;

  • Flexibel;

  • Verantwoordelijk;

  • Communicatief sterk;

  • Leergierig;

  • De motivatie om een vraagstuk tot op de bodem uit te zoeken;

  • Geschikt voor werken in een scale-up: “it is gonna be a fun, but bumpy ride”;

  • Vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal en comfortabel met Engels.
