jobs.description:
PAXAFE is a pharmceutical logistics orchestration & decision intelligence SaaS platform that helps cold chain planning, logistics and quality teams consolidate their transportation data agnostically, digitize and automate product quality and lane qualification decisions, and operationalize prescriptive recommendations in the transportation network.

​

Acting as the cold chain trust layer whose mission is to drive towards zero transportation waste, PAXAFE works with cold chain manufactures and service providers to reduce product loss, improve operational efficiencies and make more informed decisions in real-time.

PAXAFE's vision is to become the backend intelligence infrastructure that powers every temperature, time and value-sensitive shipment in the world.

PAXAFE is backed by great VCs (Framework Venture Partners, Ubiquity Ventures, Venture53, RoseCliff Ventures, etc.) and CVCs (Microsoft M12, Northwestern Mutual, Greenlight Re)

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Implementation Lead) to drive successful deployments and long-term value for PAXAFE’s life sciences and logistics customers.

This role is fundamentally project management–driven. You will lead complex, cross-functional implementations for pharmaceutical and biotech customers, ensuring integrations, data flows, and operational processes come together seamlessly. You’ll act as the central point of coordination across customer stakeholders, internal teams, and technical systems.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be technically fluent — comfortable working with APIs, integration workflows, and data structures — and able to bridge the gap between business, operations, and engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end customer implementations across PAXAFE’s platform (Command Center, Lane Qualification, Auto Product Release, Risk Intelligence), with a strong focus on timeline, scope, and delivery quality.
  • Own project management responsibilities — building project plans, managing milestones, tracking risks, and ensuring accountability across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate pharmaceutical and supply chain requirements into structured implementation plans, aligning system capabilities with operational workflows.
  • Manage complex integration projects involving APIs, webhooks, IoT devices, and third-party systems (e.g., ERP, WMS, TMS, telematics).
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers during implementation and expansion phases — ensuring clarity, momentum, and trust.
  • Drive ongoing customer programs as clients expand their control tower capabilities — managing new integrations, feature rollouts, and optimization initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers, refine requirements, and ensure scalable, high-quality deployments.
  • Capture and operationalize customer feedback to influence product roadmap and improve implementation playbooks.
  • Build repeatable processes and frameworks to scale implementations across a growing customer base.
  • Support training, documentation, and enablement for both customers and internal teams.

Who We’re Looking For

  • 6-15 years of experience in Project Management, Customer Success, or Implementation roles within SaaS, pharma, or supply chain environments.
  • Strong project management background — experienced in leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations with clear structure and execution discipline.
  • Domain experience in life sciences, pharma, biotech, or regulated supply chains is strongly preferred.
  • Technical fluency — understands APIs, JSON, system integrations, and data flows; comfortable reviewing API documentation and using tools like Postman.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical teams — ensuring alignment across operations, IT, and engineering.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated environments (GxP, compliance-driven processes) is a strong plus.
  • Highly organized and proactive — able to manage multiple workstreams and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working in a startup environment — adaptable, resourceful, and willing to build structure where it doesn’t yet exist.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Mission-driven impact: Help ensure the safe, compliant delivery of life-saving therapies and critical products worldwide
  • Project ownership: Lead high-visibility implementations with global pharmaceutical companies
  • Growth phase: Join at a pivotal stage where you can shape how Customer Success and Implementation scale
  • Collaborative environment: Work directly with Product, Engineering, and executive leadership
  • Cutting-edge technology: LLMs & Agentic AI | Azure | Python | Prismatic | Supabase | PostgreSQL | IoT
  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere (Central / Eastern US preferred)
  • Strong compensation & benefits: Competitive salary, equity, five weeks PTO, full healthcare coverage

Our Core Values

  • Own With Pride: Take accountability for outcomes and execution
  • Navigate With Intent: Make clear, strategic decisions
  • Think Deep, Act Fast: Balance thoughtful analysis with speed

Senior Software Engineer - 3D Experiences Matterport

Job Description

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights, and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

About Matterport:

Matterport is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our groundbreaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data, making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 170 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.

jobs.description:
Company:

Qualcomm Germany GmbH

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Technical Standards Engineering

General Summary:

As a senior Technical Standards contributor and participant, you will work closely with internal and external partners to improve and evolve industry technical standards while representing Qualcomm as a delegate in standardization forums and industry organizations. Your responsibility will include understanding data center industry landscapes and competitors' strength and weaknesses, collaborating with internal partners to identify existing and emerging standards for Qualcomm to focus on, help review and guide internal product requirements and specifications for conformance with the standards, and working with attorneys to file patents that protect the novel IP aspects of any inventions.

The primary focus for this role is wired connectivity infrastructure involving high-speed optical and electrical SerDes standards for core data center infrastructure. This includes the implications of solving problems across photonics, packaging, materials science, and system architecture.

Technical Focus Areas

  • Direct experience with IEEE 802.3 and OIF. Aware of related developments in other data center interconnect standards ecosystems including OCI MSA, OCP, UEC, and UALink.
  • Deep understanding of 200G, 400G and forward-looking 800G/1.6T Ethernet rate evolution, including PAM4/PAM6 modulation, FEC, equalization, channel loss, BER targets and link-budget tradeoffs.
  • Knowledge of scale-up, scale-out and scale-across data center fabrics, including electrical copper reach limits, active electrical cables, linear pluggable optics, co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, and optical module architectures.
  • Strong ecosystem credibility with data center silicon, optics, connector, cable, module, switch, NIC and hyperscaler stakeholders.
  • Ability to assess competitive technology directions, identify standards gaps, and shape specifications to support Qualcomm product and IP roadmap objectives.
  • Ability to translate hyperscaler, AI accelerator, switch silicon, and optical module requirements into practical SerDes, PHY, controller and standards engagement priorities.
  • Ability to check posted technical material for accuracy and prepare internal technical material and analysis.
  • Ability to establish and play a leading role in a potential future “800G Interest Group” (or similar name) as a means to promote Qualcomm credibility and thought leadership in Data Center connectivity.

Minimum Qualifications (per leveling description)

  • Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience in system design, validation, or related engineering roles
  • 2+ years of experience participating in technical standards bodies or industry organizations
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across teams and organizations
  • Effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in optical, SerDes and system design, modeling, validation, or test
  • 4+ years of active participation in standards organizations (e.g., IEEE, OCP, PCI-SIG or similar)
  • 5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership
  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role
  • Deep understanding of data center ecosystems, including enterprise, HPC, and hyperscale environments

jobs.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals.   We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success.  We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

Digital Forensics Consultants are responsible for providing forensic analysis services andconducting onsite and remotecollections of electronically stored information (ESI) from computers, mobile devices, networks, collaboration apps, cloud repositories, and various other media and data sources.Using state-of-the-art technology, they process and analyze data in support of forensic investigations and litigation and prepare compelling, detailed reports of their findings. Forensic Consultants may occasionally provide court testimony related to forensic analysis and data collection projects.

What will this person do?

  • Perform forensicallysoundonsite and remote collections of ESI from a wide variety of data sources, including but not limited to computers, mobile devices, hard drives, servers, external data storage devices, cloud data sources, and other digital media.
  • Perform forensic analysis of data in support of investigations and/or litigation.
  • Prepare detailed written forensic analysis reports, declarations, and related correspondence.
  • Provide written and/or oral testimony in court proceedings as necessary.
  • Assistclients and various Lighthouse business units in scoping new forensic projects to identify project requirements, recommend workflows, and develop timing and cost estimates.
  • Provideongoing andtimelyproject status updates.
  • Accurately track and log assigned data collections.
  • Conduct custodian interviews to identify relevant data sources.
  • Enter time and expenses into the appropriate billing system by prescribed deadlines.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalenttraining andexperience.
  • A person performing successfullyin this role typically hasfouror more years of experience in Digital Forensics consulting and client service.
  • Ability to describe complex technical concepts / ideas in non-technical terms, to less technical audiences
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to balance many priorities and to work under pressure while remaining calm.
  • Ability to be a team player and to collaborate with the various teams across the Company.
  • At least one security or digital forensics industrycertifications, such as CISSP,EnCE, CCE, CFCE, MCFE, or similar
  • Experience in the forensiccollection andanalysis of Windows, MacOS, iOS, and Android devices.
  • Experience in the forensic collection and analysis of cloud and enterprise data repositories (Microsoft Purview, Google Workspace, etc.)
  • Training, experience, and/orcertifications with forensic tools such as Axiom, EnCase, Forensic Toolkit, Cellebrite (Inseyetes, UFED, Physical Analyzer, Digital Inspector, Digital Collector),Verakey/Graykey, or open-source forensic tools.
  • Masteryofdata collection, preservation, and chain of custody principles and procedures.
  • Experience ininterfacing withclients and client partners to plan data collection and forensic analysis projects involving a wide variety of physical devices, network storage, cloud storage, and email platforms.
  • Understanding ofproject economics with the ability to work closely with forensic team leaders to provide project time and expense estimates and set appropriate project expectations.
  • Experience providingwritten reports and/or declarationsfor use inlegal proceedings.
  • Experience providing court testimony is a plus.
  • Programming, scripting, and/or database design experience is a plus.
  • Linux/UNIX experience is a plus.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

jobs.excerpt: A gente sabe que existem grandes talentos em busca de oportunidades incríveis, mas nem sempre temos a vaga desejada aberta.
jobs.description:
A gente sabe que existem grandes talentos em busca de oportunidades incríveis, mas nem sempre temos a vaga desejada aberta. Por isso construímos esse Banco de Talentos. Assim, toda vez que abrirmos uma nova vaga no grupo ODDZ, estes serão os primeiros perfis que iremos olhar.

Então não perca tempo e se inscreva aqui. Assim que surgir uma oportunidade com a sua cara, entraremos em contato!

Buscamos promover a inclusão e a diversidade em nossas atuações e operações. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente que pessoas negras, mulheres e LGBTQIA+ se inscrevam no nosso banco de talentos.

Atuamos no segmento de marketing esportivo, cultura e entretenimento. Nossas vagas frequentemente estão conectadas às seguintes áreas:

# Criação

# Mídia, Social & BI

# Operações

# Planejamento

# Projetos

# Comercial

# Financeiro

# Growth Marketing

# Jurídico

# Marketing e Comunicação

# Pessoas & Gestão

NOSSOS VALORES:

#1 PAIXÃO

Nosso combustível é nossa paixão pelo o que fazemos e o impacto positivo que geramos ao nosso redor.

#2 COLABORAÇÃO

Trabalho e processo colaborativo para estimular a inteligência coletiva. Com colegas, outras áreas, outras empresas, clientes, pessoas e/ou empresas parceiras que possam agregar positivamente no desenvolvimento e entrega.

#3 POLIVALÊNCIA

Partindo do nosso DNA de consultoria, mergulhamos de cabeça no desafio que foi identificado, para então utilizar nossa criatividade para solucionar uma questão que parta de pessoas para as pessoas.

#4 EFICIÊNCIA E FLEXIBILIDADE

Processo não engessado, sem enrolação, sem muitas esferas de aprovação. Nosso foco é encontrar o problema, identificar a oportunidade e chegar na solução mais criativa e eficiente.

#5 FAMÍLIA OLN

Sempre trabalharemos para promover um ambiente que você possa sentir-se em casa, junto de todas as pessoas, sem a cultura da hierarquia. Não importa nossa estrutura, nosso tamanho, nem quão grande é nosso sonho, seu papel é fundamental.

#6 SENSO DE DONA/DONO

Pense, aja, atue e comunique-se como se a Octagon também fosse sua. Cuide dela e nós vamos cuidar de você. Projete seu futuro aqui

#7 LEGADO

O nosso desejo com todos os projetos é deixar um legado. Cumprindo nosso propósito de desenvolver o esporte e o entretenimento de forma relevante para seus ecossistemas e comunidades na América Latina. Isso é o que sustenta a nossa existência.

#8 DIVERSIDADE & INCLUSÃO

Nós valorizamos pessoas, vivências e opiniões diversas. As diferenças ajudam a criar valor e a entregarmos soluções completas. Isso só é possível com a real inclusão, permitindo que todas as pessoas contribuam com o seu máximo. Trabalhamos ativamente para aprender, respeitar, evoluir e remover barreiras para inclusão em toda a nossa rede de empresa e projetos

Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organisation!

Arduino's mission is to enable people to enhance their lives through accessible open-source electronics and digital technologies. Company:

Qualcomm Germany GmbH

Job Area:

Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Business Development - SIP

General Summary:

At Qualcomm, we invent breakthrough technologies that transform how the world connects, computes, and communicates. For over 35 years, Qualcomm has been the world’s leading wireless technology innovator and the driving force behind the development, launch, and expansion of 5G. We perfected processing for the smartphone, and now encompass many different verticals and products. From compute to automotive to gaming—you’ll find Snapdragon branded technologies making a difference. In 2023, we launched Snapdragon X Series - the most powerful, intelligent, and efficient processor for Windows in its class. Designed for this next era of modern AI computing, these cutting-edge devices deliver unparalleled performance, multi-day battery life, and advanced AI capabilities, redefining the personal computing experience.

Job Description: As a EMEA Channel GTM Manager in Germany you will engage across a select portfolio of Distributors and leading Channel Partners to define strategic marketing programs and GTM plans that drive market awareness, preference, and demand for Snapdragon-based compute devices in the Commercial Channel. You will collaborate with channel counterparts including Marketing, PAMs and OEMs to develop and implement omni-channel marketing programs, joint OEM campaigns, demand generation initiatives, pipeline acceleration activities, seller enablement motions as well as joint PR and event marketing that deliver significant ROI and meet performance goals.

This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent relationship-building skills and a strong understanding of marketing channels and tactics as well as a comprehensive knowledge of the IT industry – with strong focus on the Commercial Compute Channel. This is a fast-paced role where you will work with multiple teams across various time zones. The ideal candidate has in-depth knowledge of the regional market and expertise in driving customers down the marketing funnel. They possess extensive experience in developing and managing marketing programs and GTM plans across multiple partners and have a proven track record in scaling sales enablement efforts to drive partner awareness and advocacy.

Key Responsibilities:

Channel Relationship & Partner Management

  • Develop and support execution of quarterly GTM plans in collaboration with Commercial Channel Partners and Account Management team to enhance brand visibility, customer engagement, and drive revenue growth.
  • Foster and expand relationships with the Partner’s Marketing, OEM, and PAMs, and lead regularly scheduled meetings to ensure campaign and program alignment and execution.
  • Articulate the Snapdragon value proposition to the Partners Marketing and PAMs to ensure the benefits of Snapdragon resonate via the various channel programs.
  • Work with the Partner’s Marketing team to adapt marketing material to fit their audience - inclusive of email, social, banner ads, videos, content syndication, etc.
  • Manage quarterly Marketing investment plans for GTM related activities ensuring ROI.
  • Manage the approval process for Partner assets to ensure all Partner-created content and assets comply with Qualcomm brand guidelines and GTM messaging.

OEM

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to strengthen OEM partnerships at country level and ensure alignment on all regional GTM activities.
  • Build relationships with Partner OEM managers to ensure cohesive communication and alignment between the Channel Partner, Qualcomm, and the OEMs.
  • Identify relevant cross-collaboration activities to drive the sellout of Snapdragon-based devices, ensuring Snapdragon is represented appropriately in marketing materials.
  • Leverage OEM relationships to gain regional insights on products and markets and build a credible knowledge base within the organization.

HQ/EMEA

  • Collaborate with the HQ Commercial teams and the regional Account Management team to understand the Snapdragon compute value proposition and product roadmap to articulate this messaging to Channel partners.
  • Provide regular updates to the worldwide and regional leadership teams on Partner GTM plans, activities, and success metrics, working closely with the regional Account Team and Channel Partners to measure the ROI of MDF investment.
  • Work with the regional Account Team to understand and prioritize partnerships based on defined targets and align GTM plans to strategic focus in the region.
  • Build and maintain a strong network with the HQ Business, Marketing, PR, Social, Digital, Channel Training, and Brand teams to ensure that brand identity, messaging, and processes are seamlessly integrated into our regional go-to-market strategies and tactics.

Campaign Management

  • Develop and implement marketing campaigns, strategies, and tactics to promote the sellout of Windows on Snapdragon-based devices in collaboration with OEMs and Channel Partners.
  • Identify key verticals, target audiences, and KPIs for each campaign to track and measure success.
  • Work closely with Channel Partners to identify the sales funnel and lead qualification flow, ensuring relevant leads are nurtured by Channel Sales teams.
  • Collect and report on post-campaign metrics from Channel Partners to monitor the performance of spend.

Event Management

  • Collaborate with Channel Partners and OEMs to identify relevant tradeshows and customer-facing events that resonate with their audience and incorporate these into the GTM plans.
  • Develop a comprehensive event plan in collaboration with the Channel Marketing teams and their agency, covering aspects such as timings, venue, build cost, content, invitations, and attendee list.
  • Coordinate with the Qualcomm Marketing and PDM teams to identify and integrate relevant Qualcomm content for presentations to drive the Snapdragon value proposition.
  • Host pre-event kick-offs and post-event debriefs, and report on post-event metrics to track ROI.

Skills/Experience

  • 8 + years Commercial Channel and Marketing experience ideally from the compute industry.
  • Strong understanding of how the Commercial Channel and OEMs operate and sell, possess a deep understanding of the marketing funnel and tactics, as well as lead generation and nurturing tactics and tools.
  • Experience in negotiating and managing MDF Programs.
  • Skilled in defining and executing B2B and Channel programs to effectively drive customers down the funnel.
  • Creative problem solving with strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Ability to communicate and evangelize both internally and externally.
  • Proven experience in working on new projects and establishing new ways of working.
  • Comfortable driving cross-functional team alignment to create a comprehensive plan, identifying dependencies and critical issues/paths.
  • Experience in analyzing and reporting on the effectiveness of marketing programs and GTM plans and adjusting strategies as needed within established KPIs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of Commercial Channel and marketing experience ideally from the compute industry.
  • Master's degree in business or technology is preferred.
  • Business level English and German is required, additional languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to build trusting, collaborative relationships and rapport with senior business stakeholders & Channel Partners.
  • Strong capability to convey information clearly and accurately with great credibility.
  • Highly organized, resourceful, and adaptable.

What's on Offer

Apart from working in an open, relaxed and collaborative space, you will enjoy:

CI/CD Infrastructure Architecture & Scaling

Embedded Hardware Validation & Automation

  • Eliminate flakiness and nondeterminism in HW test environments.

Open‑Source & Internal Pipeline Ownership

  • Enforce PR gating, reproducible builds, artifact management, and API correctness.

Cross‑Functional Influence

  • Influence DevOps, firmware, and platform teams using data‑driven insights.
  • Lead technical deep‑dives on CI and embedded HW failures.
  • Align infrastructure capabilities with program milestones and customer requirements.

Documentation & Process Engineering

  • Produce high‑quality documentation for CI architecture, HW frameworks, and best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement and streamline reproducible HW testing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in CI/CD engineering, verification, embedded systems, or runtime/toolchain development.
  • Expertise designing/scaling CI/CD (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Deep experience integrating embedded hardware into automated pipelines.
  • Background in firmware flashing, device provisioning, power/reset automation, and board‑farm debugging.
  • Strong scripting/programming in Python, Bash, C/C++.
  • Experience maintaining open‑source verification pipelines.
  • Strong debugging across runtime/driver/inference layers.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Qualcomm AI stack (QNN, QAIRT, SNPE).
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute validation (DSP/GPU/CPU/NPU).
  • Background in silicon bring‑up or hardware‑in‑loop systems.
  • Experience with large device‑farm operation and automation.

Success Indicators

  • Highly stable, scalable CI/CD pipelines with reduced failures/flakiness.
  • Faster regression turnaround and increased throughput.
  • Strong embedded target coverage with reproducible signals.
  • Positive feedback from global engineering teams.

O Inatel

O Instituto Nacional de Telecomunicações é um centro de ensino, pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tecnologias, criado em 1965. Foi a primeira instituição de ensino superior de Engenharia de Telecomunicações do Brasil. Desde a fundação, o Inatel caminha junto às importantes decisões no que diz respeito a telecomunicações, tecnologia da informação, informática e todos os ramos da tecnologia.

A instituição possui mais de 800 colaboradores alocados em Santa Rita do Sapucaí, sul de Minas Gerais, região conhecida nacional e internacionalmente como o “Vale da Eletrônica” e em outras cidades do Brasil de forma remota.

Áreas de atuação:

Link Title is seeking an experienced, licensedUtah Escrow Officerto join our team on apart-time basis. Preferred

jobs.description:
Intelex is looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI and Analytics to join our growing AI team and help shape the future of intelligence-powered EHSQ software. In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for AI and analytics capabilities across the Intelex platform—spanning structured data transformation, embedded AI features, and the analytics experiences that turn EHSQ data into organizational insight.

You will work at the intersection of customer value, data architecture, and cutting-edge AI—translating complex enterprise needs into clear, prioritized roadmaps and working hand-in-hand with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to bring those roadmaps to life. The ideal candidate blends strong analytical thinking with a deep passion for AI product development and brings communication skills to align cross-functional stakeholders and represent our product strategy externally.

Responsibilities and Deliverables

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and maintain the product roadmap for AI and analytics capabilities, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation.

  • Translate business objectives, market signals, and customer research into a prioritized backlog with clear goals, success metrics, and release milestones.

  • Develop and communicate a compelling product vision for how AI—including LLMs, Auto-Structure, AI Lens, and agentic workflows—will transform how EHSQ professionals work.

  • Partner with the VP of Data Analytics, Architecture & AI to align AI product investments with company strategy and Fortive Business System priorities.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage Intelex’s unique cross-industry EHSQ data as a strategic moat, and build products that capitalize on it.

Customer & Market Discovery

  • Conduct ongoing customer discovery—through interviews, advisory councils, and collaboration with sales and customer success—to deeply understand EHSQ workflows and unmet needs.

  • Analyze usage data, NPS feedback, and support signals to identify friction points and validate hypotheses before committing to development.

  • Track the competitive landscape across EHSQ software, EHS AI point solutions, and horizontal AI platforms to surface gaps and positioning opportunities.

  • Partner with marketing on positioning, messaging, and analyst relations (e.g., Verdantix, Gartner) for AI and analytics features.

Delivery & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of AI and analytics features—from writing clear PRDs and acceptance criteria through sprint planning, launch, and post-release iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering leads, AI Solution Architects, and UX designers to make sound build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions and ensure technical feasibility.

  • Define instrumentation and analytics strategies so new AI features are measurable from day one; monitor adoption, quality, and outcome metrics post-launch.

  • Manage dependencies across squads and proactively surface risks to delivery timelines.

  • Support customer onboarding and enablement by working with the services team to define configuration guides, training materials, and rollout playbooks for AI capabilities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Enablement

  • Serve as the internal product authority on AI and analytics—enabling sales, presales, and customer success teams with competitive positioning, demo narratives, and feature deep-dives.

  • Present roadmap updates, business cases, and launch readiness reviews to senior leadership, including the CPTO and executive team.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in architecture and governance reviews, ensuring AI design decisions preserve trust, explainability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Contribute to Intelex’s external AI narrative—including customer-facing trust and governance documentation, AI pricing strategy, and partner/ecosystem communications.

Organizational Alignment

Reports to the VP of Data Analytics, Architecture and AI

Qualifications

Skills & Work Traits

  • Exceptional communicator—able to translate ambiguous AI concepts into crisp business value for executives, customers, and engineers alike.

  • Customer-obsessed with a bias for discovery before solutioning; comfortable sitting with ambiguity and structuring it into actionable plans.

  • Highly collaborative and cross-functional—builds trust quickly with engineering, design, data, sales, and services partners.

  • Analytically rigorous: uses data to drive prioritization decisions, measure outcomes, and tell compelling product stories.

  • Strong product instincts for what makes AI features trustworthy, useful, and adoptable in enterprise software contexts.

  • Self-directed and proactive, with the organizational discipline to manage multiple roadmap threads simultaneously and keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Comfortable representing the company externally—with customers, analysts, and partners—on AI product strategy and roadmap.

  • Leader who embraces the Fortive Business System and applies continuous improvement thinking to product processes.

Product & Domain Competencies

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise SaaS product management, including PRD writing, agile delivery, roadmap governance, and go-to-market execution.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts—including LLMs, RAG, structured data extraction, classification models, and agentic workflows—sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and make sound trade-off decisions.

  • Experience defining and tracking analytics product metrics (e.g., feature adoption, model accuracy, time-to-insight) and working with data teams to instrument and monitor them.

  • Familiarity with cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure) and BI/analytics tooling (e.g., QuickSight, Sisense, or equivalent) at a conceptual level.

  • Exposure to AI governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles as they apply to enterprise software products.

  • Experience in or passion for EHS, quality, sustainability, or regulated-industry verticals is a strong asset.

Experience

Required:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI, data, or analytics products in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Demonstrated track record of taking AI or data-driven features from discovery through launch and measuring their business impact.

  • Experience working directly with data science, ML engineering, or AI architecture teams and translating technical constraints into clear product decisions.

  • Strong command of agile methodologies and experience managing a backlog across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Preferred:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least one senior or lead PM role.

  • Experience in enterprise EHSQ, ERP, compliance, or related regulated-industry software.

  • Background in or exposure to data product management, including working with structured and unstructured data transformation pipelines.

  • Familiarity with AI platform economics, usage-based pricing models, or AI add-on packaging in enterprise SaaS.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline. Product management certifications (e.g., Pragmatic Institute, AIPMM) or AI/ML fundamentals certifications are a plus.

Other Requirements

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The HR & AI Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for shaping and evolving Fortive’s HR technology ecosystem. Reporting to the Director of HR Technology (Engineering & Platform), this position sits at the intersection of HR systems, enterprise integration, and AI innovation, leading architecture decisions across Oracle HCM Cloud, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, LMS platforms, and the broader IT landscape.

This role is the primary technical authority for HR platform architecture — defining how systems connect, how AI augments HR workflows, and how data flows reliably across the enterprise. The architect partners closely with HR Product Owners, IT/Enterprise Architecture, and vendor teams to deliver scalable, future-ready solutions that support Fortive’s operating companies and HR functions globally.

Core Technology Landscape

  • Oracle HCM Suite
  • Boomi Middleware
  • ServiceNow HRSD
  • Eightfold AI Platform
  • LMS Solutions
  • Integration APIs
  • Power BI Reporting
  • Oracle Analytics

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Systems & Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end architectural design of Fortive’s HR technology landscape, including Oracle HCM Cloud (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, Benefits), ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, and LMS platforms.
  • Develop and maintain architectural blueprints, data flow diagrams, and modernization roadmaps aligned to cloud-native, API-first principles.
  • Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the HR tech portfolio.
  • Partner with IT’s Azure-based infrastructure teams to ensure HR systems align with enterprise architecture standards and security posture.

2. Integration Architecture & Engineering

  • Define and drive integration strategy across HR systems, moving from point-to-point patterns toward reusable, API-first services.
  • Lead architecture and hands-on implementation using Boomi (atoms, molecules, connectors, process routing) as the primary middleware platform.
  • Design scalable integration patterns — real-time APIs, event-driven integrations, and batch/file-based flows — connecting Oracle HCM to Eightfold, LMS, payroll, benefits, and IT/ERP systems.
  • Maintain data integrity, auditability, and compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) across all integration flows.
  • Supervise and guide integration developers through the full development lifecycle, including code reviews, design reviews, and documentation standards.

3. AI Solutions & Automation

  • Identify and deliver high-value AI and automation use cases across the HR lifecycle — intelligent onboarding, workflow automation, AI-assisted case triage, talent insights, and conversational self-service.
  • Architect and implement AI capabilities within Oracle HCM Cloud, Eightfold’s talent intelligence platform, and ServiceNow HRSD.
  • Build and prototype solutions leveraging HR-specific AI platforms, taking ideas from POC to production.
  • Embed AI/ML, NLP, and chatbot capabilities into HR workflows and digital employee experience channels, aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
  • Establish AI performance monitoring and responsible AI frameworks for HR use cases.

4. Data Architecture & Governance

  • Design HR data models, master data management (MDM) strategies, and data lineage documentation in partnership with Data Engineering and BI teams.
  • Enable secure, governed access to HR data for analytics (Power BI, Oracle Analytics).
  • Define and enforce HR data contracts, quality standards, and privacy controls across all systems and integration points.

5. Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to HR leadership, Product Owners, and IT on HR technology architecture, AI strategy, and platform decisions.
  • Translate complex architecture and AI concepts into clear business outcomes tied to KPIs and strategic priorities.
  • Provide technical guidance on vendor selection and partnership for Oracle, ServiceNow, Eightfold, and integration tooling.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L&D, Total Rewards) to embed AI capabilities within HR programs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10–12 years of progressive experience in HR technology and enterprise systems architecture.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud, including integrations, HCM Extracts, Security, and configuration across at least three functional modules.
  • Proven experience with Boomi or a similar enterprise integration platform (Dell Boomi preferred), including building and supporting production integrations.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, synchronous and asynchronous processing, and data transformation.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI/ML and automation solutions within HR or other enterprise business systems.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML and automation solutions within HR systems.
  • Experience with digital assistants or AI-driven employee experience platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceNow HRSD, including case management, virtual agent, and HR service delivery configuration.
  • Experience leading or mentoring small technical teams, including integration engineers and developers.
  • Must be available to work within U.S. time zones (CST).

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Eightfold AI or comparable talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience with LMS platform architecture (e.g., Absorb, Cornerstone, or similar).
  • Background in Agile/SAFe delivery, DevOps practices, and CI/CD for integration pipelines.
  • Experience with RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or enterprise BI architecture for HR data products.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will have mapped the current HR architecture landscape, identified integration gaps and technical debt, and proposed a prioritized modernization roadmap. Within the first year, you will have elevated integration maturity toward API-first and reusable services, shipped at least two meaningful AI-powered HR use cases into production, and established architectural standards that guide the broader HR engineering team.

jobs.description:
Talent Enablement Partner | Fortive

Role Summary

The Talent Enablement (TE) Partner helps Fortive Operating Companies solve business and leadership challenges by translating them into practical talent actions that improve performance. This role serves as a dedicated partner to assigned OpCos and corporate functions — helping leaders focus on the few development and capability shifts that matter most, activating the right solutions, and staying accountable until those changes take hold.

Reporting to the VP Talent Enablement, the TE Partner works closely with OpCo HRVPs, HR business partners, and leaders to listen, diagnose, confirm, recommend, co-create, and sustain solutions over time. This is not a traditional program-building role. TE Partners use enterprise tools and content first, shape practical solutions for the OpCo context, and only build something new when nothing else will work. The role requires someone who can learn a new business quickly, build credibility without a lot of infrastructure, operate comfortably in ambiguity, and stay with the work long enough to see behavior and business outcomes improve.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Business & Talent Diagnosis

  • Build a deep understanding of each assigned Operating Company’s strategy, operating model, leadership strengths, and talent risks through an embedded partnership with OpCo HRVP, HR business partners, and OpCo people leaders.
  • Partner with operating company HR teams to clarify the real business problems to solve and shape targeted responses.
  • Translate business challenges into clear leadership, capability, and talent implications.

2. Solution Shaping & Enablement

  • Shape, recommend, co-create, and embed practical solutions by drawing from enterprise curriculum, assessments, coaching, development plans, and learning assets as options. Use what already exists when it will work. When no enterprise solution fits, the TE Partner may design a net-new approach with the HRVP and flag recurring needs back to the Enterprise Development & Delivery Specialist.
  • Adapt and contextualize solutions so they fit the Operating Company’s realities and operating cadence.

3. Selective Delivery & Coaching

  • Co‑design and deliver with HRVPs and other leaders when the circumstances make sense to build internal activation capability.
  • Personally facilitate and deliver high impact workshops, team installations, and leadership sessions when expertise, behavior change, or alignment is critical.
  • Coach leaders and teams in the flow of work, reinforcing new behaviors and practices over time.
  • For Partnership Programs (e.g., PLE, GEM, Talent Edge): support the reinforcement, practice, and coaching moments that follow center-delivered core experiences — helping OpCo leaders embed new behaviors in their daily work and operating cadence.

4. Sustained Outcome Ownership

  • Maintain ongoing partnership with the Operating Company HR team to monitor progress, adjust the approach, and reinforce follow-through until the change is sticking.
  • Stay accountable for outcomes over time — not just design and delivery — and prioritize solutions that support the business strategy and maximize business impact.
  • Surface risks, trade‑offs, and priority tensions early and transparently.
  • Own the ‘20% localization’ for Partnership Programs — adapting enterprise curriculum to the OpCo’s context, use cases, and operating cadence in partnership with the HRVP or OpCo customer.

How the role works in practice

1. Start with the OpCo business problem

  • Partner with the operating company team to align early on the outcome the OpCo cares about.
  • Use a simple sequence: listen → diagnose → confirm → recommend → co-create.

2. Translate priorities into critical-few high-leverage interventions

  • Convert business priorities into clear capability/behavior shifts and define “what good looks like” for leaders and priority populations.
  • Use reframes to keep the work outcome-based:
    • “That’s the symptom—let’s confirm the root cause we’re solving for.”

3. Leverage enterprise assets, but design for OpCo adoption

  • Bring a menu of established enterprise tools and adapt to what will work in the OpCo’s context.
  • Design for the OpCo’s operating cadence: integrate into existing meetings, rhythms, and leader routines.
  • When the best path is beyond current enterprise offerings, align with the HRVP on an alternative approach and ensure it integrates cleanly with the OpCo’s goals. Flag recurring unmet needs to the Enterprise Development & Delivery Specialist for potential enterprise portfolio development.

4. Build capability and sustainment while delivering

  • Co‑create with the HRVP and OpCo leaders so the diagnosis, story, and plan can be replicated and scaled.
  • Make “what to do next” explicit: define roles, cadence, and follow through checkpoints with the HRVP.
  • Align on whether the work is HRVP led (with TE Partner support) and/or TE Partner led (direct delivery). Co-design and support accordingly.

How This Role Fits in the Operating Model

The TE Partner primarily operates within two of the three engagement patterns:

  • Partnership Programs: The center builds the 80% core curriculum. The TE Partner works with the HRVP/OpCo to contextualize the last 20% (use cases, local examples, reinforcement cadence) and supports the coaching and sustainment layer after center-delivered experiences.
  • Custom Enablement: When an OpCo surfaces a unique need not in the enterprise portfolio, the TE Partner helps shape a solution — drawing on enterprise assets where possible and flagging recurring needs back to the center.

The TE Partner also coordinates with Learning Operations (a separate team managing LMS, talent technology, assessment tools, and on-site learning logistics) to ensure smooth deployment.

Success Measures

Success in this role is defined by observable and sustained impact, including:

  • Improved leadership effectiveness and behavior change
  • Stronger bench readiness and talent progression in priority roles
  • Higher quality execution of talent processes (e.g., OTA, development planning)
  • Improved employee experience in targeted moments that matter
  • Increased capability and confidence of HRVPs and people leaders to lead enablement work independently
  • Ability to integrate as a strategic and collaborative partner with OpCo
  • Strength of feedback loop with Enterprise Development & Delivery Specialist — recurring OpCo needs surfaced and addressed in the enterprise portfolio.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Bachelor’s degree required, ideally in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Education, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Typically 8+ years of experience across HR business partnership, talent management, leadership development, organizational development, internal consulting, or related business-facing talent roles.
  • Experience operating as an internal consulting partnerto leaders at all levels ideally through long term engagements.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex organizational and leadership challenges.
  • Strong facilitation and coaching skills; comfortable shaping demand, challenging assumptions, and prioritizing what matters most.
  • Highly adaptable and scrappy; able to learn a new business quickly, build credibility without a lot of infrastructure, and operate comfortably in ambiguity.
  • Judgment to resist building from scratch when an existing enterprise asset or simpler approach will work; able to design and build a solution end-to-end only when needed.
  • Fluency with modern learning delivery approaches and tools (virtual and in-person facilitation, cohort experiences, leader toolkits, and learning technologies) to scale adoption across operating companies.
  • Able to operate in a dual mode: as a trusted internal consulting partner (diagnosis, influence, alignment through the HRVP) and as a hands-on L&D practitioner (direct delivery, installation, and reinforcement in the flow of work).
  • Experience working effectively in a decentralized, multi-OpCo or matrixed operating model—balancing local context with enterprise resources and building durable partnerships with OpCo HRVPs and leaders.
  • Strong change leadership and implementation discipline; able to move from concept to sustained behavior change and stay accountable for results over time.

jobs.description:
Learning & Delivery Specialist | Fortive

Role Summary

The Learning & Delivery Specialist helps Fortive Operating Companies build the capabilities they need to win by creating practical, reusable learning content and curriculum that OpCos can deploy with minimal effort. This role turns OpCo voice of the customer and Fortive priorities into clear learning experiences that drive adoption and real behavior change in the flow of work.

In practice, this role partners with Talent Enablement Partners, Talent Planning, People Insights, and OpCo HRVPs to turn needs analysis into reusable learning pieces (targeting ~80% shared core) that OpCos can tailor as needed. It has a bias for fast, resourceful builds — curating off-the-shelf learning where it fits, using external benchmarks to raise quality, and adding Fortive-specific context only when it makes the content more useful. This role owns design and Fortive-wide delivery moments; day-to-day OpCo delivery and activation stays with Talent Enablement Partners and OpCo HR.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Needs Translation & Intake

  • Partner with Talent Planning, People Insights, Talent Enablement Partners, OpCo HRVPs, and FLT stakeholders to turn business strategy and talent signals into clear capability needs and learning outcomes that OpCos can use immediately.
  • In partnership with Talent Planning understand OpCo needs to inform most common, highest-impact learning and capability gaps to inform centralized content development.
  • Frame learning demand in an 80/20 way: define the reusable core (so OpCos can move faster) and the “last mile” customization needed for local relevance and adoption.

2. Shared Curriculum & Content Development (Build the 80%)

  • Design and develop curricula and content that OpCos can deploy with minimal friction—clear, practical, and built for real leader/employee use in the flow of work.
  • Establish and maintain a shared set of learning content that covers priority capabilities, including:

(TBD) GEM leadership capabilities, FBS Fundamentals, people leadership, change management, onboarding, and other priority capabilities as defined by the roadmap.

  • Build content with a reuse-first mindset: start with off-the-shelf learning when it fits, then add Fortive or OpCo examples only when they improve usefulness, uptake, and outcomes.
  • Support delivery of Fortive-wide learning moments and curriculum (ECO, GMDP, FBSLO, ALE, FLS, etc.).
  • Own the design and development of change management curriculum and capability-building content, in partnership with the FBS Office, for localized delivery through TE Partners.

3. Experimentation, VOC, and Learning Effectiveness

  • Operate with a bias for quick pilots: test with one or more OpCos, measure usefulness and adoption, iterate fast, and scale what works.
  • Run tight VOC loops with Talent Enablement Partners, learners, and OpCo HR/people leaders to improve content clarity, usability, and real-world application.
  • Define lightweight effectiveness measures (participation, completion, on-the-job use, leader feedback, and business-aligned outcomes where possible) and use results to refine the roadmap.

4. Leading Practices, Benchmarks, and Expert Network

  • Maintain a leading practice library across OpCos (what’s working, assets, approaches, facilitators) so OpCos can reuse proven tools instead of starting from scratch.
  • Facilitate simple benchmarking across OpCos and with external sources to keep content current, practical, and effective.
  • Build and manage an internal and external expertise pool (SMEs, facilitators, vendors, platforms, and content sources) to accelerate development speed and quality—including researching and selecting best-fit options as needs evolve.
  • Listen, test, and incorporate input—while keeping the bar high for quality and making sure content is easy for OpCos to reuse and deploy.

How the role works in practice

1. Start with the business need

  • Use inputs from TE Partner needs analysis, Talent Planning, People Insights, and FLT priorities to clarify what people need to do differently and who it’s for—so OpCos know exactly why it matters.
  • Confirm “what good looks like” and how learners will use the content in real work.

2. Curate first, then build (scrappy by default)

  • Scan existing Fortive content, OpCo-leading practices, and off-the-shelf content to identify the fastest path to an effective solution.
  • Build the shared core once (80%) and design modular add-ons for OpCo customization when required.
  • Customize for Fortive only when it increases relevance, adoption, and outcomes (e.g., language, examples, leader expectations, GEM/FBS integration).

3. Pilot, learn, iterate, then scale

  • Run small pilots with OpCos to test learning design, content usability, and facilitation guidance before broad rollout.
  • Collect VOC, usage signals, and facilitator feedback on content development; use feedback to quickly refine and improve effectiveness of content (prototype loops).
  • Package for scale so OpCos can deploy consistently: facilitator guides, leader toolkits, participant materials, and clear deployment guidance, including what is delivered centrally versus through TE Partners or OpCo HR. For Partnership Programs, define the handoff clearly: what the center delivers versus what the TE Partner supports.

4. Keep the library current and the network connected

  • Continuously refresh the shared curriculum and leading practice library based on new OpCo innovations, external benchmarks, and evolving Fortive priorities.
  • Connect the right internal/external experts to the right capability needs—reducing reinvention and speeding deployment.

How This Role Fits in the Operating Model

The Learning & Delivery Specialist primarily operates within two of the three engagement patterns:

  • Fortive Programs: Owns end-to-end design, management, and delivery of critical programs (e.g., FLS, ALE, ECO, GMDP, FBSLO). These are 100% center-designed and center-delivered.
  • Partnership Programs: Builds the 80% reusable core curriculum for programs like PLE, GEM, Talent Edge, and Change Management. The TE Partner then contextualizes the last 20% with OpCo-specific use cases and supports reinforcement and coaching.

This role also coordinates with Learning Operations (a separate team managing LMS, talent technology, assessment tools, and on-site learning logistics) to ensure curriculum is accessible and deployable at scale.

Success Measures

Success in this role is defined by reusable curriculum that OpCos adopt and use — and that gets better over time based on real feedback:

  • A clear, reusable “core” curriculum (80%) that OpCos can deploy quickly, with strong adoption and positive VOC
  • Faster time-to-deploy for new capability needs through effective curation and off-the-shelf reuse
  • Higher quality and consistency of key Fortive learning experiences (onboarding, leadership, GEM/FBS learning)
  • Evidence of iteration: pilots run, learnings captured, and content improved each cycle
  • A living leading practice library that reduces reinvention and increases cross-OpCo sharing and reuse
  • Evidence that content design enables behavior transfer — measured through post-pilot application rates, facilitator feedback on coaching usability, and TE Partner quality ratings on content fit.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Bachelor’s degree required, ideally in Human Resources, Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Development, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Typically 6–8+ years of experience across learning design, curriculum development, leadership development, talent development, instructional design, or related capability-building roles.
  • Strong learning design and curriculum development capability (needs analysis → learning objectives → content/curriculum build → pilot → iteration → scale).
  • High bias for experimentation and iteration; comfortable testing content quickly, incorporating VOC, and improving continuously.
  • Resourceful builder mindset: able to curate, adapt, and integrate off-the-shelf learning efficiently (vs. creating everything from scratch).
  • Fluency with modern learning delivery approaches and tools (blended learning, cohorts, leader toolkits, micro-learning, virtual/in-person facilitation guidance, AI) to scale adoption across OpCos.
  • Ability to build and manage an internal & external expertise network (SMEs, facilitators, vendors, content providers) and to apply benchmarks/leading practices appropriately.
  • Comfort partnering across a decentralized, multi-OpCo model—balancing local context with shared content, consistency, and reuse.
  • Familiarity with change management frameworks and the ability to design change capability content that integrates with FBS and operating cadence.
  • Learning technology orientation: able to shape content strategy that fits LMS capabilities and supports simple access, search, and reuse.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Global Trade Services Lead- GTS FunctionalJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) Functional Lead to support the Agile TM Team on the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS), a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

This role is responsible for leading the design and implementation of global trade compliance, export controls, and customs management processes within an integrated SAP environment. You will work across functional and technical teams to ensure that transportation and logistics operations are executed in full compliance with U.S. and international trade regulations.

This position requires deep GTS expertise, strong leadership capability, and the ability to influence enterprise-wide compliance strategies in a complex, highly regulated DoD environment.

Responsibilities:

SAP GTS Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the functional lead and subject matter expert for SAP Global Trade Services (GTS).

  • Own the design and configuration of GTS processes, including: Compliance management (restricted party screening, embargo checks), Export control classification and licensing, Customs management and import/export processing

  • Provide strategic direction on GTS solution architecture and integration with SAP S/4HANA.

Trade Compliance & Regulatory Alignment

  • Ensure SAP solutions align with U.S. and international trade regulations, including export controls and customs requirements.

  • Design and implement processes that support auditability, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Identify compliance risks and develop mitigation strategies and internal controls.

  • Support audit activities and ensure readiness for regulatory reviews and inspections.

Integration with Transportation & Logistics

  • Lead integration between SAP GTS, Transportation Management (TM), and Sales & Distribution (SD) to ensure: Trade compliance checks are embedded within logistics and order execution processes, Seamless flow of data across export, shipment, and delivery activities

  • Collaborate with EWM, MM, and Finance teams to ensure end-to-end process alignment.

Agile Delivery & Team Leadership

  • Act as a functional lead within an Agile team, guiding design decisions and mentoring team members.

  • Participate in and lead Agile ceremonies including: Sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives

  • Work closely with Product Owners to prioritize compliance capabilities and enhancements.

  • Ensure delivery of high-quality solutions aligned with program milestones and compliance requirements.

Requirements Analysis & Solution Design

  • Lead requirements gathering and translation into functional designs and configuration specifications.

  • Conduct fit-gap analysis to align business needs with SAP GTS capabilities.

  • Recommend scalable, compliant solutions that balance standard SAP functionality with mission requirements.

Testing, Validation & Deployment

  • Define and oversee testing strategies for GTS functionality, including SIT and UAT.

  • Validate compliance processes, screening results, and documentation accuracy.

  • Support deployment, cutover activities, and post-go-live stabilization.

Data Governance & Reporting

  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of trade compliance data, including classification, partner data, and licensing information.

  • Support development of compliance reporting, audit trails, and regulatory documentation.

Continuous Improvement & Optimization

  • Identify opportunities to enhance trade compliance processes and system performance.

  • Recommend and implement improvements based on regulatory changes, audit findings, and operational feedback.

Qualifications:

Required

  • A “Secret” clearance is required to begin employment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Information Systems, or related field
  • 8–12+ years of SAP functional experience, including deep expertise in SAP GTS
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments and integrations
  • Strong knowledge of global trade compliance regulations, including export controls and customs processes
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Demonstrated ability to lead functional design efforts and influence stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred

  • Experience supporting DoD or federal government logistics and transportation programs
  • Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, and other U.S. export control regulations
  • Experience integrating GTS with SAP modules such as TM, SD, MM, and FI/CO
  • Experience with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe)
-

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Allbridge is the leading supplier of world class connected technology solutions, services, and support for high-density properties.

With more than 35 years of continuous growth and industry experience, Allbridge supports technology in over one million rooms, in 8,000 properties, across North America and the Caribbean, including hotels, resorts, senior-living communities, condominiums, multifamily developments, and mixed-use properties.

Job Summary

The Sales Director, Multifamily will play a key role in executing Allbridge's growth and expansion strategy. This role will be responsible for driving the organization’s continued fast-paced expansion into new and existing markets and closing new business through strategic and consultative selling to national and regional property owners and managers. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth across the multifamily and senior living markets, with ownership of complex, large‑scale opportunities. The position requires a relentless hunter consistently employing thoughtful sales processes with a consistent track record of sales over-achievement. This is a client-facing role requiring deep industry expertise, proven ability, and a broad base of industry contacts. This role will report to the Chief Financial and Operating Officer. The Director will work closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Operations to deliver scalable, market‑aligned solutions and establish Allbridge as a preferred provider with key ownership and management groups.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

Successful employees have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university and a minimum of 4+ years of demonstrated relevant work experience in strategic sales in a business-to-business sales environment, in the Multifamily and/or Senior Living industries selling smart-building technology, bulk services such as resident video services or wifi solutions. Required to build rapport and lasting relationships with large national firms, professionally managing accounts, setting and pitching sales meetings, maintain a full sales funnel, negotiating contracts, and closing deals selling cutting edge, disruptive technology to top decision-makers at the enterprise level. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Has some authority to perform contract negotiations, and including pricing, features, and installation timelines per company standards.
  • Develop new business opportunities by identifying potential clients, building rapport with key decision makers, and penetrating national sales markets.
  • Meet assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned accounts.
  • Initiate internal partnerships with sales and solutions engineering team members to assist in closing complex and/or technical sales that require additional technical expertise.
  • Use consultative selling skills to quickly assess needs and sales opportunities within the client base. Deliver solutions and proposals that care for and solve for these requirements.
  • Attend industry and business development events, inclusive of identifying and nurturing sales leads.
  • Participate in strategic account planning to grow our presence and deepen penetration into large accounts or opportunities.
  • Deliver forecast reporting and required training/development objectives within the assigned time frame.
  • Consistently integrates Albridge’s core values into their everyday habits by treating all customers, internal and external, professionally, honestly, and respectfully.
  • Accepts ownership and accountability of position responsibilities and consistently strives to deliver innovative results for internal teams and customers that establish trust, high standards, credibility, and quality performance.
  • Meet clients face to face, demonstrating deep industry expertise. Travel requirements, typically a minimum 30-40% and based on business need.

Required Qualifications

  • Successful completion of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university (or international equivalent) in business administration. A graduate degree is preferred. In lieu of a degree, 6 years of strategic sales experience is required.
  • Required to have a minimum of 4+ years of demonstrated strategic sales experience in a business-to-business sales environment, in the Multifamily and Senior Living industries, with a preference to have experience selling video services, advanced network and infrastructure platforms, and smart technology (IoT) solutions.
  • Ability to build rapport and lasting relationships with large national firms, professionally managing accounts, setting and pitching sales meetings, negotiating contracts, and closing deals selling cutting edge, disruptive technology to top decision-makers at the enterprise level.
  • Consistently demonstrates excellent professional business acumen, organization skills, detail-oriented, meeting deadlines, and metrics driven decision-making skills.
  • Maintain a strong portfolio of C-Level contacts within Enterprise Accounts.
  • Advanced knowledge of construction management processes, and preference to have expert knowledge of building products, construction details and relevant rules, regulations, and quality standards.
  • Must have familiarity with prospecting and customer relationship management tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, BuildCentral, and Construct Connect, and Salesforce. Remains adaptable; able to quickly learn new technologies and processes.
  • Must be flexible, an outstanding communicator with a customer service focus, and must consistently demonstrate skills in accuracy, organization, and time management.
  • Must be able to work effectively as a team member in a fast paced, and high-volume work environment, operating with a high level of detail and conscientiousness.
  • Must possess excellent verbal, written, and presentation communications skills in the English language.
  • Required to have demonstrated intermediate level PC skills with the ability to effectively operate within a Windows Operating System and Windows based programs such as Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, and Project.
  • Intermediate Salesforce and NetSuite accounting software experience is a plus.
  • Ability to travel 30-40% based on business needs.

Workplace Benefits We Offer

In addition to earnings and other incentives Allbridge offers a comprehensive package of benefits, based on eligibility, typically for regular, full-time positions, some of which includes:

  • Medical and Prescription options, Dental, Orthodontics and Vision Plans
  • Rich HSA company-funded options and Flexible Spending accounts
  • 100% Company paid premiums for Short Term Disability
  • Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment insurance Plan options
  • Supplemental Insurance Plan options
  • 401(k) Profit-Sharing Retirement plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off after 60 days of employment
  • Paid Holidays, per Employee Handbook
  • Great workplace culture that embodies our values.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Allbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Allbridge does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions tohundreds of thousands of businessesand empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Backend Software Engineer on Twilio Segment CDP engineering team.


Who we are & why we’re hiring

Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.


Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a globally anti-racist, anti-oppressive, anti-bias company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business. We employ thousands of Twilions worldwide, and we're looking for more builders, creators, and visionaries to help fuel our growth momentum.

About the job

Segment is a best-in-classcustomer data platform (CDP) designed with engineers, marketers, and product managers in mind. We’re excited to work at the cutting edge of data and artificial intelligence, such as with ourAI-Assisted Suggest Mappings product. And, we move a lot of data -over 12 trillion API calls a year.


This position is needed to build and scale APIs to enable Twilio developers to unlock best-in-class personalized customer experiences through the Twilio Segment CDP products. As a Software Engineer on the team, you will collaborate closely with product management, architecture, and other engineering teams to design APIs, identify performance bottlenecks, and data models, and drive system-level improvements that enhance both developer velocity and customer experience. You’ll be expected to evaluate and communicate trade-offs between feature velocity, system stability, and technical debt, and help drive architectural decisions that ensure long-term sustainability and performance.


We iterate quickly on these products and features and learn new things daily — all while writing quality code using the latest AI tools. We work closely with product and design and solve some of the toughest engineering problems to unlock new possibilities for our customers. If you get excited by building products with high customer impact — this is the place for you.


Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design and build robust, scalable backend systems and APIs across Segment’s data platform.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with design, product, and other engineers to define solutions that balance usability, performance, and long-term architecture.
  • Communicate technical decisions clearly - articulating trade-offs, customer impact, and team alignment.
  • Troubleshoot and improve system reliability, debugging issues and refining operational tooling and processes.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for our managed services

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


Required:

  • Experience programming in one or more of the following: Go, Java, Python, or similar languages
  • Experience operating large-scale, distributed systems on top of cloud infrastructure such as Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Have hands-on experience with container orchestration frameworks (e.g. Kubernetes, EKS, ECS)
  • Have experience with large scale async processing systems
  • Experience shipping services (products) following CI/CD development paradigm
  • Good grasp of software engineering and how to build a system in scalable and extensive manner;
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills to convey complex technical concepts effectively.
  • Comfortable asking questions and taking initiative to solve problems where it is often necessary to “draw the owl”
  • Leverage best-in-class development productivity practices including AI tooling.

Desired:

  • Building products or tools that are currently using A.I.
  • Experience working with event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pulsar, or similar).
  • Familiarity with database technologies like PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.
  • Exposure to observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.
  • Experience working in a geographically distributed team.

Location:

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.
  • No mandatory travel is anticipated.

Compensation:

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.
The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:
  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C.
  • $116,960.00 to $146,200.00.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay a
  • rea): $123,760.00 to $154,700.00).
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520.00 to $171,900.00).
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 7/16/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
