jobs.description:
About the Role

Our client is a well-established roofing contractor based in Colorado, USA, serving customers across the Colorado Front Range.

The business currently completes approximately three roofs per week and has the infrastructure to significantly increase its volume. They are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support the growing operation.

Despite the Administrative Assistant title, this is not a junior or passive role. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership, work independently, follow projects through to completion, identify issues before they become problems and continuously look for ways to improve processes.

This is a phone-heavy and customer-facing position, with significant inbound and outbound communication. Native-level or near-native spoken English is essential.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Customer & Office Administration

  • Answer and return company phone calls.
  • Monitor and respond to company emails.
  • Communicate professionally with homeowners, vendors, subcontractors, insurance companies, inspectors and municipalities.
  • Maintain accurate customer and project records.
  • Manage tasks and projects within the CRM system.
  • Keep project notes, statuses, documents and follow-up tasks up to date.
  • Identify projects or tasks that appear stalled and take appropriate action.

Lead Follow-Up

  • Contact new leads promptly.
  • Follow up with leads who have not scheduled appointments.
  • Assist with inspection and appointment scheduling.
  • Document all lead communication and follow-up activity.
  • Ensure potential opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

Permits & Inspections

  • Apply for roofing and construction permits with cities and counties throughout Colorado.
  • Research municipality-specific permitting requirements.
  • Track permit applications through approval.
  • Record permit costs and upload permits to customer files.
  • Identify projects requiring mid-roof or specialist inspections.
  • Schedule required inspections.
  • Coordinate ladder sets where required.
  • Communicate inspection dates and requirements to homeowners.
  • Track inspections through final approval.

Permitting is a significant part of this position, and the successful candidate will need to manage different requirements and online portals across approximately 20 Colorado municipalities.

Insurance Supplements

  • Assist with submitting insurance supplements.
  • Maintain the Supplements in Progress tracker.
  • Track original insurance pricing, supplement status, approvals and increases.
  • Save supplement documentation to customer files.
  • Communicate supplement submissions and approvals to homeowners.
  • Follow supplements through to completion.
  • Ensure approved supplemental amounts are reflected correctly in final billing.

Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare down-payment invoices.
  • Review signed quotes and insurance estimates when preparing invoices.
  • Understand basic insurance terminology such as RCV and supplemental payments.
  • Prepare final invoices and incorporate applicable change orders.
  • Update invoices when insurance supplements are approved.
  • Monitor accounts receivable.
  • Contact customers regarding unpaid balances.
  • Document collection communication and follow up until outstanding balances are resolved.

Project Completion & Warranties

  • Prepare Certificates of Completion.
  • Send completion documentation to customers and insurance carriers where required.
  • Complete the company's 5-Year Hail & Wind Warranty process.
  • Identify applicable manufacturer warranties from signed contracts.
  • Register manufacturer warranties with relevant manufacturers.
  • Maintain accurate warranty documentation.
  • Notify homeowners once warranty registration has been completed.

CRM & File Management

  • Maintain complete and organised customer files.
  • Ensure CRM and Google Drive information remains consistent.
  • Upload permits, supplements, warranties, certificates, invoices and other project documentation.
  • Maintain consistent file naming and folder structures.
  • Identify and clean up duplicate, outdated or incorrectly stored documents.
  • Continually improve the organisation of digital files and records.

Process Improvement & Automation

The client is looking for someone who will improve the system rather than simply work within it.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Helping maintain and improve CRM workflows.
  • Reviewing task templates, project stages, forms and automations.
  • Identifying repetitive administrative tasks that could be automated.
  • Identifying process gaps that could lead to errors.
  • Creating and maintaining SOPs and checklists.
  • Assisting management with improving processes between sales, production, administration and accounting.

Compliance & Administration

  • Maintain subcontractor documentation and compliance packets.
  • Track W-9s, Certificates of Insurance, subcontractor agreements and other required paperwork.
  • Follow up on expired or missing documentation.
  • Maintain HR and company documentation.
  • Track contractor licences and registrations.
  • Ensure licence and registration renewals are completed before expiry.
  • Maintain insurance certificates and compliance documentation.
  • Maintain accurate vendor, municipality, inspector and manufacturer contact information.

Google & Marketing Support

Once core administrative responsibilities are under control, the successful candidate may also assist with:

  • Maintaining Google Business Profiles.
  • Uploading project photographs and before-and-after content.
  • Organising project photographs and marketing assets.
  • Creating before-and-after project videos using provided templates.
  • Organising marketing and social media assets.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations, customer service, coordination or similar role.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong telephone and customer communication skills.
  • Confidence making outbound calls.
  • Strong computer literacy.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks, projects and deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems is advantageous.
  • Strong Google Workspace/Google Drive skills.
  • The ability and willingness to work US Mountain Time hours.

Advantageous Experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

  • Roofing or construction administration.
  • Insurance administration or claims.
  • Permitting.
  • Accounts receivable or collections.
  • CRM administration.
  • Project coordination.
  • Compliance administration.
  • Process improvement.
  • SOP development.
  • Experience working with US-based companies.
  • Experience working US hours.

Working Hours

The position supports a US-based business and requires the candidate to work Mountain Time.

South African working hours: approximately 16:00–01:00 SAST.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Takes initiative rather than waiting to be instructed.
  • Is highly organised and detail-oriented.
  • Is confident speaking to customers and making outbound calls.
  • Can manage difficult conversations professionally.
  • Follows tasks through to completion.
  • Notices when something is falling through the cracks.
  • Can work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Enjoys improving processes and finding efficiencies.
  • Is comfortable learning new systems and technology.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for their work.

Key Consideration

This is not a quiet back-office administrative position. The role involves frequent phone communication, outbound lead follow-up, customer collections, permitting, insurance administration and ongoing coordination.

The successful candidate should be confident, proactive, highly organised and comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities.

We’re hiring an executive coach for Hendrik (CEO of Sharpist) for the next 12+ months.

This is a high-bar search.

We are looking for the top tier — not “good fit,” but the best operator-coach we can find in the market.

Context

Hendrik is leading Sharpist through a category-defining transformation — from a profitable, stable coaching platform into an AI-driven category bet in professional development. The next 12 months will determine whether Sharpist becomes a generational company or a successful European HR-tech player. Hendrik needs to operate at a fundamentally higher altitude to lead it: setting missions rather than running them, building systems that win without him, stepping out of operational work that has historically defined his contribution.

The coach is one of the most important hires of this transformation. They are the intellectual sparring partner who makes the shift in Hendrik’s leadership actually stick.

Non-negotiables

  • C-level operating experience in enterprise SaaS, through the 10M+ ARR scale phase. Founder, CEO, COO, or equivalent. Not earlier-stage, not adjacent industries, not advisor-only careers. They have personally lived the altitude shift we’re hiring them to coach through.

  • Expert coach, primary craft. Trained, certified, actively practicing. Coaching is what they do now — not advisory work with coaching on the side, not “operator who coaches.” We want the coaching craft to lead, with operating depth as the foundation.

  • Track record at the altitude we’re targeting. Has coached founders or CEOs through similar inflection points. Can name them (under NDA). References from current or recent coachees at this level are required.

What we are not looking for

  • Generalist executive coaches without enterprise SaaS context

  • Operators-turned-advisors with strong opinions on what Hendrik should do

  • Wellness, life, or holistic coaches

  • ICF-credential-only coaches without operating depth

  • Anyone who would treat this as “another engagement” rather than the work of a transformation

Focus areas

  • Moving from leader-of-leads to true CEO altitude — football manager mode, not player

  • Building a personal operating system away from task-list-driven work

  • Interrupting the default failure mode of leaning into operational work when stress rises

  • Designing the team architecture around Hendrik — firefighter roles, accountability anchors, ownership transfer

  • Increasing leverage and consequentiality with the leadership team

  • Sustainable energy management

  • Sparring on strategic questions through coaching, not prescription

Logistics

  • Engagement: ongoing, likely 2-4 sessions per month

  • Format: strong preference to deliver via the Sharpist platform (Hendrik is the CEO; using our own product is non-negotiable as a signal and as research)

  • Geography: irrelevant — we want the best person globally

  • Language: English working language

Search posture

This is not a posting. This is an active, high-touch search. We expect to:

  • Source from operator and founder networks, not coaching directories

  • Vet against the non-negotiables ruthlessly — most candidates will not clear the bar

  • Run multiple candidates in parallel rather than evaluating one at a time

  • Move fast once we find the right person — top-tier coaches at this level get booked

  • The right candidate is rare. We are looking for the AAA+ in the market, not the best of who applies.

Requirements

A first conversation with Hendrik should answer:

  • Did they hold a C-level role in enterprise SaaS through the 10M+ ARR scale-up — verifiable?

  • Is coaching their primary craft today, with operating experience as foundation rather than substitute?

  • Do they hold space and let Hendrik find answers, or do they advise and prescribe?

  • Would Hendrik genuinely want to spend two sessions a month with this person for the next 12 months?

  • Are they hungry for this engagement specifically, or treating it as one of many?

The last question matters most. We want someone who, after the first conversation, sees Hendrik and Sharpist as the kind of engagement they would prioritize over others.

Highlights

Sharpist is running a high-touch, operator-network search for an AAA+ coach—C-level enterprise SaaS (10M+ ARR) and coaching-first craft.

The Director, M&A is a senior leader within Veralto’s Legal team and a strategic advisor to Corporate Development and executive leadership. This role leads the legal execution of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments, and other high‑impact strategic transactions that advance Veralto’s long‑term growth agenda.

As a senior member of the team, the Director builds trusted partnerships with Finance Leaders, Segment VPs, Corporate Development, Finance, HR, Tax, and other functional leaders. This role provides strategic guidance across all phases of the M&A lifecycle—from upfront deal evaluation to integration—ensuring disciplined execution, thoughtful risk management, and alignment with Veralto’s purpose of Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources

Reports to: Corporate Secretary and Vice President, M&A, Securities & Governance, with strong partnership to SVP Corporate Development

US ONLY:

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An associate’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs.

The compensation range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This job is also eligible for Bonus Pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

US residents: In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Imagine yourself...
  • Leading high-impact, global transactions that help shape Veralto’s long-term growth.
  • Partnering with executive and cross-functional leaders from deal evaluation through integration.
  • Joining a purpose-led company where your work supports a safer, cleaner, more sustainable future.
At Veralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it is a proven path toward positive change for our planet and development for yourself.
Whether we are helping ensure the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, our work contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future.
When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 14 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a culture where purpose meets possibility and where you can deepen your expertise, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.
We offer:
  • Remote position (working in EST or CST Time Zone)
  • Ongoing investment in your career through training, on-the-job development, and coaching.
  • Paid holidays and a permissive paid time off policy emphasizing flexibility and trust.
  • Total rewards that support success at work and beyond, including comprehensive health benefits, a 401(k) savings plan with employer match, and associate wellbeing programming with rewards.

About the role

Reporting to the Corporate Secretary and Vice President, M&A, Securities & Governance, with strong partnership to the SVP, Corporate Development, the Director, Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) and Assistant Corporate Secretary supports the legal execution of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments, and other strategic transactions that advance Veralto’s long-term growth agenda.
As a member of the M&A legal team, you will combine strategic guidance with hands-on execution across the full M&A lifecycle, helping ensure disciplined execution, thoughtful risk management, and alignment with Veralto’s purpose.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Help architect and execute public and/or private M&A transactions across global markets, including acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic minority investments.
  • Coordinate cross-functional due diligence and identify material legal, operational, and regulatory risks across contracts, intellectual property, compliance, labor, environmental, and sector-specific matters.
  • Lead negotiation of LOIs, NDAs, purchase agreements, transition services agreements, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Manage outside counsel to support excellent execution, cost effectiveness, and strategic alignment.
  • Advise Corporate Development and executive leadership on deal strategy, risk allocation, structural alternatives, regulatory matters, and integration implications.
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, HR, Compliance, and segment leaders on transaction structuring, working capital, indemnities, target-company compliance, and long-term integration impacts.
  • Support subsidiary governance, global entity maintenance, delegated authorities, treasury and financing activities, investor communications, ESG and sustainability-related activities, as needed.
  • Drive continuous improvement across M&A playbooks, templates, and processes, while mentoring junior attorneys and strengthening organizational M&A capabilities.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree and active bar membership in the United States or United Kingdom.
  • 10+ years of experience leading complex M&A transactions at a major law firm (AmLaw 100) and/or a global corporate legal department (Fortune 500).
  • Deep expertise in corporate law, cross-border public and/or private M&A, and complex transaction negotiation.
  • Demonstrated experience advising senior executives on high-stakes matters and leading multiple concurrent transactions and workstreams.
  • Experience with global regulatory assessments, including antitrust and industry-specific frameworks.

It would be a plus if you also possess:

  • Experience advising industrial or technology-oriented companies, including manufacturing, water, consumer packaged goods, pharmaceutical, environmental services, technology, or other regulated sectors.
  • Experience supporting public company governance, capital markets transactions, corporate secretary activities, or subsidiary management.
  • Familiarity with public company obligations under the Securities Act of 1933, the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and NYSE Listing Standards.

About Veralto

With annual sales of $5.5 billion, Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with a proven track record of solving some of society’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading companies and globally recognized brands build on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.
Veralto’s Water Quality companies manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply. Our Product Quality & Innovation companies protect food, medicine, and other essentials by tracking and authenticating goods across the global supply chain. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, with 300+ locations worldwide.

Veralto Corporation and all Veralto Companies are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law. We value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

The EEO posters are available here.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

jobs.title: Head of Data and Analytics
jobs.excerpt: At Novakid, we’re building one of the world’s most engaging online English-learning platforms for kids.
jobs.description:
At Novakid, we’re building one of the world’s most engaging online English-learning platforms for kids. Today, we serve 100,000+ students and work with 4,000 + teachers across 15+ countries.

We’ve already proven the demand. Now we’re scaling the platform, expanding AI-driven learning experiences, and rethinking how our backend should evolve for the next stage of growth.

This is where you come in.

About the Role

Novakid is hiring a Head of Data & Analytics to lead the next stage of our analytics evolution — transforming a strong existing foundation into a modern, AI-enabled decision system that scales with the business.

This is a strategic leadership role with broad scope: you'll own the analytics organization, the technology transformation, data science, and the data culture across the company. You won't be starting from scratch — you'll be accelerating a transformation already underway.

What You'll Lead

Analytics Strategy & Operating Model Define how data and analytics supports growth, product development, commercial performance, and operations. Shape what is self-serve, AI-assisted, automated, and expert-led.

Analytics Team Leadership Lead a team of analysts embedded across product squads and business functions. Raise the bar on speed, strategic impact, and self-service enablement while keeping analysts focused on the highest-value work.

AI-Powered Analytics Scale practical AI use cases: natural-language data access, AI-assisted insight generation, anomaly detection, automated reporting, and productivity tooling for analysts and stakeholders.

Experimentation & A/B Testing Strengthen Novakid's experimentation culture — making it faster and easier to design, launch, measure, and learn from experiments without heavy analyst involvement at every step.

Data Science Build a structured, high-impact data science capability spanning ML for business use cases, forecasting, experimentation support, AI-powered product features, and research for new learning experiences.

Metric Governance & Data Foundation Drive clearer KPI ownership, stronger documentation, and a trusted semantic layer across Product, Growth, Sales, Marketing, and Finance — reducing ambiguity and conflicting interpretations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Faster turnaround on common business questions and broader stakeholder self-service

  • A modern AI-enabled analytics capability adopted across the company

  • A stronger experimentation practice with less dependency on analyst bandwidth

  • Clear KPI ownership and trusted, well-documented data

  • A well-structured data science function supporting both business and product innovation

  • Strong executive confidence in data-driven decision-making

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in analytics, BI, or data functions within high-growth digital businesses

  • Proven track record transforming analytics toward scalable, self-serve, AI-enabled models

  • Strong technical grounding in modern data stacks, cloud warehouses (we use BigQuery), BI tooling, and semantic modeling

  • Hands-on SQL fluency and solid understanding of analytics engineering principles

  • Experience leading or reshaping embedded analyst teams

  • Practical, hands-on experience applying AI in analytics at scale

  • Experience building or rebuilding a data science function spanning business support and product features

What we offer…

  • Fully remote work

  • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education.

  • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products.Unlimited holidays – because we trust you to deliver.

  • Bonuses and stock options – we grow together

Category: Legal

Welcome to The Freelance Firm!

We are a national network of experienced, high-level, freelance attorneys and paralegals who provide remote, on-demand support for both short-term and long-term legal projects for our client law firms.

Due to increased demand, we are now interviewing for a qualified, experienced, and dedicated Elder Law & Litigation Paralegal to provide ongoing remote support to a West Virginia law firm.

Remote work hours will vary, but are expected to be approximately 10+ hours per week to start, with strong potential for growth. The client is specifically seeking one dedicated paralegal who can provide both substantive litigation support and assistance with paperwork-driven elder law matters and client communications.

Paralegal Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of law firm experience as a Paralegal
  • Strong, direct litigation paralegal experience
  • Litigation experience in elder law, probate, personal injury, or general civil litigation will be considered
  • Ability to provide litigation support including court filings, reviewing and organizing case materials, corresponding with opposing counsel, and proactively keeping matters moving
  • Experience assisting with procedural aspects of active litigation matters
  • Ability and willingness to handle both substantive litigation assignments and more routine paperwork and forms
  • Experience completing forms and documentation associated with non-litigation matters
  • Comfortable communicating directly and professionally with clients
  • Strong organizational and case-management skills with the ability to independently track assignments and deadlines

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work product

The client specifically needs one versatile paralegal who can handle the full range of work, rather than someone interested only in higher-level litigation assignments. Our Paralegal pay rate starts at $30/hour.

jobs.title: Egocentric Video Data Contributor
jobs.excerpt: About PerlePerle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Imagine earning extra money without changing a thing about your day. No second shift, no commute, no time away from the work or the life you already have. You film what you are already doing, and you get paid for it.

Perle is building the data that teaches AI and robotics how real people move, work, and get things done. To do that, we need video recorded from a first-person point of view: the world as you see it, through a small camera mounted on a lightweight headstrap. We are looking for contributors across the US, Canada, and Latin America to capture everyday footage and turn their ordinary routines into real income.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

The role is simple: you wear a headstrap with your phone, press record, and go about your day. The footage is captured hands-free from your perspective, so you can keep both hands on whatever you are doing.

Contributors record everyday activities and real work. That includes things like:

  • Household life: doing tasks around the house, cooking, cleaning, organizing, repairs, and other daily routines.
  • On the job: filming while you do your actual job, whether you work in manufacturing, roofing, construction, a restaurant kitchen, a warehouse, or any other hands-on trade.
  • Everyday activities: the small, ordinary moments that make up a normal day, captured naturally as they happen.

There is no script and no acting. The whole point is authentic, real footage of real life. If you can do your job and your daily tasks, you can do this.

Why This Is Worth Your Time

  • Earn while you already work: Record while you work or while you handle things at home. Your day does not change; you just capture it.
  • Total flexibility: There are no fixed shifts. You decide when to record and how much. The more quality footage you submit, the more you earn.
  • Real, steady income: Pay is competitive and varies by region. You are compensated for every hour of accepted footage you deliver.
  • We cover your gear: Perle provides a budget to purchase the headstrap you need to get started, so the equipment is covered.
  • Be part of the future: The work you submit helps train the next generation of AI and robotics. Your everyday routine becomes part of something much bigger.

What You'll Need

  • Location: You must be based in the United States, Canada, or a Latin American country. This role is open to these regions only.
  • Age: You must be 18 years or older.
  • A supported phone: You need one of the following: iPhone 11 or newer, Google Pixel 6 or newer, or Samsung Galaxy S21 or newer. A supported phone is required to capture footage.
  • Willingness to wear a headstrap: You should be comfortable wearing a lightweight headstrap while you work or move around the house. Perle provides a budget so you can purchase one.
  • Around 10 hours a week: A minimum of 10 hours of recorded footage per week is preferred. You are free to record more, and consistency helps you earn more.

How It Works

Step 1 Apply and get approved

Submit your application and confirm you have a supported phone. Once you are approved, we will get you set up.

Step 2 Get your headstrap

We provide a budget to purchase the headstrap. You mount your phone, and you are ready to record hands-free.

Step 3 Record your day

Press record and go about your work and your routine. Capture at least 10 hours of footage a week, on your own schedule.

Step 4 Submit and get paid

Upload your footage through the app. Once it is reviewed and accepted, you are paid for every hour delivered.

Your Data Is Safe With Us

Everything you record is submitted through a dedicated app, which is built to be fully compliant and private. Your footage is encrypted and handled securely from the moment you upload it.

  • One secure channel: Footage is submitted only through the official app. Nothing is shared publicly or posted anywhere.
  • Private by design: Your personal information and your recordings are protected and anonymised and not shared.
  • Fully compliant: The app follows strict data compliance and security standards, so your data stays secure at every step.

Ready to Start Earning?

If you are based in the US, Canada, or Latin America and you want to turn your everyday routine into extra income, we want to hear from you. Whether you are on a roof, in a kitchen, on a factory floor, or just getting things done at home, your day is worth something.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreHealthier Generation is a leading children’s health non-profit that promotes equitable whole child health so that every mind, every body, and every young person can be healthy.
jobs.companyName: Alliance for a Healthier Generation Inc.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Healthier Generation  is a leading children’s health non-profit that promotes equitable whole child health so that every mind, every body, and every young person can be healthy.  and ready to succeed.  We believe a dedicated, intensified movement that centers equity in health practices and policies wherever kids live, learn and play is required to achieve dramatic improvements in the health and the life outcomes of Black, Indigenous, People of Color, as well as communities experiencing deep poverty.

Healthier Generation works nationally and locally with schools and school districts, youth-serving organizations, businesses, and communities – building their capacity to create healthier environments where young people can thrive. Our work, in total, has reached more than 31 million children and meaningfully improved environments to support the physical, social, and emotional health of the next generation, especially those from underserved communities. Our programs are evidence-based and evidence-informed, supported by a robust digital/virtual/live training platform and action center, as well as direct-to-community services. Through Healthier Generation programs, products and services, more children nationwide are gaining the opportunity to build a healthy future.

What You Will Do

Core Responsibilities
Relationship Building and Partnership Engagement

  • Cultivate and maintain a portfolio of strategic relationships to increase awareness of and engagement with Healthier Generation initiatives, connect health and learning, and advance policies and practices that improve whole child health.

  • Identify key individuals working across the school community, who can serve as champions, to collaborate on whole child health initiatives that meet mutually established deliverables and goals.

  • Convene partners at the local, state, and/or national level to increase awareness and advocacy of, connection to, and collaboration on the integration of whole child health topics.

Project Management and Implementation

  • Facilitate coaching, consultation, technical assistance, and capacity-building for partners on HG tools, resources and best practices that support the implementation of whole child health initiatives.

  • Conduct activities that support continuous improvement with district and/or school leadership teams (e.g. support in building teams, data collection and assessment, data analysis and goal setting, action planning, and measuring impact of project goals).

  • Report project progress and results through formal and informal reporting procedures, including contributing to grant reports, providing project updates, and tracking progress using various technology systems, such as CRM (Customer Relationship Management) and Knowi.

  • Support the development, implementation, and/or promotion of org-wide initiatives (i.e. America’s Healthiest School Awards, Leaders’ Summit, etc.), leveraging it to elevate best practices and expand engagement across key health topics.

Stewardship

  • Write and/or promote success stories, best practices, exemplars, and lessons learned to highlight program and organizational impact.

  • Advance HG’s Culture of Philanthropy by serving as an ambassador for the organization by fostering relationships with mission-aligned partners and increasing brand awareness through verbal and digital communications.

  • In partnership with Programs leadership, support regional/national strategy and assist in the development of concepts and proposals as needed.

Required Competencies: Who You Are

You should have a genuine interest in and commitment to making kids’ lives healthier. You are a dedicated equity driven, solution-oriented professional who values community centered approach and systems-level change. Your ability to prioritize tasks, build internal and external relationships and be self-driven prepares you for this position.

Your professional experience will show that you demonstrate Healthier Generation’s competencies:

  • Mission driven: You are passionate about creating equitable environments for young people and believe every mind, every body, and every young person should be healthy and ready to succeed. You demonstrate passion for school and youth-serving organizations, health and wellness, quality standards and processes. 

  • We collaborate and support: You plan collaboratively; inviting others to brainstorm and contribute ideas. You share information and resources to ensure clarity and understanding. You offer differing perspectives, counterpoints, and ideas to improve outcomes. You support others to achieve goals by sharing expertise, skills, or resources.

  • We are aware of ourselves and others: You demonstrate self-awareness, self-management, social-awareness, and relationship management. You demonstrate understanding of and work to mitigate sources of bias. You recognize the ideas, contributions, and achievements of others. You elicit feedback and consider perspectives to understand the potential impacts of those affected by plans or decisions.

  • We think critically and act strategically: You ask questions to understand (ex: to gain clarity on roles and responsibilities, decision-making, project plans, etc.). You incorporate feedback in relevant areas (ex: processes, work products, or interpersonal relationships). You plan thoughtfully by seeking and incorporating applicable information (ex: research, feedback, evidence, experience, etc.). You assess risks and rewards, potential impacts, and alternative options when making strategic decisions.

  • We adapt and embrace change: You approach challenges with equanimity. You adapt to shifting priorities. You work to find solutions to identify problems or opportunities. You champion new ways to improve processes.

  • We build and cultivate relationships: You Acknowledges others’ experiences, identities, and strengths. You facilitate interactions that result in new or enhanced collaborations. You practice active listening to understand, takes time to process information, and check your own bias. You take responsibility to build and repair trust.

  • We grow and improve: You foster a “safe to fail” environment where mistakes are acknowledged and learned from. You seek and implement feedback to grow. You actively pursue professional development around diversity, inclusion, equity, belonging, and skills relevant to job responsibility area(s). You incorporate learnings (e.g., professional development, feedback, research, etc.) into work processes and outputs.

Education and Experience Requirements

  • 3 years of experience working in schools, public health, out-of-school time, or other youth environments.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant education and experience.

Other Requirements

  • Knowledge of public health systems, school health, or community-based programming preferred

  • Familiarity with grant compliance, evaluation frameworks, and outcome measurement

  • Experience working with cross-sector partners (e.g., government, education, healthcare, nonprofit organizations)

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 30%, as needed, to support program implementation, partner engagement, and organizational priorities

Compensation and Benefits

At Healthier Generation, we believe in a holistic approach to rewarding and supporting staff. We balance financial stability with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and unmatched schedule flexibility. Highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Flexible PTO

  • 100% remote work with a flexible work environment

  • Competitive health benefits program with employer contributions

  • Professional development and learning opportunities

  • 401(k) employer match of up to 4%, fully vested upon hire

  • Annual stipend of $1,500 (distributed per paycheck) to support communication and wellness needs

At Healthier Generation, each position is aligned with a salary grade determined by market data. The salary range for this position is $62,800 - $94,200. We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
  • 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
  • Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
  • #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
  • 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
  • Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to join our Elastic Platform Operations (EPO)/Managed Services team. In this role, you will lead and scale the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of modern data platforms for multiple enterprise customers, ensuring reliable delivery and continuous improvement of their cloud data environments. You will collaborate closely with client sponsors, technical stakeholders, and globally distributed delivery teams to drive high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. You will also play a key role in major incident response, process improvement, and the development of delivery best practices across our Managed Services portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery

  • Own and drive the delivery and operational excellence of modern data platforms (including streaming, data lakes, and analytics) for multiple customer accounts.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into actionable Epics, Stories, and Tasks that mature and improve customer data platforms while aligning to phData methodologies and best practices.
  • Ensure engagements are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, with clear measures of success and value for customers.
  • Lead and motivate client technical teams, providing hands-on technical leadership for design, implementation, and ongoing operational support of cloud data platforms.
  • Provide leadership during major incidents, ensuring effective coordination, communication, escalation, and follow-through to resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners including architects, engineers, and site reliability/operations teams in the US and India to deliver successful client engagements and seamless handoffs across time zones.
  • Develop strong relationships with sponsors and stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and outcomes, hosting leadership discussions, and identifying opportunities to expand the value of our services.
  • Ensure teams are trained and prepared to deliver by driving accurate process documentation, clear internal and external communication, and continuous readiness for production operations.
  • Maintain proper staffing levels across accounts, balancing delivery between US and India team members to support continuous delivery and high customer satisfaction.

Practice & Firm Contribution

  • Deliver feedback and drive improvements to our overall Managed Services offerings through process optimization, knowledge sharing, and creation of accelerators and reusable assets.
  • Champion phData’s core values and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within delivery teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of best practices for incident management, change management, and modern data platform operations across multiple customers.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (Director and VP level), shaping roadmaps for cloud data platforms and influencing strategic decisions around data and analytics operations.
  • Mentor and coach architects, engineers, and operations team members, helping them grow technical depth and delivery capabilities across large and complex environments.
  • Help define and refine Managed Services standards, playbooks, and frameworks to support scalable growth across a broad customer base.

About You

You are a client-focused technical delivery leader who enjoys owning complex data platform operations, guiding teams through ambiguity, and building strong relationships with stakeholders. You are equally comfortable discussing architectural trade-offs with engineers and outcomes with business leaders, and you thrive in a remote, global, outcomes-driven environment.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical management, IT architecture, customer relationship management, project management, and/or delivery management, ideally within data, analytics, or infrastructure operations.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
  • Technical knowledge deploying and managing modern cloud data technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, Redshift, Matillion, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, Coalesce, and EMR (not all required but familiarity with several is expected).
  • Background in IT operations, infrastructure, or production support, including managing modern data platforms or data warehouses for multiple customers of various sizes.
  • Experience leading technical operations teams through multiple large or complex projects, including backlog creation (Epics, Stories, Tasks), prioritization, and delegation.
  • Experience scoping and planning large-scale, complex technology infrastructure or modern data platform initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ownership of incident and escalation processes, including coordination among technical teams, end-users, and stakeholders through resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.
  • Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) with demonstrated judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct AI-generated output.
  • Ability to describe specific engineering tasks completed with AI assistance.

Consulting / Delivery Skills

  • Experience delivering services for external or internal customers in a professional services, managed services, or similar client-facing environment, including direct interaction with global customers and business partners.
  • Ability to interact confidently with Director and VP level stakeholders, guiding discussions, building relationships, and communicating complex technical information in accessible ways (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
  • Proven experience coordinating across technical teams managing IT infrastructure services or modern data platforms for multiple customers concurrently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate with distributed, cross-functional teams across regions (e.g., US, LATAM, and/or India) and time zones.
  • Strong leadership skills with a professional track record of creating, challenging, and improving processes and procedures.
  • Highly organized, strategic thinker, and effective problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global teams and customers.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (degree preferred but not required).

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.

  • Experience managing IT or data operations/production support environments, including leading data warehouse, ML, or data engineering teams.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure Synapse in a multi-customer or managed services context.
  • Additional experience with tools such as Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, or Coalesce.
  • Prior experience in a consulting, managed services, or MSP-style environment supporting multiple enterprise customers.
  • Prior experience working in global or remote teams and partnering across US, LATAM, and/or India.
  • Demonstrated passion and curiosity for learning new technologies and staying current with technology trends to inform business strategy.
  • Contributions to internal accelerators, process improvements, or knowledge sharing initiatives are a plus.

Location & Time Zone Expectations

This role is based in the US and operates primarily in Central or Eastern US time zones, with regular collaboration with teams in India and across the Americas.

  • We are a remote-first company, and you should be comfortable working with a distributed global team.
  • Some flexibility may be required to collaborate across time zones with colleagues and clients.
  • Client needs may occasionally require flexibility in working hours and willingness to travel for client visits, team workshops, and strategic planning sessions.

Why phData?

  • Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data & AI initiatives.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways.
  • Values-Driven: We prioritize doing the right thing for our clients, our teams, and our community.

Benefits at phData

US:

  • Remote-First Work Environment
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Home Office Equipment Stipend
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Competitive comp, excellent benefits, 4 weeks PTO plan plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks)

phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at People Operations.

jobs.excerpt: Who You AreYou are a sales superstar - driven by the thrill of connecting new customers with a transformative SaaS platform that will revolutionize how their events are built and managed.
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a sales superstar - driven by the thrill of connecting new customers with a transformative SaaS platform that will revolutionize how their events are built and managed. You’re an avid fan of events and know the power of bringing the right solution to the right audience. You know intrinsically that developing authentic relationships is an integral part of sales and your approach to selling is equal parts strategic, curious, and customer-first.

You bring sharp communication skills, a deep love for event tech, and the kind of prioritization that keeps deals moving. With experience in SaaS and event technology sales, you know how to identify, develop, and close large-scale opportunities. You get that the best salespeople aren’t just closers—they’re thoughtful listeners, creative problem-solvers, and trusted partners throughout the customer journey.

You are also looking for personal and professional growth within the SaaS/Event Technology space. You are proactive, thrive on the hunt, keep your eye on the target, and never miss a detail. You are a team-player with an individualistic streak, and are the Bob Ross of sales (no mistakes, just happy accidents!).

About the Role

As our Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for helping us achieve our long-term strategy of driving our customer growth and pursuing new business opportunities.

We’re a highly focused, fully remote event marketing software company. Our clients expect us to be an events industry thought leader, always on the edge of new ideas with an unconventional viewpoint.

Every day will look a little different, but in general, you will do things like:

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles with senior stakeholders at existing and prospective Enterprise clients.
  • Be viewed as a trusted advisor by providing compelling insights and ideas that solve our customers business problems/pain points.
  • Proactively generate pipeline through strategic prospecting outbounding, including cold calls, personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and creative multi-touch sequences designed to open new enterprise doors.
  • Manage, effectively communicate and report your sales forecast on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. Accurately communicate upside and downside risk to your called number.
  • Create territory and account plans that accurately map your highest propensity to buy targets and the strategy to win these targets.
  • Drive collaboration across departments and teams, including Sales Development, Account Management, Product Enablement, and Customer Success, to ensure a cohesive customer journey.
  • Qualify, demo, and negotiate with prospects leveraging the sales qualification methodologies using MEDDICC/SPICED.
  • Consistently meet or exceed your monthly, quarterly and annual targets.
  • Lead a consultative sale by becoming an expert in both the events industry and the Swoogo product.
  • Collaborate and co-sell products within Swoogo’s partner ecosystem by developing. strong partnership relationships and consulting customers on their full event tech stack.
  • Travel to meet with enterprise prospects and customers, attend key industry events, and represent Swoogo at in-person meetings and tradeshows (estimated 25–40% travel, depending on territory needs).

What You’ve Done Before

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience
  • 2 - 3+ years of SaaS Sales experience
  • 2+ years working with Enterprise prospects
  • 3+ years sourcing and qualifying prospects through various outbound methods
  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Proficient in Sales Forecasting
  • Experience in leading CRM adoption and improvement by showcasing exceptional Salesforce hygiene
  • Previous experience with independently crafting complex sales MAPs, proposals, and order forms
  • Consistently demonstrates a thorough understanding of roles and responsibilities within an organization by building multi-threaded relationships throughout the deal cycle

It’d Be Great If You’ve Done This

  • 1+ year in events or event technology
  • Understanding of the events industry
  • Formal training on SPICED

Benefits, & How We Work

Learn moreabout Swoogo, how we work, and ourPerks & Benefits.

Swoogo is committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, sexual harassment, and all forms of abusive conduct. We do not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind—whether committed by managers, peers, clients, or vendors. We strictly comply with all applicable employment laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), and the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA).

jobs.title: Founding Games Engineer - Roblox - B2B
jobs.excerpt: Job Location: remote from Romania Budget: 30-40 euro/h Recruitment process:• HR discussion • Technical interview Role description: Our client is a new company building technology that syncs real-world live sporting event data (motion and positional data) with gaming environments in real time, so players can experience live moments as they unfold within the game.
jobs.description:
Job Location: remote from Romania

Budget: 30-40 euro/h

Recruitment process:

  • HR discussion
  • Technical interview

Role description:

Our client is a new company building technology that syncs real-world live sporting event data (motion and positional data) with gaming environments in real time, so players can experience live moments as they unfold within the game. The initial focus is sport and Roblox, with plans to expand into other entertainment and gaming platforms down the line.

  • You will lead the game-side development, initially within Roblox.
  • You will take real-time data from our external processing architecture and turn it into responsive, synchronised characters and experiences inside the game.
  • This is a hands-on founding role with real ownership. You'll help shape the technical direction of the product as well as build it.

What you'll work on:

  • Build and own the company's Roblox integration
  • Develop the systems that turn live motion and positional data into gameplay
  • Build character animation, movement and synchronisation systems
  • Develop robust client-server architecture for live experiences
  • Optimise performance across players, characters and live data
  • Work closely with our real-time systems engineer to define the interface between the company and the game
  • Help shape future integration SOPs across Roblox games and other gaming platforms
  • Contribute to technical decisions, documentation and future engineering hires

What we're looking for:

  • You are an experienced games engineer who understands both gameplay and the systems underneath it.
  • More importantly, you genuinely love games and care about the experience layer. You are interested in how technology translates into something that feels responsive, intuitive and fun for the player.
  • You should have strong experience with:
    • Roblox Studio and Luau
    • Multiplayer and client-server game architecture
    • Character, movement or animation systems
    • Performance optimisation
    • Integrating external systems or data into games
  • Experience with live data, procedural animation, motion capture, sports games or other game engines would be particularly useful.
  • We care more about the problems you have solved and your ability to learn than whether your previous technology stack exactly matches ours.

The kind of person we're looking for:

  • You should enjoy difficult technical problems, be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and be willing to challenge our assumptions when there is a better solution.
  • You should also be comfortable working directly with founders, external technology partners and other engineers.
  • We want someone who is excited by the opportunity to help build not only the product, but the engineering culture and team around it.
  • Over time, this role has the potential to grow from Roblox engineering into broader games platform development and technical leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Solid understanding of multiplayer and client-server game architecture.
  • Experience building character animation, movement, and synchronization systems.
  • Strong performance optimization skills for real-time applications.
  • Experience integrating external APIs or real-time data feeds into game engines.
  • Ability to work effectively in a small, fast-paced startup team.
  • Preferred proficiency in Roblox Studio and Luau.
  • Preferred experience with procedural animation, motion capture, or other game engines (Unity, Unreal).

jobs.excerpt: About UsQuantified Health is a virtual healthcare provider specializing in menopause care.
jobs.description:
About Us

Quantified Health is a virtual healthcare provider specializing in menopause care. We're expanding into Australia for the first time, and this is a brand new position as we build our presence in the market. We're committed to providing compassionate, comprehensive, and convenient care to women navigating this important life transition.

Who We Hope to Find

We're seeking a skilled and empathetic Medical Doctor to join our team as a founding physician for our new Australian clinic. The ideal candidate will be passionate about women's health, comfortable with virtual care delivery, and excited to help shape a brand new service from the ground up.

In This Role, You'll Make an Impact By:

  • Conducting expert virtual consultations for menopause assessments. Our triage system ensures you'll see appropriate cases, allowing you to focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care.
  • Delivering comprehensive follow ups for menopause related concerns, ensuring continuity of care and patient satisfaction. We require a minimum of 1 to 2 follow ups to optimize continuity of care.
  • Crafting personalized treatment plans tailored to each patient's unique needs. To support you, we offer evidence based care protocols and customizable template notes, streamlining your workflow without compromising on quality.
  • Prescribing and managing menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) and other treatments, staying at the forefront of menopause care.
  • Empowering patients through education on lifestyle modifications and self care strategies, helping them take control of their menopause journey.
  • Collaborating seamlessly with our dedicated physician team. Complex cases can be easily reviewed with our on call physicians or referred to specialists, ensuring you always have expert backup.
  • Enjoying the benefits of our state of the art intake process. Patients complete comprehensive forms (e.g. past medical history, screening form, etc) before their appointments, providing you with relevant information upfront. This allows you to maximize your time on what matters most: providing top notch care and counselling.

We Need Someone Who Has:

  • Current registration as a medical practitioner with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).
  • A valid Medicare provider number (or eligibility to obtain one).
  • Current professional indemnity insurance valid in Australia (e.g. Avant, MDA National, or MIGA).
  • Proficiency in virtual care delivery and telehealth platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills and a patient centered approach.
  • Familiarity with EMR systems, or willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

It Would Also Be Great If You Have (Optional, Not Required):

  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), or equivalent specialist qualification.
  • Interest, specialized training, or certification in menopause management.
  • At least 1 to 2 years of experience in women's health, general practice, or a related field.
  • Experience with menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) is an asset.
  • Interest in contributing to clinic growth and service expansion as we establish our presence in Australia.

Why You Should Join Us:

  • The opportunity to help launch and shape a new clinic as we enter the Australian market.
  • Specialize in an important and often underserved area of women's health.
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your lifestyle.
  • Collaborative team environment with supportive physician leadership.
  • Chance to shape the future of virtual menopause care in Australia.

What We're Offering:

  • Competitive rate.
  • Flexible scheduling.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Chance to make a meaningful difference in women's lives.

Compensation:

  • Contract position (minimum of 10 hours per week).
  • Part time or full time.
  • Flexible hours based on candidate availability.
  • Compensated on a per assessment basis, depending on complexity of patient.

Apiphani is a technology-enabled managed services company dedicated to redefining what it means to support mission-critical enterprise workloads. We’re a small but rapidly growing company, which means there’s lots of room for growth and learning opportunities abound!

Apiphani is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all as a fundamental component of our business. Diversity and inclusion are the bedrock of creativity and innovation. Without diversity of experience and thought, we would fail to progress as a company and as a team. Apiphani strives to foster an environment of belonging, where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered. We embrace the unique experiences, perspective, and cultural background, which only you can bring to the table.

SAP Innovation Architect — Agentic AI Platform

Location: Remote | Full-time | Competitive Compensation

At Apiphani, we’re building the future of intelligent infrastructure automation through Luumen, our agentic AI platform designed to automate, secure, and optimize enterprise IT environments.

We’re looking for an experienced SAP Innovation Architect to help shape the next generation of SAP automation and AI-driven operations. This role combines deep SAP technical expertise with a visionary mindset — someone who can connect the realities of SAP landscapes with the potential of intelligent automation.

You’ll help design, build, and evolve SAP-centric automations and features that solve real-world enterprise challenges across Basis, Security, and functional domains.

What You’ll Do

Automation & Development

  • Design and build SAP automations that streamline operations and reduce manual effort across Basis, Security, and functional processes

  • Maintain and evolve Luumen’s ABAP role and supporting assets as new SAP features and functions are introduced

  • Collaborate with Luumen’s engineering team to ensure SAP integrations are scalable, resilient, and secure

  • Develop prototypes that validate automation workflows and support production-grade deployment

Product Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to expand Luumen’s SAP-centric capabilities and translate them into product features

  • Serve as the SAP subject-matter expert for the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with ECC, S/4HANA, and Cloud ERP initiatives

  • Prototype and validate new use cases that leverage AI/ML within SAP landscapes

  • Work with product leadership to define requirements for SAP agents, connectors, and observability features

Support & Enablement

  • Provide advanced technical support for SAP-related product issues escalated by internal or customer teams

  • Mentor junior engineers and share best practices for SAP automation and monitoring

  • Partner with presales and customer success teams to demonstrate SAP-related functionality in client engagements

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, reference architectures, and knowledge-sharing resources

Thought Leadership & Vision

  • Stay ahead of SAP roadmap developments and industry trends to anticipate customer needs and shape Luumen’s product direction

  • Act as a trusted advisor internally and externally on SAP architecture, automation, and cloud transformation

  • Represent Luumen through blogs, webinars, and events — positioning the platform as a leader in SAP and AI-driven operations

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of hands-on SAP experience, including Basis administration, ABAP development, and SAP integrations

  • Strong understanding of SAP Security (roles, authorizations, and compliance considerations)

  • Proven experience with S/4HANA migrations, Cloud ERP, or RISE with SAP initiatives

  • Demonstrated success designing scalable, reliable, and innovative SAP solutions

  • Ability to bridge SAP technical depth with AI and automation strategy

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify and convey complex ideas to technical and business audiences

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in a SaaS or software product organization influencing product strategy

  • Exposure to AI/ML applications within enterprise IT or operations

  • Familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, and managed services delivery models

  • Background in presales or solution architecture with direct customer engagement

  • Passion for mentoring and cross-functional collaboration

Why Join Apiphani

You’ll join a global, high-performing team redefining how enterprises manage SAP systems through intelligent automation. This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and strategy behind Luumen’s SAP capabilities — driving innovation at the intersection of AI, automation, and enterprise operations.

At Apiphani, your expertise won’t just maintain systems — it will help reimagine how SAP runs in the age of agentic AI.

Base Salary
€95.000—€130.000 EUR

Company Benefits*

  • Medical/dental/vision - 100% paid for employees, 50% paid for dependents
  • Life and disability - 100% paid for employees
  • 401K - 3% contribution, no employee contribution necessary
  • Education and tuition reimbursement
  • Accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity benefits offered through our providers
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Legal assistance
  • Paid Time Off - up to 6 weeks per year
  • Sick Leave - up to 2 weeks per year
  • Parental Leave - up to 12 weeks

*Benefits listed in the job description apply to employees working in the United States. For international employees, Apiphani partners with an Employer of Record, Deel, and provides all statutory benefits required under local law; certain U.S.-specific programs (such as EAP, legal assistance, etc.) may not be available outside the United States. The specific benefits package will be outlined in the local employment agreement issued through Deel.

For the Bankrate website click here. Curious how Bankrate fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

Bankrate is rebuilding itself with AI at the center. The AI Transformation Office exists to make that real, not as a slide deck but as running software. We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed directly with our business teams and ship the AI systems that change how Bankrate operates. Your clients are internal: Human Resources, Marketing, and Commercial. Your job is to walk into their workflows, find the highest-leverage problems, and build the agents, tools, and integrations that solve them. You report to the Head of AI Transformation. This is an individual-contributor role for a builder, not a manager.

This is not a role for people who want to build software for fun. It's for people who want to solve real business problems and fundamentally change how a company operates. Demos don't count. Prototypes that die in a sandbox don't count. What counts is the workflow running on Monday morning, the business outcome it drives, and the team that can't imagine going back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Embed and ship. Sit with a business team, learn how they actually work, and build the AI system that changes it. You own the problem end to end: architecture, code, deploy, and the relationship with the people who use what you build. Nothing gets handed off. A few problems in flight to give you a sense of the work:
    • Autonomous Customer Support Agents that resolve tier-1 issues on their own and escalate to humans only where judgment is required.
    • Automated AI Training Pathways that give every Bankrate employee a personalized route to fluency, built once and scaled across the company.
    • Paid Media Optimization Agents that watch spend, test creative, and reallocate budget faster than any human team could
  • Build net-new and integrate. Some problems need software that doesn't exist yet. Others need AI wired into the systems we already run. You'll do both, and you'll know which one the moment calls for.
  • Move fast and fail faster. You prototype in hours, put things in front of real users in days, and kill what isn't working without ego. Speed is the strategy. The landscape shifts under you and you keep up.
  • Operate with the full agentic toolkit. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), AI APIs, vector databases, prototyping platforms (v0, Lovable, Replit), and automation layers (Zapier, n8n). You reach for whatever gives you leverage, including tools that shipped last week.
  • Design agents that hold up in production. Reliable, auditable, and keeping humans in the loop where they belong. The work has to run when you're not in the room.
  • Compound the wins. What you learn on one engagement becomes the pattern every other engagement inherits. You make the whole office better, not just your own project

What We’re Looking For:

  • 2 to 8 years building and shipping. You've put production software in front of real users and owned the consequences. Where you trained matters less than what you've shipped.
  • AI-native to the core. You already build with agents, AI tools, and APIs as a default, not an experiment. This is how you work, not something you're curious about.
  • Problem-solver first. You're energized by a messy business problem, not a clean spec. You want to change how a company operates, and code is your means, not the point.
  • High agency, high urgency. You don't wait for permission or perfect requirements. You find the leverage, build, ship, and iterate.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity. You get productive in unfamiliar systems and domains without much hand-holding, and you bring structure where there's none.
  • A real collaborator. You work shoulder to shoulder with non-technical business teams, translate their problems into systems, and bring them along so what you build actually gets used.
