jobs.description:
About Easy Dynamics Corporation

Easy Dynamics designs, builds, and secures the systems that protect our people, places, and way of life. We are a trusted advisor delivering best-in-class technology solutions in Digital Identity, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management. Our teams combine engineering excellence with a disciplined, forward-leaning approach to solve our clients' hardest technical challenges. We bring our “East Coast address, West Coast attitude” to everything we do, combining mission focus with our innovative, collaborative, and flexible culture that puts people first. Our subject matter experts work at the cutting edge of cybersecurity and technology, delivering identity management, zero trust, cloud, and security automation solutions that directly impact critical government missions. We believe the best work happens when talented people have the freedom and support to do what they do best.

We don't run on rigid hierarchy or playbooks that are locked in once and expected to work for the rest of time. We're a company of self-starters who take ownership without being asked twice and treat ambiguity as room to run rather than a roadblock. Our practice is growing quickly, and our structure stays deliberately light so ideas can move fast and the people closest to the work have real say in how it gets done. Every role comes with an opportunity to help shape how we deliver impact for both our clients and our team.

Growth isn't a perk here, it's an expectation we hold for ourselves and for each other. We build in the time and support for our people to keep sharpening their professional skills, because the technology we work in doesn't sit still and neither should we. Across our practice, we're putting AI to work in deliberate, high-trust ways, from surfacing patterns in client requirements to accelerating process and quality analysis, so our teams can spend their time and judgment on the problems that actually need it. We invest in our people's growth because it's how we stay ahead of the mission and how our teams keep getting better at what they do.

About the role

We're looking for a Capture Manager to own the strategy, positioning, and competitive shaping of our pursuits from qualification through submission and award. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on figuring out how we win, and who is also comfortable picking up a pen to help draft proposal content when a pursuit needs an extra set of hands.

We're a small, lean business, and we don't run a traditional, Shipley-defined capture organization with rigid lane boundaries between capture and proposal roles. Instead, your specific responsibilities will be assigned per pursuit based on team capacity and what that opportunity needs. On one pursuit you might be the strategy owner directing a separate Management Volume writer; on the next, you might be the Management Volume or Past Performance writer yourself while someone else owns the win strategy; on another, you might be brought in solely as a reviewer to pressure-test win themes and technical soundness. Each pursuit's kickoff will name your specific role, and expectations will be set explicitly rather than assumed.

This is a blended capture/proposal role by design. You'll need the strategic instincts of a capture lead, the working knowledge of a proposal writer, and the flexibility to move between those functions as staffing and opportunity size require. Many capture roles stop at strategy and hand off to a proposal team for execution, in a fixed lane that never changes pursuit to pursuit. This one doesn't. You'll move between owning the win strategy, writing the volumes that carry it, and reviewing someone else's work, depending on what each pursuit needs and who else is available. If you want a role that flexes with a lean, fast-moving team rather than a rigid title, this is built for you.

What you'll do

The activities below span the full range of what this role covers across a fiscal year. Which of these you're doing on any given pursuit depends on your assignment for that pursuit (see above), not a fixed job lane.

Lead Capture Efforts (Qualification through Award)

  • Take ownership of the pursuit at BD-to-Capture handoff and maintain the Capture Deck as the central strategy artifact,
  • Brief Senior leadership at deal reviews on opportunity status and bid/no bid decisions
  • Coordinate subcontractor and teaming partner engagement for the pursuit (scope splits, past performance contributions, staffing)
  • Develop price-to-win in coordination with the Pricing Lead and Executive Team
  • Lead customer intelligence gathering and pursuit question strategy
  • Coach technical teams through win theme development and validate that the capture/win strategy is fully set before Proposal Development begins
  • Lead pre-RFP strategy validation (“Blue Team”) sessions and build initial storyboard templates

Ensure Strategy Integrity Through Proposal Development

  • Validate that win themes, discriminators, and competitive positioning are actually landing in the written volumes, not just present in the capture plan
  • Participate in color team reviews (Pink/Red/Gold) with specific responsibility for evaluating strategic and competitive strength of the draft
  • Flag any evaluation-response or clarification content that would change technical, pricing, or strategic commitments
  • Draft Management Volume content, including staffing narratives, management approach, and BOE labor inputs, in coordination with the Solution Architect / Technical Team's staffing model
  • Draft or contribute to Past Performance narratives, tailoring selected references to the specific opportunity's win themes
  • Support Proposal Manager-led kickoff, volume assignments, and compliance reviews as a working contributor, not just a strategy reviewer

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in capture management, business development, or proposal management within the federal contracting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build and defend a win strategy, not just manage a schedule
  • Working proficiency in proposal writing, specifically Management Volume and Past Performance content;
  • Comfort operating across the full pursuit lifecycle, from qualification through post-award transition
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, working closely with Business Development, Proposal Management, Solution Architects, Contracts, Pricing, and Delivery
  • Ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into a coherent, compelling narrative under deadline pressure
  • Project management experience
  • Comfortable using or learning CRM / pursuit-tracking tools (e.g., NextStage, GovWin, SAM.gov research)
  • Experience wearing both capture and proposal-writing hats on smaller pursuits or in a lean BD organization
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted document writing and proposal prompting
  • Prior experience with Basis of Estimate (BOE) inputs or cost-volume coordination
  • Someone who comes to the table with a point of view, not just looking to facilitate a process
  • An individual looking for a role that will require hard work to deliver high impact and high reward

Salary range: $160,000 - $190,000/year

If you are individual who is looking to roll up their sleeves and work with a team of technologists, managers and consultants who are smart, committed and focused on growth that aligns with mission and capabilities, this may be a great role for you. Easy Dynamics is a growing, tech-forward team of professionals who are committed to continuous improvement and evolving our capabilities and solutions to meet the market, the technological challenges and the missions we support.

Easy Dynamics is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
Social Media & Growth Coordinator

Employment Type: Full-time
Work Setup: Remote / Offshore
Location: Philippines
Schedule: Australian business hours, with overlap during AEST

About the Client

Our client is an Australia-based private equity and asset management firm focused on the lower-mid-market across Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia.

The business partners with founders and management teams, providing capital and strategic support to established businesses with opportunities for operational improvement, category expansion, and geographic growth. Its sector focus includes healthcare, wellness and beauty, consumer, and specialty retail.

The firm takes a disciplined, operator-led approach to investing, working closely with management teams and focusing on sustainable value creation, operational performance, and long-term growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Social Media & Growth Coordinator to manage social media, content, and local growth marketing across multiple brands and business verticals.

This is a full-time, dedicated role suited to a creative and commercially minded marketing professional who can take ownership of content from planning and creation through to publishing, community engagement, lead generation, and performance reporting.

You will work across multiple brands, audiences, and stakeholders, adapting content and communication styles while maintaining strong brand consistency. Beyond content execution, you will be expected to identify marketing gaps, build repeatable processes, and proactively recommend opportunities that can improve engagement, enquiries, bookings, and overall business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Content

  • Manage and maintain a consistent social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Develop and maintain monthly content calendars for each assigned brand.
  • Create and publish social media content, including feed posts, Stories, Reels, TikTok videos, and other short-form content.
  • Develop content that reflects each brand's unique tone, audience, positioning, and content pillars.
  • Repurpose existing marketing collateral and assets into engaging social and digital content.
  • Coordinate with business teams and relevant stakeholders to source photos, videos, promotions, events, and other content.
  • Maintain and regularly update Google Business Profiles, including photos, opening hours, posts, and Q&A.
  • Ensure content is timely, relevant, engaging, and aligned with business objectives.

Content Management & Organisation

  • Maintain a central content library using SharePoint, OneDrive, or an equivalent platform.
  • Organise content into clear categories such as raw photos/videos, team content, client content, products, events, UGC, promotions, content to be edited, ready-to-post content, and published content.
  • Review and organise content provided by business teams.
  • Select suitable content and transform it into polished marketing assets.
  • Regularly audit existing content to identify opportunities for reuse and repurposing.
  • Maintain an efficient workflow from content collection through to publication.

Brand & Creative Management

  • Create content using approved Canva brand kits, templates, colours, fonts, and logos.
  • Maintain consistent visual identity and messaging across all channels.
  • Adapt content appropriately for different brands, audiences, and platforms.
  • Ensure all content follows applicable brand, advertising, and compliance requirements.
  • Review relevant campaign and promotional materials and incorporate approved assets into local content strategies.
  • Ensure no unapproved artwork, filters, edits, or alterations are applied to branded or campaign assets.

UGC & Creator Partnerships

  • Identify and build relationships with relevant local content creators and influencers.
  • Research creators based on audience, engagement, location, platform, and brand relevance.
  • Maintain an organised creator database covering contact details, platforms, followers, engagement, location, offers, content received, and results.
  • Coordinate UGC opportunities and creator collaborations.
  • Build relationships with complementary local businesses for cross-promotions, giveaways, and collaborative content.
  • Organise and maintain creator- and partner-generated content for future use.

Local Events & Community Engagement

  • Identify relevant local events, markets, sporting activities, and community opportunities.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on agreed promotional events and activities.
  • Develop content before, during, and after local events.
  • Repurpose event content across multiple social media channels.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen local brand awareness and community engagement.

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate with relevant local partners and community organisations to maximise marketing opportunities.
  • Where applicable, liaise with shopping centres and other local partners regarding EDMs, newsletters, social media, digital screens, and promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate monthly promotions and campaigns for relevant local marketing opportunities.
  • Support the preparation of marketing artwork and promotional materials as required.

Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Develop and maintain a consistent process for encouraging positive customer feedback and public reviews.
  • Monitor relevant review platforms and identify opportunities to strengthen online reputation.
  • Repurpose strong customer reviews and testimonials into engaging social media content.
  • Create review-based content such as graphics, Reels, testimonial posts, and other social assets.
  • Support customer engagement and retention initiatives.

Paid Advertising

  • Set up and manage paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
  • Develop and test audiences, creatives, and campaign variations.
  • Manage advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
  • Optimise campaigns based on performance and business objectives.
  • Focus on measurable outcomes such as enquiries, leads, and bookings, rather than reach and impressions alone.
  • Use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.

Lead & Enquiry Management

  • Monitor dedicated enquiry inboxes and social media DMs.
  • Respond to and follow up on customer enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support the conversion of enquiries into bookings or other desired actions.
  • Track enquiry volume and conversion performance by brand and channel.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from social engagement through to conversion.

Monthly Content Planning

  • Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar for each assigned brand.
  • Plan content around upcoming campaigns, promotions, events, collaborations, product or service focuses, and other key marketing priorities.
  • Coordinate content requirements with relevant stakeholders in advance.
  • Ensure content is prepared and scheduled consistently across channels.

Reporting & KPIs

  • Prepare a simple monthly marketing and social media report for each assigned brand.
  • Track key performance indicators, including:
    • Follower growth
    • Reach
    • Engagement
    • Saves and shares
    • UGC activity
    • Creator and partnership activity
    • Review growth
    • Enquiries
    • Bookings
    • Conversion rates
    • Revenue, where measurable
  • Analyse performance to identify which activities are contributing to business results.
  • Make recommendations and adjust content and marketing activity based on performance insights.

Proactive Growth & Systems Building

  • Proactively identify gaps in current marketing, engagement, content, and reporting processes.
  • Research, test, and implement practical solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Identify tools and systems that could improve marketing efficiency and customer engagement.
  • Develop repeatable processes and workflows where none currently exist.
  • Bring forward ideas for new creator partnerships, local events, content opportunities, campaigns, and engagement initiatives.
  • Take ownership of building practical marketing solutions using available systems and tools.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of experience in social media management, content coordination, digital marketing, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
  • Strong experience creating social media content, including Reels and short-form video.
  • Experience planning and managing paid Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Understanding of audience testing, creative testing, campaign optimisation, and budget management.
  • Strong Canva skills with the ability to create polished, on-brand marketing materials.
  • Basic video editing skills for Reels, TikTok, and other short-form content.
  • Experience managing a shared content library and digital content workflow.
  • Experience with SharePoint or OneDrive is preferred.
  • Experience sourcing and managing influencers, UGC creators, or content partnerships is highly desirable.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands, audiences, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency.
  • Excellent written English and professional communication skills.
  • Experience working with a regulated or compliance-focused industry such as health, aesthetics, beauty, wellness, financial services, or professional services is highly regarded.
  • Previous experience supporting an Australian business or working in an offshore/BPO environment is an advantage.
  • Strong initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently research and implement solutions.

Systems & Tools

Experience with the following platforms and tools is preferred:

  • Canva
  • Microsoft 365
  • SharePoint / OneDrive
  • Google Business Profile
  • Meta Business Suite
  • Facebook / Instagram Ads Manager
  • TikTok Ads Manager
  • LinkedIn
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Social media scheduling and reporting platforms

Working Arrangements

  • Full-time, dedicated offshore position.
  • Remote work from the Philippines.
  • Working hours aligned with Australian business hours, with sufficient overlap during AEST for regular communication with stakeholders.
  • Australian public holidays are not required to be worked.
  • Regular check-ins with the client and relevant stakeholders.
  • This is a dedicated resource role, with the successful candidate focused exclusively on the assigned brands and business activities during working hours.

Why Join This Role?

  • Work with a growing Australian business across multiple brands and industries.
  • Take ownership of social media and growth marketing initiatives from strategy through execution.
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute directly to business growth.
  • Have the opportunity to build marketing systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Gain exposure to multiple brands, audiences, and growth initiatives.

Confidentiality & Compliance

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of company, brand, customer, and marketing information.
  • Follow all applicable advertising, content, and brand compliance requirements.
  • Handle customer enquiry and social media data responsibly.
  • Use authorised systems and platforms when handling company and customer information.
  • Maintain appropriate access controls for brand assets and customer data.
  • Ensure brand and customer information is not disclosed, copied, or retained outside authorised systems.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Data Security & Compliance

Say hello to opportunities.

It’s not every day that you consider starting a new career. We’re RingCentral, and we’re happy that someone as talented as you is considering this role. We invest more than $250 million annually to ensure our AI-enabled technology and platforms meet or exceed the needs of our customers.

AIR Pro is RingCentral’s agentic AI platform for enterprise voice and digital customer interactions. The platform enables organizations to automate customer experience conversations with measurable business outcomes. We have thousands of customers already running RingCentral AI products today. That install base is your deployment surface: real production traffic, real contact centers, real revenue on the line from day one.

This is where you and your skills come in. RingCentral is standing up a Forward-Deployed Engineering function. There is no playbook. You will help write it.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your time inside customer environments shipping production agentic AI systems: designing multi-turn voice and digital agents, building integrations to CRMs, EHRs, and ticketing systems, and instrumenting everything so outcomes are measurable.

You carry direct accountability for containment rates, handle-time reduction, and expansion, and you get the authority that goes with it: a defined escalation path into Product and Engineering, a standing mechanism for roadmap input based on what you hit in the field, and committed engineering support for platform blockers.

You will support pre-sales for your accounts (demos, POCs, technical scoping), and what you learn will shape how we hire, structure, and scale the FDE team. If you want a narrowly scoped lane, this isn't it. If you want to define a function inside a platform with a large enterprise base, it is.

Job Duties:

  • Own end to end strategic customer deployments. A focused portfolio, depth over breadth: discovery, workflow analysis (call routing, agent scripts, escalation paths, back-office handoffs), success criteria definition, production deployment, iteration, proven ROI, expansion.

  • Build production systems. Multi-turn agent workflows: prompt design, retrieval pipelines, decision logic, fallback handling, live-agent handoff. Integrations to customer systems of record. Guardrails and compliance controls (PII, HIPAA, PCI) fit to each environment.

  • Instrument everything. Deploy evaluation, monitoring, and testing frameworks so agent performance is continuously measured and improved. Success criteria are set before deployment, not reverse-engineered after.

  • Shape the platform. Your field findings feed roadmap prioritization directly. Document integration patterns, platform gaps, and recurring requirements with enough technical depth that Engineering can act on them.

  • Support the sale. Senior technical resource for your accounts pre-sales: live demonstrations, architectural conversations, proof-of-concept builds, deployment scoping alongside AEs and Sales Engineers. Turn pilot results into expansion cases.

The stack

You'll work directly with AIR Pro's agent orchestration layer, its APIs and integration framework, retrieval and knowledge tooling, and evaluation/observability infrastructure, plus whatever the customer runs (Salesforce, Epic, ServiceNow, custom APIs). You'll go deep on LLM behavior in production: prompt architecture, tool use, latency budgets for voice, failure modes, and evals.

Desired Qualifications:

Required

  • A strong engineer first. You write and ship production code (Python and/or TypeScript), build and debug API integrations independently, and have owned systems running in production. This is a hands-on-keyboard role.

  • 4+ years in customer-facing technical work where you personally built what was deployed: forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture with real implementation ownership, or technical consulting.

  • Working depth with LLMs in production: RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation. You've debugged why an agent fails, not just demoed one that works.

  • Communicates across the range: design reviews with engineers, business cases with executives, and difficult conversations with customers when a deployment needs to change course.

  • Thrives with incomplete information, competing priorities, and no one telling you what to do next.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military/work experience.

Preferred

  • Voice/telephony depth: SIP, WebRTC, SBCs, or CCaaS/UCaaS platform experience. Voice agents are harder than chat, and this is a voice-first platform.

  • Enterprise-scale agentic AI deployments, voice or digital.

  • Industry depth in healthcare, financial services, retail, or insurance.

  • Familiarity with the competitive conversational AI landscape.

Why this role

  • Founding-hire leverage. Everything you build (deployment methodology, eval standards, integration patterns, hiring bar) becomes how the team works. That's rare inside a public company with an existing enterprise base to deploy into.

  • No cold start. You are not hunting for design partners. Strategic customers are already under contract and waiting for exactly this function.

  • Product influence with teeth. Structured, committed feedback loop into Product and Engineering, not a suggestion box.

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits

  • Voluntary supplemental health coverage and life insurance

  • 401K match and ESPP

  • Paid time off and paid sick leave

  • Paid parental and pregnancy leave

  • Family-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.)

  • Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7

  • Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning

  • Employee bonus referral program

  • Student loan refinancing assistance

  • Employee 1:1 coaching, perks and discounts program

RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.

About RingCentral

More flexible and cost effective than legacy on-premises PBX and video conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral® empowers modern mobile and distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any device, and any location. RingCentral is headquartered in Belmont, California, and has offices around the world.

The role provides strategic guidance on how to develop a comprehensive software engineering AI strategy, prioritize high-value opportunities, and measure and communicate the impact of AI to drive ROI.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Proven software engineering leadership experience, having led large-scale, multi-team software delivery organizations with accountability for execution, quality and outcomes
  • Deep expertise in software engineering strategy and value measurement for AI, including roadmap planning, technology decision-making, performance assessment, metrics and ROI evaluation.
  • Hands-on expertise in AI-native software development, including embedding AI across the SDLC, leveraging AI to improve developer productivity and optimizing software delivery outcomes, and AI engineering to deliver AI applications and agents.
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Sr. Engineer II, Enterprise Intelligent Automation delivers and supports complex, end-to-end intelligent automation (IA), Agentic AI, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions across the enterprise. Operating with increasing independence and judgment, this role integrates standard workflow frameworks with advanced Cognitive AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and document processing engines to scale the organization's digital workforce, drive operational efficiency, and solve multi-factor business challenges.
  • Architect, configure, develop, and test production-grade Intelligent Automation (IA) and Agentic AI solutions by integrating generative AI tools and developer APIs (e.g., Google Gemini, Claude) with enterprise workflow platforms (e.g., N8N, Decisions, UiPath REFramework) to deliver highly reusable and maintainable automation assets.
  • Design, deploy, and support next-generation Agentic Automation workflows utilizing multi-agent collaboration, dynamic planning, and contextual reasoning with robust guardrails to handle non-deterministic and complex operational scenarios.
  • Provide technical consultation and conduct detailed feasibility studies on incoming automation requests from business units, recommending optimal automation patterns (e.g., deterministic RPA vs. Intelligent Document Processing vs. Agentic workflows) to ensure optimal solution design.
  • Partner with IT Security, Cloud Platform teams, and system administrators to maintain, scale, and secure virtual worker environments, orchestration instances, and API connectors in compliance with enterprise security baselines.
  • Lead structured code reviews for peer and offshore developers to enforce compliance with Center of Excellence (CoE) standards and security policies, continuously improving engineering quality and development postmortem processes.
  • Support, govern, and guide citizen developers across business units by establishing architectural guardrails and secure code library access, enabling safe and standardized department-level automation development.
  • Proactively monitor and tune production digital workers and agent environments to resolve complex exception patterns, system outages, or workflow failures, thereby minimizing business disruption.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and subject matter experts to analyze manual process flows, translate business requirements into technical designs, and demonstrate live automation capabilities during project reviews.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in Intelligent Automation (IA), and/or Agentic Automation (AA) development, implementation, and administration.
  • Hands-on experience using supporting programming and data languages, including Python, Microsoft .NET (C# or VB.NET), SQL, XML, and JSON.
  • Experience designing, configuring, and deploying Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions within enterprise environments.
  • Experience implementing cognitive AI integrations, custom API connections, or agentic frameworks to support dynamic decision-making in workflows.

License/Certification Required:

  • Advanced Automation certifications or other specialized Intelligent Automation / AI industry certifications (Decisions Orchestration Platform).
  • Advanced Industry Standard Coding certifications (Python, React, JavaScript) preferred.
  • Advanced AI industry certifications (Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, OpenAI Platforms) preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Enterprise automation and workflow orchestration platforms (e.g., UiPath, N8N, Decisions, WorkAuto) and emerging Agentic AI architectures. Automation design patterns, enterprise architectures, exception handling, and standard development frameworks (e.g., REFramework). Modern Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) under Agile methodologies. Relational database schemas, API integration techniques (REST/SOAP), and enterprise credential security protocols.
  • Skill in: Prompt engineering and technical configurations for LLMs (e.g., Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) to perform cognitive business tasks. Designing multi-system pipelines that smoothly ingest and transform structured and unstructured data assets. Guiding and mentoring citizen developers to safely deploy department-level workflows within established CoE guardrails. Presenting complex technical concepts, architectures, and product demonstrations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to: Translate manual, rule-based, and unstructured processes into resilient, self-healing automation code. Independently scope, project-manage, and execute components of larger automation projects from requirements intake through production launch. Define and implement robust human-in-the-loop (HITL) validation strategies for automated processes managing sensitive or regulated data (such as PII or PHI).

About Flosum

Flosum is the 100% Salesforce DevOps, security, and data management platform — built on Salesforce, for Salesforce. We help enterprise teams ship faster, stay compliant, and protect their metadata and data across the entire release lifecycle. As Salesforce DevOps becomes mission-critical in the Agentforce era, we're investing heavily in community, content, and developer love — and that's where you come in.

The Role

We're hiring a Salesforce DevOps Evangelist to be the public face and voice of Flosum across LinkedIn, YouTube, and the global Salesforce ecosystem. You will make Flosum famous by building an authentic personal brand, connecting deeply with developers, admins, and architects, and turning Salesforce DevOps best practices into content people can't stop sharing. If you live and breathe Salesforce DevOps, post about it daily, and love being on camera — this role was built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Create daily LinkedIn content — posts, carousels, polls, and short-form video — that drives conversation around Salesforce DevOps, metadata, Agentforce, and release management
  • Produce a steady stream of YouTube videos, livestreams, podcasts, and demo reels showing Flosum in action against real-world DevOps challenges
  • Speak at Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX, World Tours, community user groups, and partner webinars — owning the stage as Flosum's technical storyteller
  • Build hands-on demos and reference architectures that showcase Flosum's native CI/CD, backup, data masking, and Agentforce-ready workflows
  • Engage authentically with the Trailblazer Community — comment, collaborate, and amplify other voices in Salesforce DevOps
  • Partner with product and engineering to translate roadmap into compelling narratives, blogs, and launch campaigns
  • Mentor customers and prospects on source-driven development, branching strategies, and DevOps KPIs like deployment frequency and change failure rate
  • Represent the developer's voice internally — bring community feedback back to product to shape what we build next

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 5+ years hands-on Salesforce experience: Apex, LWC, Flow, Metadata API, SOQL
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce DevOps — CI/CD pipelines, Git source control, sandbox management, automated testing, and release orchestration
  • Working knowledge of Agentforce and how AI agents intersect with DevOps, governance, and metadata
  • A proven track record of building a personal brand on LinkedIn — you already post regularly and have an engaged following
  • Comfort and charisma on camera — you can record a demo, host a livestream, or keynote a webinar without breaking a sweat
  • Excellent written communication — your posts, blogs, and docs are crisp, opinionated, and useful
  • Experience with Flosum, Gearset, Copado, Salto, or similar DevOps tooling
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, or DevOps-specific) strongly preferred

Bonus Points

  • Existing speaker history at Dreamforce, TDX, or major community events
  • Active YouTube channel, podcast, or blog focused on the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Salesforce MVP, Golden Hoodie, or recognized community leader status
  • Experience launching developer programs, hackathons, or community initiatives

Success Metrics — First 12 Months

  • Grow Flosum's share of voice in Salesforce DevOps conversations on LinkedIn and YouTube
  • Publish a consistent cadence of high-engagement content across owned and personal channels
  • Deliver flagship talks at a minimum of 6 industry events including Dreamforce and TDX
  • Drive measurable inbound interest — demo requests, trial signups, and community sign-ups attributable to evangelism
  • Build a thriving Flosum developer community that customers and prospects want to be part of

Why Flosum

  • Be the most recognized voice in Salesforce DevOps — with a company that will invest in your brand
  • Work alongside a passionate team that's defining the category natively on the Salesforce platform
  • Remote-first culture with a real travel and content production budget

jobs.description:
Verwandeln Sie Ihre Leidenschaft für Luxus in eine Karrierechance. Entdecken Sie die Welt der Premiummarken und hinterlassen Sie einen bleibenden Eindruck in den Bereichen Mode, Schönheit, Schmuck oder Automobile.

Als Evaluator für Luxusmarken tauchen Sie in die Welt des Luxus ein, um Kundenerfahrungen diskret zu bewerten und kritisches Feedback zu geben, das den Marken hilft, ihre Dienstleistungen zu verbessern. Ob Sie Boutiquen besuchen, online einkaufen oder ein Produkt zurückgeben - Ihre Stimme prägt die Zukunft des Luxus.

Flexibilität - jeder Besuch in einem Geschäft dauert etwa 20 Minuten, so dass Sie die Flexibilität haben, mehrere Aufgaben zu erfüllen.

Häufige Gelegenheiten - führen Sie mehrere Einsätze pro Monat durch und arbeiten Sie mit einigen der renommiertesten Marken weltweit zusammen.

Was Sie tun werden:

1. Wählen Sie Ihre Aufgaben - stimmen Sie Ihre Missionen mit Ihren persönlichen Vorlieben und Ihrem Profil ab.

2. Besuchen Sie Luxusgeschäfte oder bewerten Sie online - sprechen Sie mit den Verkäufern in den Geschäften oder online, bequem von zu Hause aus.

3. Beobachten Sie genau - prüfen Sie das Ambiente, die Servicequalität und das allgemeine Kundenerlebnis.

4. Geben Sie ehrliches Feedback - nutzen Sie unsere Plattform, um Ihre Beobachtungen über Fragebögen mitzuteilen.

Vorzüge der Rolle:

Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Marken aus verschiedenen Branchen.

Flexible, auf Ihre Interessen zugeschnittene Aufgaben.

Entschädigung für Ihre Zeit und Ihren Beitrag, mit der Möglichkeit der Rückerstattung von Einkäufen.

Eine benutzerfreundliche Plattform für die Verwaltung von Aufträgen und Feedback.

So werden Sie Mitglied der CXG-Community:

1. Registrieren: Melden Sie sich unter live.cxg.com an und bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mail.

2. Vervollständigen Sie Ihr Profil: Füllen Sie Ihre Daten zu 100% aus und lassen Sie sich verifizieren.

3. Lassen Sie sich zertifizieren: Bestehen Sie die allgemeine Zertifizierung, um Zugang zu den Missionen zu erhalten.

4. Bewerben Sie sich für Missionen: Erkunden Sie Aufträge mit Marken, die Sie begeistern.

5. Beginnen Sie mit der Evaluierung: Beginnen Sie, auf dem Luxusmarkt etwas zu bewegen. Vergütung:

Nicht-Kauf-Evaluierungen: Sie erhalten ein Honorar, das sich nach der Komplexität des Auftrags richtet.

Einkaufsbasierte Evaluierungen: Rückerstattung für genehmigte Artikel, wie in der Aufgabenbeschreibung angegeben.

Über CXG

CXG bringt Premiummarken mit über 80.000 Bewertern in 70 Ländern zusammen. Mit 12 globalen Niederlassungen und fast zwei Jahrzehnten Erfahrung im CX-Einzelhandel sind wir bestrebt, das Kundenerlebnis für Luxusgiganten neu zu definieren.

Kommen Sie zu uns und genießen Sie die Flexibilität, mit unserer mobilen Plattform CXG Live auch unterwegs zu arbeiten. Auf dieser Plattform können Sie Missionen, Zertifizierungen und Feedback nahtlos verwalten.

Requirements

  • Sie müssen mindestens 18 Jahre alt sein.
  • Derzeitiger Kunde von Premium- und Luxusmarken.
  • Steht derzeit nicht unter Vertrag mit einer Einzelhandelsmarke, um Unparteilichkeit zu gewährleisten.
  • Pünktlich, organisiert, detailorientiert und zuverlässig.
  • Aufmerksam und leidenschaftlich in Bezug auf Kundenerfahrungen.
  • Es sind keine Vorkenntnisse erforderlich; wir schätzen ehrliches Feedback von echten Kunden.

jobs.description:
Fashion / Product Developer Designer
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity
At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly organized and technically skilled Fashion / Product Developer Designer to join our team remotely. In this role, you are the critical bridge between our creative design team and our overseas/domestic manufacturing partners.

Since we operate 100% remotely, your success depends on your ability to translate ideas into flawless digital blueprints, manage factory relationships via email and video calls, and self-manage your workflow across different time zones. You will not just draw; you will engineer garments for commercial production.

Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Development
  • Translate initial creative sketches and mood boards into highly detailed digital Tech Packs (using Adobe Illustrator, CLO 3D, or Excel) that include graded specs, construction callouts, stitch types, and trim details.
  • Research, recommend, and source appropriate fabrics, hardware, and wash finishes that match the design intent while meeting cost and sustainability targets.
  • Conduct remote fit sessions (via Zoom/Teams), providing clear digital comments and photos to factories on pattern adjustments and construction fixes.
2. Remote Factory & Vendor Communication
  • Serve as the main point of contact for our manufacturing partners via email, WhatsApp, and scheduled video conferences.
  • Negotiate pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities (MOQs) remotely.
  • Troubleshoot production issues in real-time by reviewing factory-reported problems through shared digital files (Google Drive, Dropbox) and providing immediate solutions.
3. Project & Timeline Management
  • Own the production calendar from sample stage to bulk delivery, ensuring all milestones are met despite geographic distances.
  • Proactively flag potential delays (e.g., fabric shortages, sample failures) to the internal team using project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or Slack).
4. Quality Assurance & Costing
  • Establish clear quality standards (AQL levels) and ensure factories adhere to them via remote inspection checklists.
  • Breakdown garment costs (Costing Sheets) to ensure the final product sits within the target wholesale and retail margins.

What We Are Looking For
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Fashion Merchandising/Product Development, or related field is a plus—but what truly matters is your attitude and ability to grow. Eagerness to learn is just as valued as experience.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fashion product development, technical design, or production management (freelance or in-house).
    • Must have proven experience in apparel development, with specific expertise in intimate wear.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in creating Tech Packs (Adobe Illustrator is a must; CLO 3D or Browzwear is a huge plus). Strong knowledge of woven, knit, and cut-and-sew construction.
  • Remote Work Proficiency:
    • Digital Collaboration: Comfortable using Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, and other project management tools daily.
    • Communication: Excellent English written and verbal skills
  • Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose a fit or construction issue from photos/videos sent by a factory and explain the fix clearly without being physically present.
  • Home Office Setup: You must have a reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet space for video calls.
  • Portfolio Requirement: Please submit a portfolio showcasing your relevant apparel and intimate wear development work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
Preferred
  • Experience working directly with Asian or European manufacturing hubs.
  • Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) software.

Why Join STERRY?
We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your skills in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply!

Disaster Recovery Public Assistance Technical Specialist – Reservist (On-Call)

When communities are impacted by hurricanes, floods, wildfires, tornadoes, and other major disasters, recovery requires experienced technical professionals who can assess damage, evaluate recovery needs, develop cost estimates, and help restore critical public infrastructure. Their expertise helps communities recover faster, rebuild smarter, and become more resilient for the future.

At ICF, our Disaster Management team partners with federal, state, tribal, territorial, and local governments to help communities recover and rebuild. We support disaster recovery programs that restore essential public services, strengthen infrastructure, and help communities navigate complex funding requirements following catastrophic events. We are seeking experienced Public Assistance Technical Specialists to join our On-Call Reservist team and support disaster recovery efforts across the country.

This is a U.S.-based, on-call position that may require travel to client sites, field locations, and disaster recovery operations for multi-week assignments.

Why Join Our Reservist Team?
• Support communities during some of their most critical moments of recovery.
• Apply your expertise to meaningful, real-world challenges.
• Gain experience across a variety of disaster recovery programs and geographies.
• Work alongside experienced disaster recovery professionals committed to helping communities rebuild.
• Enjoy the flexibility of on-call employment while remaining connected to impactful work.

About On-Call Employment with ICF
Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as "On-Call" employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work as it becomes available, with the freedom to accept or decline assignments. Individuals may work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest.

For many professionals, this model provides the opportunity to contribute to meaningful disaster recovery efforts while maintaining flexibility and pursuing other professional interests.

Please provide an updated resume that highlights experience relevant to the qualifications listed below, including construction, estimating, disaster recovery, FEMA Public Assistance, infrastructure assessment, and related technical expertise, where applicable.

What You Will Do
• Evaluate damaged facilities, infrastructure, documentation, and photographs to support disaster recovery project development.
• Develop and review scopes of work, damage inventories, repair recommendations, and cost estimates.
• Apply FEMA Public Assistance policies, regulations, and program requirements during project development and review.
• Review FEMA Project Worksheets and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
• Provide technical guidance and support to project teams, applicants, and recovery stakeholders.
• Consult on Hazard Mitigation, Alternate Procedures, Improved Projects, and other FEMA Public Assistance requirements.
• Participate in meetings with agencies, applicants, contractors, and project teams to support recovery project planning and implementation.
• Maintain accurate project records, reporting, and documentation within program management systems.
• Support recovery initiatives that help restore critical public infrastructure and community services.

Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience supporting FEMA Public Assistance programs, including Hazard Mitigation (Sections 404 and/or 406), Alternate Procedures, Improved Projects, or related recovery initiatives.
• 3+ years of construction, infrastructure, engineering, estimating, building assessment, or related technical experience.
• 2+ years of experience utilizing RSMeans, Xactimate, FEMA Cost Estimating Format (CEF), or comparable cost estimating software.
• Experience supporting disaster recovery projects at the federal, state, tribal, territorial, or local government level.
• Ability and willingness to travel by air and vehicle with limited notice to support disaster recovery operations.
• Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, environmental sciences, disaster management, infrastructure, finance, or a related field.
• Experience supporting active disaster recovery programs funded through FEMA Public Assistance, Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP), CDBG-DR, or CDBG-MIT.
• Experience applying FEMA Public Assistance policy, guidance, and regulations to complex recovery projects.
• Experience evaluating infrastructure, construction, public works, utilities, facilities, or capital improvement projects.
• Experience supporting disaster recovery projects involving complex stakeholder, political, or programmatic considerations.
• FEMA certifications or relevant FEMA coursework.

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) builds and manages strategic relationships with a select group of U.S. external experts within assigned therapeutic areas across specialty groups to generate timely, actionable insights that inform brand strategy. Join us as a Traveling Research Associate II - And utilize your expertise to support clinic operations, manage patient care workflows, assist with administrative tasks, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance the efficiency and quality of clinical services.

At ThermoFisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

What You’ll Do:

  • Join a virtual site operations SWAT team who is expected to travel 65 to 70% to different sites in the state and neighboring states.

May perform technical procedures running patient clinics including vital signs, height, weight, Electrocardiogram etc. Fully inform patients about
the tests to be conducted and guides patients in the requirements of the trial.

• May perform Phlebotomy tests.

    • Report Quality Incidents and participate in the investigation and resolution.

    • Thorough attention to detail to ensure accuracy and efficiency in data entry

    • Regular and consistent attendance.

You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Job Title: Clinical Applications Specialist- Neurology/Oncology (OH, PA, VA)

Job Location: Remote

Job Description Summary

The Clinical Applications Specialist, PDx Neurology/Oncology, ensures that GE HealthCare radiotracers (Vizamyl, DaTscan, Cerianna) translate into meaningful clinical impact for every patient. This role partners closely with customers to deliver training, clinical expertise, and operational support that enable safe, confident, and effective use of molecular imaging solutions. As part of the clinical and operational engine of PDx, you support successful program launches, sustained adoption, and long term growth—keeping the patient at the center of every step.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Develop product, clinical, workflow, and software knowledge, skills, and competence within the Nuclear Medicine and PET modality customers supporting GE Healthcare’s Neurology and Oncology radiopharmaceutical portfolio including Vizamyl, DaTscan, Cerianna and DaTQUANT quantification software.
  • Collaborate and coordinate the delivery of on-site and virtual customer training, including pre-training coordination, patient go-live support, and ongoing post-go-live training and support as needed over the product's lifecycle. Participate in the company scheduling process for these events.
  • Build solid customer relations by interfacing directly with customers including physicians, nurses, technologists, scheduling, and business office staff. Serve as the interface between the customer and GE.
  • Collaborate with Field Sales teams to support pre-sale product activities such as image reviews, DaTQUANT quantification demos, technical product support, or similar activities.
  • Present on GEHC RadioPharma products at conferences, speaking events, and customer events as needed to support clinical education of products. Present CE credits to technologists. Present Reader Training to Imagers.
  • Communicate all relevant product offering intelligence including customer concerns, opportunities, and competitive information to appropriate internal parties such as Management, Supply, Field Sales, Marketing, Market Access, and Medical Affairs. On request, participate in company work streams around clinical and business processes.
  • Basic understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. Good understanding of how the work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
  • May have some autonomy to make decisions within a defined framework. Resolves issues in situations that require good technical knowledge and judgment within established procedures. Consults more senior team members for issues outside of defined instructions/parameters.
  • Expeditiously communicates appropriate customer questions to Medical Science.
  • Collaborate with CMO partners as needed to support customers and market growth.
  • Ensure a compliant, ethical culture to promote GEHC products and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
  • Additional projects and initiatives as required.

Required Qualifications

  • CNMT or equivalent specific Nuclear Medicine modality certification.
  • 4+ years of clinical imaging experience including a minimum of 3 years’ experience with Nuclear Medicine and PET modalities; Experience using DaTscan, Vizamyl and/or Cerianna preferred.
  • Comfortable in a clinical/patient environment.
  • Required to travel extensively 85+% (4-5 days per week including overnights and some weekends) within the US and Canada (USCAN) via multiple modes of transportation (car, air travel, train, etc.) as necessary for onsite customer education and training.
  • Residence located no more than 1 hour from a major airport.
  • Proficient use of software applications, such as Windows Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and navigating other computer and web-based tools (intranet/internet/apps); CRM
  • Ability to learn specialized industry-specific software and provide digital education and training solutions. Preference for familiarity with viewing software such as MIM, Hermes, and Syngo.
  • Must register with one or more vendor credentialing services by various customer hospitals. This requires but is not limited to, proof of immunization for mumps, measles, and rubella (MMR) and hepatitis and drug testing/screening.
  • Must live within the territory (Northeast US) commutable to a major US airport (within 1 hour)

Desired Characteristics

  • Ability to support and contribute to strategy and innovation. Through ongoing successes, new expectations and contributions are generated to transform the clinical education experience.
  • Exceptional people skills. Behaviors are adaptive, functional, and constructive.
  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs
  • Self-confident, service-oriented, conscientious, assertive, persistent, motivated, flexible and a collaborator.

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and operate a vehicle safely.
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

Job description summary

This Director role sits within Data Products and Foundations, under Data Partnerships, Innovation and Products. The role reports to the Executive Director, Innovative Data Offerings and Products and partners closely with DEO (Data Enablement Organization) to execute the strategy set for trusted, reusable, AI-ready data products.

This role owns enterprise data foundations across reference data, master data, metadata, standards, stewardship, and business definitions, defining the vision, roadmap, prioritization, adoption plan, and value measures needed to improve data trust, consistency, discoverability, interoperability, metadata coverage, standards adoption, and AI-ready enterprise foundations.

The Director will ensure products are defined in innovative ways that go beyond datasets, embedding business meaning, rules, metrics, lineage, metadata, and context so they can be reused by business users, analytics teams, and AI-enabled solutions.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle management for Reference Data, Master Data, Metadata, Standards.
  • Define products in innovative ways by embedding business meaning, semantic definitions, reusable measures, standards, metadata, lineage, and clear consumption patterns directly into the product design.
  • Work closely with DEO (Data Enablement Organization) to translate the strategy into executable plans, align on delivery priorities, remove operational barriers, and ensure products are scalable, reliable, and ready for enterprise consumption.
  • Partner across business, analytics, technology, Data Partnerships, Innovation and Products, and Data Products and Foundations teams to prioritize high-value capabilities and reduce duplication.
  • Drive product adoption, stakeholder engagement, product performance management, issue prioritization, and continuous enhancement based on business needs and user feedback.
  • Establish product standards, governance routines, intake processes, service expectations, and value measures that ensure reliability, reuse, compliance, scalability, and business impact.

Experience:

Novartis is seeking an experienced Director to lead product strategy, delivery, adoption, and governance for Payer, HCP, Omnichannel, Engagement. The ideal candidate brings product leadership, cross-functional influence, and the ability to partner with DEO to execute strategy while translating business priorities into trusted, reusable, AI-ready data products.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA strongly preferred
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, technology, data, analytics, or consulting, with a strong focus on data products, data strategy, product management, or analytics enablement.
  • Minimum 5+ years of domain expertise in reference data, master data, metadata management, data standards, data governance, stewardship, semantic models, product management, and AI-ready data foundations.
  • Proven ability to define product vision, roadmap, prioritization, use cases, adoption plans, value measures, and governance routines in a complex matrixed environment.
  • Strong understanding of semantic data products, business definitions, data quality, metadata, lineage, standards, and AI-ready data consumption patterns.
  • Experience partnering with data enablement, platform, technology, analytics, business, governance, and operations teams to execute strategy and scale data products.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into data product requirements and present complex concepts clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Must understand both data and the relevant business/domain context to bridge technical requirements with business needs, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage ambiguity, and adapt to changing business priorities while maintaining focus on measurable outcomes.

BeOne Medicines is seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking Director of Corporate Affairs Strategy, Analytics & Insights to help drive the evolution of a high-performing, insight-led global Corporate Affairs function.

The Director serves as a key strategic and operational leader within Corporate Affairs, responsible for advancing planning, performance measurement, AI enablement, insights generation, and operational excellence across the global function. The role partners closely with the Head of Global Corporate Affairs Strategy, Analytics & Insights to translate strategy into execution, drive organizational alignment, strengthen decision-making through data and insights, and build scalable capabilities that increase the impact and effectiveness of Corporate Affairs. The Director leads critical enterprise processes, including strategic planning (AOP and LRP), Corporate Affairs performance measurement and reporting, AI roadmap execution, financial governance, and cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Success in this role requires deep Corporate Affairs experience within the biopharmaceutical industry, combined with strategic thinking, operational rigor, analytical expertise, and change leadership. The Director will serve as a trusted advisor to Corporate Affairs leadership, helping establish the systems, governance, insights, and capabilities that enable the function to demonstrate impact, improve performance, and support enterprise objectives.

Strategic Planning and Alignment

  • Partner with the Senior Director to lead the annual Corporate Affairs strategic planning process (AOP, LRP), ensuring clear alignment between enterprise goals, functional strategies, and regional plans.

  • Manage key milestones and governance touchpoints, ensuring timely decision-making and visibility across leadership teams.

Corporate Affairs AI Enablement

Insights and Decision

  • Translate complex qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights that inform strategy and elevate performance discussions.
  • Prepare and present insight-driven briefings and reports for Corporate Affairs leadership and senior executives, highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with regional and functional leads to gather intelligence on stakeholder perceptions, emerging issues, and communication effectiveness.
  • Help define and evolve key performance indicators (KPIs) and success measures that link Corporate Affairs activity to business impact.

Enterprise Reporting and Storytelling

  • Support the design and delivery of global Corporate Affairs performance reporting, connecting results and insights to strategic narratives.
  • Establish periodic business reviews, leadership updates, that demonstrate the impact of Corporate Affairs.
  • Manage operational workstream (e.g., communications, performance) of key partners in our LMIC patient access program on behalf of BeOne Medicines.
  • Work closely with Corporate Affairs teams to embed data-driven storytelling into thought leadership and reputation management efforts.

Operational Excellence and Change Enablement

  • Operationalize strategic initiatives, including process improvements, new capability builds, and change adoption across regions.
  • Serve as a key connector across regions and workstreams, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and consistency.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Corporate Affairs, Communications, Public Affairs, Patient Advocacy, or related experience within the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences sector, including experience supporting global or multi-regional organizations.
  • Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives, including the application of AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve organizational effectiveness, decision-making, and business outcomes.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging AI tools and translate them into scalable capabilities, processes, and ways of working across corporate affairs teams.
  • Proven track record driving adoption of new technologies through governance, change management, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Experience designing and leading enterprise measurement frameworks, operating models, strategic planning processes, or organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of the external stakeholder, policy, regulatory, and reputational landscape shaping global biopharmaceutical companies.
  • Proven ability to influence senior executives, build alignment across highly matrixed organizations, and drive execution through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership teams and contributing to Board-level reporting and strategic discussions.
  • Experience managing operational and financial processes, including annual planning, forecasting, governance, resource allocation, and budget oversight.

Preferred Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with operational execution excellence.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change; proactive in driving improvement.
  • Skilled in stakeholder engagement and fostering cross-functional alignment.
  • Passion for data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with digital analytics tools, visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and AI-enabled insights.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.

The Role

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.

Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.

The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).

  • Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.

  • Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.

  • Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.

  • Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.

  • Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.

  • Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.

  • Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.

  • Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.

  • Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.

  • Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.

  • Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.

  • Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.

  • Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).

  • Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).

  • Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.

  • Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.

  • Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.

General

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.

  • Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.

  • A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.

  • Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.

  • Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem.

  • Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering.

  • A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team.

  • A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves.
