Senior Data Scientist

Givelify is a fintech-for-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we’ve helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7.5 billion. Together, they’re changing their world with kindness and generosity.

Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters.

Make an impact at one of the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits.

About your role

We're seeking a Senior Data Scientist to be an early and foundational member of a growing Data Science & Insights team — with a focus spanning product and business analytics at Givelify. Reporting to the Head of Data Science & Insights, you will work across the full analytics stack — dashboards, metrics, experimentation, and modeling — with an immediate focus on building the business intelligence infrastructure that gives Givelify transparent, reliable visibility into how the organization is performing.

This is a generalist senior individual contributor role by design. As the team grows and specialization becomes possible, your focus will evolve with it. For now, breadth is the asset — you are someone who can move fluidly across problem types and deliver rigorously wherever you land.

Your Team

You will be part of the Data Science & Insights team — driving experimentation, analytics, and modeling at the frontier of behavioral science and fintech, tackling problems most data teams never encounter. We translate the complexity of human generosity into rigorous, measurable insight that shapes products and decisions at scale.

Senior Data Scientist will get to:

  • Own the development of org-wide business dashboards that provide transparent, reliable insight into company performance, functional health, and execution velocity — the infrastructure that helps Givelify understand how it is operating at any moment.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define, instrument, and maintain the metrics that matter — ensuring the right things are being measured, consistently and trustworthy.
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional teams to design and execute rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments that establish causation before solutions launch — embedding an experiment-first mindset into how Givelify builds and decides.
  • Work alongside the Data Science & Insights team to continuously raise the bar on experimentation at Givelify — tackling hard methodological challenges like measuring the impact of experience-driven features, managing concurrent experiments, and developing approaches that make rigorous testing possible even where it has historically been difficult.
  • Build predictive and behavioral models that deepen understanding of donor and organizational behavior — segmentation, churn, propensity, and beyond.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

  • Own your outcomes completely — you hold yourself accountable for scoping, delivery, and impact, and you execute collaboratively, knowing the best analytical work at Givelify is built with teams, not in isolation.
  • Proactively surface opportunities to bring experimentation and causal rigor to decisions across the organization — making the experiment-first mindset contagious.
  • Bring stakeholders into the analytical process early and continuously — from question definition through to recommendation — so that insights translate into action.
  • Lead with expertise and invest in others — as an early member of a growing function, your impact extends beyond your own output to how the team gets better.

Your experience:

  • 5–8+ years of experience in data science, business intelligence, applied statistics, or advanced analytics
  • Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Mathematics, Econometrics, or a related quantitative field
  • Strong track record building business dashboards and insight systems that drive operational visibility and executive decision-making
  • Solid experience with experimental design and causal inference — A/B testing, power analysis, difference-in-differences, propensity methods — and translating results into business decisions
  • Strong background in predictive and behavioral modeling — regression, classification, segmentation, time series, gradient boosting — with a focus on business application
  • Expert in SQL; advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PySpark) and/or R
  • Hands-on experience with modern data stacks, Databricks preferred; broader fluency with modern data stacks essentials
  • Comfortable working across problem types — you don't need a narrow lane to do excellent work
  • Practical fluency using AI/LLM tools to accelerate analytical work (e.g., exploratory analysis, code assistance, documentation), along with an understanding of responsible AI use and data governance

Your superpowers:

  • You influence through evidence and storytelling — you don't just analyze; you move people and decisions with what you find
  • You translate ambiguity into clarity — where others see a messy question, you see an analytical path forward
  • You are data-informed, not data-driven — you know that data illuminates decisions, and you bring analytical rigor and human judgment in equal measure
  • You are a custodian and evangelist of causal rigor — you champion well-designed, preemptive experiments as the gold standard for knowing what works, and you carry that conviction into every analytical conversation
  • You are a player-coach — you lead with expertise, build strong processes, and make the people around you better
  • You are energized by being early — you find building more exciting than inheriting a mature function
  • You are comfortable with a shifting focus — you thrive when priorities evolve and don't need a narrow lane to do excellent work

jobs.excerpt: Seu bem-estar, nossa missão.  Junte-se a uma empresa que torna o mundo mais saudável.
jobs.description:
Seu bem-estar, nossa missão. Junte-se a uma empresa que torna o mundo mais saudável.

CONHEÇA A GENTE

Estamos revolucionando o bem-estar corporativo. Nossa plataforma conecta colaboradores do mundo todo aos melhores parceiros em exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono – tudo em uma só subscrição. Com base em Nova York e equipe na Europa, América do Norte e América do Sul, nossa missão é fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

A gente acredita que o trabalho deve ser gratificante, inspirador e equilibrado. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma equipe que valoriza bem-estar, colaboração e perspectivas diversas, em um lugar onde paixão e criatividade rompem limites para criar impacto de verdade. Suas contribuições vão ajudar a construir um mundo mais saudável, para você e milhões de pessoas globalmente.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Estamos contratando uma pessoa Analista de Control Desk Júnior (CX) para se juntar ao nosso time de CX Global no Brasil para atuar de forma remota!

Nosso time de CX Global é o coração da experiência dos nossos membros, parceiros e clientes corporativos em todo o mundo. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa analista júnior de CX WFM Intraday (Control Desk) para atuar diretamente no monitoramento, balanceamento e gestão em tempo real das nossas operações de atendimento. Nesta função, você não será apenas alguém acompanhando pausas ou painéis: você atuará na linha de frente com autonomia real para tomada de decisões críticas, servindo como um parceiro consultivo para os supervisores de operações e garantindo que nossos níveis de serviço (SLA) sejam atingidos com eficiência e qualidade.

Esta vaga é 100% remota (para qualquer região do Brasil), no horário regular de fechamento de turno: de segunda a sexta-feira, das 12h30 às 21h00, com escala de 1 plantão mensal aos sábados (das 08h00 às 15h00, com compensação e redução de carga horária durante a semana).

SEU IMPACTO

  • Monitorar e gerenciar a operação de atendimento em tempo real, mantendo o equilíbrio entre a entrada de volume/contatos e a capacidade instalada de agentes em múltiplos canais.
  • Identificar desvios de SLA, tempo de resposta (FRT), backlog e absenteísmo/aderência à escala, aplicando ações corretivas imediatas (redistribuição de filas, ajustes em pausas e ativação de planos de contingência).
  • Atuar como o ponto focal ágil e consultivo entre WFM/Planejamento e a liderança de operações (Supervisores e Coordenadores), alinhando movimentações com clareza técnica e sem ruídos.
  • Investigar as causas-raiz de desvios de indicadores operacionais, categorizando ocorrências e quantificando impactos no dia a dia.
  • Registrar ocorrências operacionais, incidentes sistêmicos e gerar relatórios intraday objetivos para acompanhamento contínuo da operação.
  • Participar de iniciativas e projetos de melhoria contínua na esteira de tempo real, incluindo o uso prático de inteligência artificial generativa para automação de alertas e visibilidade de dados operacionais.

QUEM É VOCÊ

  • Vivência prática comprovada no acompanhamento operacional, controle em tempo real ou rotinas de Control Desk/Intraday em centrais de atendimento, contact centers ou operações de CX multicanal.
  • Domínio prático dos principais indicadores e conceitos de atendimento ao cliente (SLA, TMA/AHT, Aderência, Ocupação, Backlog, First Response Time).
  • Conhecimento conceitual ou prático no manuseio de ferramentas de atendimento/omnichannel ou Workforce Management (como Zendesk, Genesys, Tymeshift ou plataformas correlatas).
  • Habilidade intermediária ou avançada no uso de planilhas eletrônicas (Google Sheets e/ou Microsoft Excel) para cruzamento de dados, tabelas dinâmicas e fórmulas analíticas.
  • Conhecimento de inglês a partir de nível intermediário (capacidade de ler, interpretar relatórios técnicos e se comunicar por chat/e-mail com equipes globais; proficiência avançada será considerada um diferencial).
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com segurança para dialogar, negociar e alinhar decisões com lideranças operacionais.
  • Raciocínio lógico ágil, capacidade de resolução de problemas e adaptabilidade a cenários dinâmicos e imprevistos diários.
  • Familiaridade e interesse no uso de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (ex.: Gemini, ChatGPT) para otimizar análises, sínteses de relatórios e rotinas diárias.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

Criamos um ambiente de trabalho para você prosperar em todas as dimensões da sua vida. A gente faz isso por meio de benefícios bem pensados, recursos para o bem-estar emocional e uma cultura que empodera cada pessoa a realmente se conectar com seu papel aqui e ser dona dele, balanceando isso com o próprio bem-estar.

Nosso programa de benefícios flexíveis ajuda você a customizá-los de acordo com as suas necessidades!

Nossos benefícios incluem:

WELLHUB: Plano Gold+ gratuito, com acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios, programas fitness digitais e recursos online para meditação, nutrição, suporte de saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais. Você também pode adicionar até 3 familiares ao seu plano, garantindo que quem mais importa para você tenha acesso a bem-estar.

WELLZ: Um recurso único e completo para o bem-estar mental. O Wellz oferece jornadas personalizadas que combinam sessões semanais de terapia cognitivo-comportamental (52 por ano) e conteúdo à demanda.

SAÚDE E CUIDADO: Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL: Com o regime de trabalho que prioriza flexibilidade, a gente oferece vagas híbridas e remotas, para que tenha a liberdade de trabalhar do jeito que funciona melhor para você. O modelo de trabalho desta vaga específica pode ser discutido com a pessoa recrutadora e com a liderança. Quando você entrar no Wellhub, também pode usar o nosso reembolso de home office para montar o seu escritório em casa!

DESCANSO REMUNERADO: Se desconectar e recarregar as energias é muito importante. Por isso, oferecemos férias após 6 meses de trabalho + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga a cada ano na empresa (somando até 5 dias) + 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário!

LICENÇA PARENTAL REMUNERADA: Receber um novo membro na família é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida. Queremos que cada pessoa colaboradora possa estar presente de verdade e aproveite esse tempo em família. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental 100% remunerada a todos os novos pais. Quem dá à luz também tem direito à licença estendida (Empresa Cidadã) e a um período de adaptação (ramp-back), em que pode trabalhar meio-período até se ajustar à nova rotina.

DESENVOLVIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Tenha acesso a plataformas globais de aprendizado, participe de sessões interativas, construa seu mapa de desenvolvimento personalizado e explore nossas oportunidades internas. Aqui, a gente foca em aprendizado e feedback contínuos para apoiar sua jornada em direção ao sucesso – tanto pessoal quanto profissional.

CULTURA: Você vai se juntar a uma equipe de pessoas dedicadas, que se unem para romper limites, apoiar umas às outras e criar impacto duradouro no bem-estar corporativo. Nós vencemos em conjunto, cultivando relações de confiança por meio de comunicação transparente e de uma cultura em que cada perspectiva importa. Entenda mais sobre nossos valores e cultura.

Quer ver como é realmente trabalhar aqui? Siga a gente no Instagram @lifeatwellhub e assista ao vídeo do nosso time no YouTube!

Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento @ Wellhub

Buscamos criar um ambiente colaborativo, acolhedor e inclusivo, onde todo mundo sinta que faz parte.

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades equitativas. Todas pessoas qualificadas que se candidatarem serão igualmente consideradas, sem discriminação por raça, religião, cor, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou mental não desqualificante, nacionalidade, condição de veterano ou qualquer outra base coberta pela lei apropriada.

Nosso compromisso com a inclusão também se estende à forma como reconhecemos e remuneramos nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa Syndio Fair Pay Certified, um certificado que reflete a nossa dedicação contínua a práticas de remuneração justas e equitativas em toda a nossa equipe global. Leia mais aqui.

Presales Director

We are continually growing and are always interested in connecting with exceptional talent. This posting is intended to help us build a pipeline of qualified candidates for anticipated future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates who align with our needs may be contacted as opportunities arise.


Interested in a career that bridges the gap between Supply Chain and Technology?


Elemica, a global leader in digital supply chain automation, is seeking experienced Presales Director to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations.

This role will have a competitive total compensation package and recognition for overachievement of sales goals.


Our Values


At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:

  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
  • Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.
  • Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain

What’s In It For You?


  • Industry impact: Help Fortune 1000 companies digitize over $1 trillion in annual commerce
  • End-to-end solutions: work across procurement, order automation, and logistics on a single SaaS platform
  • Collaborative team: join a highly experienced, globally connected commercial organization
  • Flexibility & exposure: remote-first role with global client interactions and cross-functional partnerships
  • Customer-centric work
  • Cutting-edge supply chain technology and innovation
  • Flexible work locations
  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and careers
  • Personal and pet insurance options
  • Flexible time off and paid holidays
  • 401k and bonus program
  • Wellness and mental health initiatives
  • Generous employee referral bonus program
  • Fun work environment

Role & Responsibilities


Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Presales, the Presales Director is the primary presales contact for opportunities, primarily in EMEA. You’ll engage directly with enterprise clients to understand their business goals, uncover process challenges, and design tailored solutions that drive digital transformation.


What You’ll Do


  • Serve as the lead presales consultant for new client opportunities and expansions, supporting account executives across industries
  • Collaborate with clients to understand supply chain pain points and demonstrate how Elemica’s solutions address them through procurement, order-to-cash, and logistics operations
  • Deliver high-impact workshops, solution walkthroughs, and value-aligned presentations for stakeholders across IT, supply chain, and business functions
  • Partner with an internal analyst to configure demos, while maintaining a functional understanding of the setup process to support customization or troubleshooting as needed
  • Manage and author client-facing RFP responses, proposals, and supporting materials with minimal supervision
  • Translate solution strategies into implementation scopes in collaboration with the Services team
  • Stay informed on industry trends, ERP ecosystems (e.g., SAP), and surrounding supply chain platforms (e.g., TMS, P2P, order automation, planning) to influence solution design and product feedback loops

What You’ll Need


  • 10–15+ years of experience in presales, solution consulting, or business analysis for enterprise supply chain or SaaS platforms
  • Proven expertise in at least one area: procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, or transportation/logistics with broad understanding of end-to-end supply chain operations
  • Strong familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and complementary supply chain software such as Blue Yonder, Coupa, Esker, Conexiom, Oracle, or Kinaxis
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage senior business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to lead strategic client conversations, facilitate discovery, and shape solution roadmaps
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable in an individual contributor role with cross-functional influence
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related discipline

Who We Are


Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.


It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative Sr. Customer Analytics Director to serve as the lead individual contributor driving analytics, performance metrics, and data-driven insights across our Customer organization. Working closely with the Chief Customer Officer (CCO) and key cross-functional partners, this role connects financial and operational data to improve customer retention, optimize revenue performance, and drive organizational accountability.

The ideal candidate possesses deep SaaS financial acumen, advanced data architecture and reporting skills, and the proven ability to translate complex recurring revenue datasets into actionable strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Customer Revenue Metrics & Standards: In partnership with Finance (owners of official ARR and financial reporting), ensure all key customer performance metrics—including ARR movement, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), up-for-renewal rates, cohort views, and churn drivers—comply with Thoma Bravo standards and industry best practices. Translate overall company metrics into actionable operational views for Customer Success, evaluate renewal forecast accuracy, and build reporting on cross-sell and upsell pipelines owned by Sales and Renewals.
  • Executive & Board Reporting: Lead the end-to-end data preparation and analytical narrative for CCO presentations, board packs, Thoma Bravo operating reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). Frame business performance, revenue risks, and investment asks around quantifiable business outcomes, ensuring executive reporting directly aligns with underlying operational reality.
  • Renewal & Retention Variance Analysis: Own the ongoing reporting, modeling, and variance analysis for renewal rates, comparing official forecasts against planned targets and actual results while providing detailed root-cause breakdowns of underlying drivers.
  • Planning & Capacity Modeling: Partner with Finance to construct the annual customer renewal and retention model, setting historical baselines, target assumptions, and segment-level forecasts. Build data-driven headcount, coverage-ratio, and capacity models linked directly to book-of-business segmentation.
  • Customer Health & Early Warning Systems: Design, refine, and maintain the organization’s customer health scoring model, risk telemetry, and predictive churn analyses to proactively flag accounts at risk.
  • Analytics Requirements & Data Governance: Define customer organization reporting requirements across Salesforce, the enterprise data warehouse, and BI platforms. Partner with Systems & Operations and Data & Analytics teams to ensure data models align strictly with Finance’s standardized definitions, while independently executing custom quantitative analyses for the CCO.
  • Cross-Functional Strategy Alignment: Collaborate with Revenue Operations and CRO leadership to align on unified data models for improving Net Retention Rate (NRR). Work alongside Product Strategy to deliver granular churn and revenue forecasting sliced by product line and usage behaviors.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in customer analytics, revenue analytics, FP&A, strategic finance, or Customer Success/Revenue Operations within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS recurring revenue models and financial mechanics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, cohort analysis, contraction, and churn dynamics.
  • Advanced proficiency in querying, modeling, and visualizing complex enterprise datasets using SQL, Excel, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) alongside CRM platforms like Salesforce.
  • Proven experience translating business requirements into technical data specs and building executive-ready dashboards.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear, persuasive executive visual narratives and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong cross-functional influencer and communicator capable of driving alignment across Finance, Sales, RevOps, and Product leadership.
  • Prior experience operating within a Private Equity-backed enterprise (Thoma Bravo or similar portfolio environment) and supporting board-level reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record as a high-output individual contributor capable of managing complex data projects independently from concept to execution.

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr Staff Applied AI Engineer to join our team. This is an On-site in Santa Clara, California or Remote (US role) role, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Applied AI Engineering in the IT/Data Strategy department. The Sr Staff Applied AI Engineer, GTM is a senior, hands-on AI builder embedded with our go-to-market organization who turns ambiguous, high-stakes ideas into secure, production-grade solutions that move revenue outcomes. Beyond engineering, you will act as a trusted transformation advisor to GTM leaders to run discovery, shape the GTM AI strategy and roadmap, and guide Build/Partner/Buy decisions where success is measured in business terms such as pipeline generated and seller productivity. In this role, you will also improve and expand the technical implementations, standards, and engineering playbooks the rest of the Applied AI team relies on, keeping our deliverables aligned with current best practices.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Assist GTM AI strategy from discovery through delivery by embedding with GTM leaders, RevOps, and product owners to map the revenue lifecycle, set the GTM AI roadmap, and advise on feasibility, cost, risk, and Build/Partner/Buy decisions
  • Build and deploy secure, production-grade AI solutions for revenue teams, designing and shipping high-impact use cases using retrieval-augmented generation, structured-data querying, and agentic workflows
  • Run each solution like a product tied to revenue, building monitoring and evaluation frameworks, implementing security controls for customer and commercial data, and establishing ROI against GTM KPIs
  • Drive adoption and change across the field by partnering with Sales Enablement, GTM Operations, and frontline managers to roll out solutions, train users, and establish tight feedback loops based on how the field actually works
  • Set the standards that multiply the team, improving and expanding reusable building blocks like retrieval pipelines, reference architectures, GTM data connectors, and engineering playbooks while mentoring other engineers

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and seeing dynamic environments as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner, operating with high integrity and a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing ongoing candor, feedback, and mutual respect as the fastest ways to earn trust.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing a deep curiosity for solving complex technical challenges and a desire to build secure, scalable, and transformative systems.
  • You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping value to users quickly without sacrificing technical excellence.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years working directly on AI and/or ML projects
  • Direct experience driving both AI strategy and execution for GTM functions (Sales, Marketing, Partner Enablement), including shipping solutions used by customer-facing teams with measurable impact on GTM metrics, and fluency in the revenue lifecycle
  • Hands-on experience across most of the components that make up modern AI solutions, including retrieval methods, reusable skill development, agentic orchestration, connecting to tools and data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) frameworks
  • A track record of working directly with GTM leaders on ambiguous problems, running discovery, converting unclear expectations into a concrete plan, and communicating trade-offs, risk, and architecture to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience securing AI systems and the data they access, including least-privilege access and defending against risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
  • Strong engineering skills with experience deploying and running AI at scale, proficiency in Python, comfort integrating across GTM systems of record, and experience releasing and monitoring AI systems on a major cloud platform

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • GTM experience at a B2B enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity company with complex, multi-motion sales, with a prior role in RevOps, Sales Engineering, or GTM Strategy being a strong plus
  • Direct experience with graph-based knowledge systems and long-term agent memory, including account and relationship graphs, GraphRAG, or persistent context across an account’s history
  • Experience building automated evaluation frameworks, such as LLM-as-judge or regression testing for AI quality, ideally paired with A/B or holdout experiments that measure business lift in the field

jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As a Staff+ Builder, you're on the frontier of continuously redefining how we deliver software and exercise judgement in a constantly evolving landscape — a true AI-native builder expanding products and how they get built. Some of the best work here starts with no brief, no team and no playbook. We want someone who sees that as the appeal: who takes an idea from zero to one and cares personally whether it gets traction. This role exists to bring that way of working into In Tandem, wherever the organization needs it most.

This is an evergreen role. We will shape the specific team and scope with you as we learn where your strengths meet the most important opportunities across our products and platform. As we move through conversations, we will discuss the concrete problem area, collaborators, and expectations for the opening we are considering together.

What you will do:

  • Seek out problems worth building for. Talk with users, learn from support and product data, and pay attention to changes in our markets. Turn those signals into a clear view of what matters, then take initiative inside shared priorities, and bring partners along as you learn.
  • Take it from zero to one. Start where there is no structure. Get a first version in front of real users quickly, find out whether anyone cares, and do the unglamorous work that earns early traction. Own the outcome, not just the code.
  • Carry useful work into production. Shape a focused first version, build it, and learn from real use. Define how you will judge success before you build, then use the evidence to improve, expand, or stop the work.
  • Raise the pace and quality of engineering. Identify places where an AI-enabled workflow can shorten the path from idea to shipped software. Build the tools, context, checks, and feedback loops that let other engineers use it with confidence.
  • Own the hard decisions. Move work forward when requirements are incomplete, make your reasoning visible, and bring consequential tradeoffs to the right partners. Choose when to prototype, when to invest in durable architecture, and how to verify that a system is correct, safe, and useful.
  • Connect the pieces. Work across product and engineering boundaries. Bring depth in a core platform and enough range across APIs, web, mobile, and infrastructure to help a feature succeed end to end.
  • Make others stronger. Share working examples, explain tradeoffs clearly, invite criticism, and help teams adopt what proves effective.

What strong work could look like:

The shape of the work will depend on the team. Examples include:
  • Recognizing a recurring difficulty in a family workflow, validating it with users and partners, and shipping a focused improvement across client and service boundaries.
  • Launching something small with no existing team or process, getting it to its first real users, and iterating on their feedback until it was adopted or you chose to stop.
  • Turning a promising agent prototype into a reliable engineering workflow with evaluation, tests, observability, and clear human review points.
  • Removing a recurring bottleneck in delivery so teams can make more high-quality changes with less coordination.
  • Connecting an emerging user or market need to our product strategy, testing the opportunity with a small build, and using the result to decide whether it deserves more investment.
These are examples of the work this role might own, not claims that those projects are planned or assigned.

What you bring:

What you bring
  • Staff-level impact as a hands-on engineer: you have shaped technical direction, built important systems, and helped other people deliver stronger work.
  • An owner's mindset. You've started something with little structure, such as a product, feature, internal tool, open-source project or company. You stayed with it through the early phase until it found users or you learned it wouldn't.
  • Evidence that you can move from an uncertain problem to a useful result. You know how to test a premise with a prototype and how to recognize when a prototype needs stronger engineering before it can be trusted in production.
  • Product judgment and curiosity about users and markets. You can explain why a problem mattered, how you chose it with others, and what changed for users or the business because of what you built.
  • Practical fluency with AI-assisted development. You have used models or agents to build real software or workflows, and you can explain where they helped, where they failed, and how you checked the result.
  • Strong judgment about architecture, quality, security, and user experience. You know which decisions need close attention and which can be accelerated.
  • Depth in at least one engineering area, with the curiosity and fundamentals to work effectively across the stack.
  • Low ego, high integrity, and a habit of making your reasoning visible so others can learn from and improve it.
What will stand out
Show us a piece of work you helped take from an uncertain opportunity to a useful result. If it started from zero, tell us what you did to get the first users and what you did when nobody was available to help. What user or market signal made the problem worth pursuing? How did you choose the direction with your partners? What did you build yourself, what reached production, and how do you know it made a difference? If AI or agents played a part, tell us what you delegated, how you evaluated the output, and what you changed when the first approach fell short. A strong account of a failed experiment and the judgment it sharpened is welcome.

You may have built that work in a product company, a small team, open source, or a path that does not fit a conventional résumé. The evidence matters more than a particular employer name or tool list.

Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!

jobs.excerpt: We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.
jobs.description:
We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.

Ilir Sela started Slice in his family’s pizzerias, where he saw firsthand what it takes to run a local shop. Now we’re taking everything we’ve learned beyond pizza, to taquerias, delis, burger joints, and other neighborhood staples.

We put technology, marketing, buying power, and support to work for more than 15,000 restaurants, so owners spend less time on admin, marketing, and order management and more time growing their business. They remain independent, but never alone.

We’re growing our team to help bring this next chapter to life. That’s where you come in.

This position is open to applicants across all of the UK on a remote basis, with the physical office located in Belfast, Northern Ireland.

The Challenge to Solve

How do mom-and-pop restaurants survive and win in a world of big-budget chains and third-party apps? This is the challenge you’ll help solve at Slice. Local pizzerias already outperform the big chains in offline sales, yet are outsold 20-to-1 online – a gap we’re determined to close. We operate at the intersection of high stakes and local community: our mission is to level the playing field for small businesses by providing them with the technology and capabilities that rival those of the biggest players. When a shop partners with Slice, our goal is that it feels “as if they’ve just hired 1,000 people” to support their business. As an engineer on our team, you’ll seek out bold, asymmetric opportunities to create these outsized impacts for our restaurant partners and the millions of customers they serve. It’s not just about writing code – it’s about writing the future of eating local.

What You'll Do

As aStaff Software Developer on our Services team, you will immerse yourself in our ambitious mission and take on a wide range of responsibilities to drive customer impact. Specifically, you will:

  • Build innovative features & services: Design, code, and launch new backend features that help our restaurant partners operate more efficiently and deliver exceptional, seamless experiences to their customers. Your work will directly enhance real-world interactions between shops and pizza lovers every day.
  • Identify game-changing opportunities: Constantly look for asymmetric opportunities where a small technical change can deliver disproportionate value. You’ll use your creativity and entrepreneurial mindset to find 10x solutions that delight users and give our partners an edge.
  • Own projects end-to-end: Take ownership of initiatives from concept through production. You’ll work closely with product, design, and other teams to define solutions, execute rapidly, and iterate based on feedback. When you see a problem, you don’t wait - you tackle it.
  • Use the best tools for the job: While our primary stack is Python (Flask), we embrace any technology that delivers value. You might rewrite a microservice from Go to Python, craft a script in Ruby, or leverage a new cloud service – whatever it takes to solve the task at hand in a scalable way.
  • Collaborate in a small, agile team: Work alongside a tight-knit team of 5 to 8 backend engineers (across the US, UK, and Europe) who are as passionate about the mission as you are. Together, you will review code, brainstorm ideas, and push each other to raise the bar while maintaining a fun, supportive atmosphere.
  • Ensure quality and performance at scale: Employ best practices in coding, testing, monitoring, and DevOps to ensure our services are reliable and performant. You build it, you own it - from writing unit tests to fine-tuning logging and alerting, you’ll make sure your code runs smoothly in production.

The Winning Recipe

We’re looking forbold, founder-like engineers who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo and build products that make a real difference. If you’re an unconventional thinker and a highly productive doer, you’ll feel right at home. The ideal candidate has:

  • Owner’s mindset: You think like a founder. You take initiative, own problems end-to-end, and move with urgency to deliver results. Obstacles energize you, and you thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment where your decisions drive real impact.
  • Proven builder: You have solid experience crafting scalable backend systems in Python (Flask) and working with databases and cloud services. You’re comfortable diving into monitoring and logging tools to keep systems healthy. More importantly, you’re technology-agnostic – you quickly pick up new languages or frameworks (Go, Ruby, or whatever is needed) to solve problems effectively.
  • Remote-ready collaborator: You excel at working on a distributed team and communicating asynchronously. You’re comfortable collaborating with teammates across different time zones and backgrounds, and you know how to stay connected and communicative in a remote work setting.
  • Product & customer focus: You care deeply about the why behind your code. You can clearly express opinions on product direction and design, always keeping the end-customer and restaurant owner in mind. At the same time, you respect others’ perspectives and believe the best ideas can come from anywhere.
  • Innovative problem solver: You love finding creative solutions to hard problems. Words like “impossible” or “uncharted” fuel your curiosity. You seek out those asymmetric win scenarios and aren’t afraid to experiment, adapt, and iterate to achieve a better outcome for users.

If you’ve ever dreamed of building something big, scrappy, and impactful – and you have the skills to back it up – we want to meet you!

The Extras

Working at Slice comes with a comprehensive set of benefits, but here are some of the unexpected highlights:

  • Access to medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Flexible working hours
  • Generous time off policies
  • £200 per annum employee wellbeing allowance
  • Market leading maternity and paternity schemes

The Hiring Process

You’ll find a summary of your expected interview process below and we’ll stick to this as closely as possible, but please note this may be subject to change.

  • Application
  • 30 minute introductory meeting
  • 90 minute Live Coding Interview & 60 minute Technical Interview
  • 45 minute Hiring Manager meeting
  • Offer!

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit more about this role:


This position represents an amazing opportunity for a nurse practitioner or physician assistant with specialization in nephrology who has a big heart and entrepreneurial spirit and is committed to improving outcomes for people with chronic kidney disease.


Devoted Medical is building a next generation, value based, virtual-first CKD clinic that dramatically expands access to specialty care for America's most vulnerable seniors. The clinic will focus on delaying time to progression of CKD 4 and 5, and increasing the proportion of planned rather than emergency dialysis starts for Devoted Medical patients. The Chronic Kidney Disease Clinic is one of several of Devoted Medical’s virtual specialty care programs that are designed as “micro centers of excellence” that deliver highly tailored, specialized care to patients with specific chronic conditions– e.g. diabetes, congestive heart failure, hypertension, etc.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Your primary focus will be to deliver direct nephrology care to CKD patients to ensure medication optimization, manage electrolytes and volume status, facilitate shared decision making around goals of care, and ensure effective planning for vascular access or PD catheter placement for optimal dialysis initiation.
  • You will collaborate closely with other members of the nephrology care team including physicians, social workers, pharmacists, clinical assistants. You will interface closely with family members and caregivers to coordinate holistic care for the member, ensure continuity of care and deliver a collaborative care plan.
  • You will participate in regular panel review discussions to offer advice and provide guidance around medical management.
  • Perform comprehensive assessments including comprehensive diagnosis/disease review, medication review, and assessment for quality of care (STARS/HEDIS) interventions as well as social and home health/DME needs.
  • Utilize our home grown electronic health information system for visits while also providing feedback on how to improve the interface.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and ethical guidelines.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing professional development to stay current on best practices and advancements in kidney care.
  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Attributes to success:

  • Skilled NP or PA with thorough understanding of nephrology management including disease process, treatment modalities, medication management and lifestyle modification. Direct experience working in a nephrology practice and/or a dialysis center is a must.
  • You are experienced working on an interprofessional team and enjoy team-based care.
  • You have great clinical and non-clinical judgment.
  • You are thorough and take the time to address the needs of your patients.
  • You are deeply empathetic and humanistic, and want to go the last mile for your patients.
  • You enjoy a fast-paced, high-energy, organization. Agility and collaboration are key as we will change and improve quickly.
  • You welcome learning and using new technologies that are being developed in parallel. You thrive on knowing your work can help make these technologies better for you and your patients.
  • You learn from every experience and are not afraid to fail - that's how you're wired.
  • Finally and most importantly, you have a passion for making healthcare better, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

Skills and experience:

  • NP or PA with 5 or more years working in outpatient clinical practice.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a nephrology practice or dialysis unit required.
  • Proficiency in using telehealth technology and electronic health records (EHR).
  • Virtual care experience is preferred along with a strong desire to continue practicing clinical medicine and performing virtual visits.
  • An understanding of managed care is a plus, including how to appropriately assess STARS/HEDIS measures, code clinical comorbidities, and identify clinical care gaps.
  • Proficiency in Spanish is desired.

Licensure and Certification:

  • Must possess a current, active, and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license in at least one U.S. state.
  • Must be willing to obtain additional state licenses as required by the business. (We provide administrative assistance and cover 100% of the associated fees.)
  • Active BLS is required at time of hire and must be maintained while employed at Devoted Medical.

Salary Range: $120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

jobs.title: Purdue Global Vice President, Enrollment Management (Remote/Virtual, IN, US)
jobs.excerpt: Our Opportunity: Building on Purdue University's mission to provide greater access to affordable, high-quality education, Purdue University Global is a public, nonprofit institution offering a world-class education online.
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity:

Building on Purdue University's mission to provide greater access to affordable, high-quality education, Purdue University Global is a public, nonprofit institution offering a world-class education online. Purdue Global delivers personalized online education tailored to the unique needs of adults who have work or life experience beyond the classroom, enabling them to develop essential academic and professional skills with the support and flexibility they need to achieve their career goals.

The Vice President, Enrollment Management will provide support to Purdue University Global.

Job Summary:

Reporting to the Chief Enrollment and Partnerships Officer, the Vice President, Enrollment Management (VP of EM) leads Purdue Global's new student enrollment operation and is accountable for delivering new student academic starts each term. The role owns the student's path from the point Marketing hands off a qualified inquiry through the first-term add/drop period. This position serves working adult students in a fully online institution, with emphasis on providing an informed, supportive experience for those students; routinely achieving budget and start goals; and creating a positive work environment centered on collaboration, respect, student outcomes, and continuous improvement. The VP of EM will demonstrate a commitment to Purdue Global's land grant mission of access and can point to success serving a broad population of adult learners.

The VP of EM is responsible for all new student admission and enrollment services at Purdue Global, including application materials, document and transcript collection, transfer credit intake coordination, advisor training, metrics, policies, and processes. Purdue Global is a primarily open-admissions institution; where admission decisions are required, they reside with the academic schools, and the VP of EM ensures those decisions are supported and executed quickly and consistently.

The VP of EM has managerial responsibility for leading, developing, and continuously improving the enrollment management organization. Purdue Global is seeking a leader who has designed and built enrollment operations that produced measurable, repeatable results at scale, not only managed operations already in place. The VP of EM will work closely with Marketing to define and hold the handoff standard and to feed conversion performance back into demand generation decisions; with Student Success to ensure new students transition smoothly into classes and to define the handoff once a student is past add/drop; and with the Office of Strategic Partnerships to support the enrollment of students from military, nonprofit, community college, workforce development, and corporate partners.

The VP of EM will also be expected to remain at the forefront of the discipline by engaging with peers across the sector and bringing proven practice to Purdue Global, and will develop and maintain collaborative relationships with the senior team, academic leadership, faculty, staff, the Purdue University System and outside partners to ensure enrollment operations are integrated with, and reflective of, the work of our shared land grant mission.

What to expect in this role:

  • Enrollment operations and delivery of new student starts:
    • Own new student academic starts against plan each term, by population and by program.
    • Lead the admissions advising organization, including staffing, hiring, training, coaching, and quality assurance.
    • Own each stage of the funnel from Marketing handoff through admit, registration, start, and add/drop, including application completion, document and transcript collection, transfer credit intake coordination, and financial aid coordination.
    • Own speed to contact, speed to admit, speed to start, and melt between admit and start, and design the processes that improve them.
    • Own first-term engagement and intervention through the add/drop period, and maintain the handoff standard to Student Success.
    • Design and hold the qualified inquiry handoff standard with Marketing and ensure conversion results are reported back to inform channel and campaign decisions.
    • Ensure students arriving through partner channels receive an enrollment experience aligned to each partnership's terms.
    • Manage enrollment vendors and ensure compliance with internal and external policies, regulations, and other mandates.
  • Enrollment analytics, forecasting, and performance management:
    • Own the term-by-term start forecast, the staffing and capacity model, and the daily and weekly performance cadence for the operation.
    • Develop, manage, and report on funnel metrics and outcomes representative of student and institutional success.
    • Identify and track patterns, trends, and anomalies, and design and implement immediate operational responses.
    • Serve as the enrollment business owner for the CRM and related systems.
  • Admissions policy, process, and compliance:
    • Monitor compliance with the standards for admission and related policies and processes.
    • Ensure all recruitment and enrollment activity meets federal, state, accreditor, and university requirements, including Title IV and misrepresentation rules.
    • Oversee quality monitoring activities (reporting and responses) of adherence to policy, process, compliance standards, and best practice.
    • Collaborate with university stakeholders and vendors on the ongoing improvement of admissions policies and processes for improved student and institutional outcomes.
  • Team leadership and cross-functional partnership:
    • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing enrollment leadership team and advisor workforce.
    • Collaborate with Student Success, Financial Aid, the academic schools, and the Office of Strategic Partnerships to ensure a seamless, student-centered handling of issues that arise in the enrollment process.
    • Proactively identify improvement opportunities across enrollment systems, processes, and procedures, and present findings and recommendations to leadership.
    • Manage operational resources and the enrollment budget.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Experience:

  • Master's degree in a related field from an accredited institution of higher learning.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in enrollment management or a similar field, with at least 5 years leading a large online or adult-serving admissions and enrollment operation.
  • Equivalent combination of education and/or experience may substitute for minimum education or experience requirements.
  • Significant experience working with adult learners in a wholly online environment, and a strong record of success working collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated record of designing and building enrollment models, processes, and teams that delivered new student starts against plan across multiple terms and years, at meaningful scale.

What we're looking for:

  • Extensive knowledge of enrollment management theory and practice, with demonstrated success increasing new student enrollment and persistence through the first term.
  • Demonstrated success leveraging digital marketing and optimizing conversion in a demand-generation marketing environment.
  • Fluency in funnel analytics, forecasting, and capacity planning, and comfort being challenged on the numbers.
  • Experience as the business owner of an enrollment CRM, including process design and configuration decisions.
  • Working knowledge of Title IV, state authorization, and admissions compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated skills in program development and planning, re-engineering processes and procedures, and formulating and revising policy at an institution of higher learning.
  • Demonstrated success building, developing, and maintaining an effective enrollment management team.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with university stakeholders, including academic leadership, faculty, students, and partners.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills and the ability to present effectively to stakeholders at multiple levels within and outside the university.
  • Demonstrated management of operational resources within budget.
  • Experience serving military, employer-sponsored, and transfer populations preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office suite software, such as MS Word, Excel and Powerpoint, as well as Google applications such as Gmail, Chat and Meet.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Additional Information:

  • The target salary is $230,000. The final salary offer will be determined based on various factors, including internal equity, available budget, and relevant experience.Learn about our Benefits HERE!
  • Please note that this is a remote position.
  • Purdue will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.
  • This is a U.S.-based position. This position is open to candidates who reside and are authorized to work in the United States.
  • A background check is required for employment in this position.
  • We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. You may wish to review the Purdue Virtual Meeting Professional Standards.
  • FLSA: Exempt (Not Eligible for Overtime) This position is generally classified as exempt unless a non-exempt classification is required by applicable state law.
  • Purdue Global is an EO/EA employer. Our goal is to recruit and retain talent from a broad pool of applicants. Purdue Global celebrates a variety of perspectives, experiences, and skills to support a success-focused environment for employees and students. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. All are encouraged to apply.

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role

We have a well established technical writing team, and are evolving our approach to content at JumpCloud. We are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to lead, scale, and optimize our product and developer documentation. In this role, you won't just write—you will act as an information architect and workflow innovator.

You will leverage cutting-edge AI documentation tools, prompt engineering, and modern automation to streamline content creation. Your goal is to keep our documentation technically accurate, end user focused, and optimized for both human readers and AI retrieval systems (RAG/chatbots).

Key Responsibilities :

    Docs-as-Code & Version Control Management

  • GitHub Native Workflow: Manage documentation using standard developer tools—drafting in Markdown, managing branches, opening Pull Requests (PRs), and conducting code reviews in GitHub.

  • Continuous Publishing: Integrate into automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Static Site Generators (e.g., Docusaurus, MkDocs, Hugo).

  • Maintain strict version control across multiple product releases, API versions, and branch merges.

    • Content Generation & In-App User Guidance

  • Author, edit, and maintain clear, accurate end user documentation (API references, developer guides, user how to’s, configuration guides, and release notes) for IT admins and their teams.

  • Cross-collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product Managers, and Designers to translate UX designs, and technical specs into intuitive content.

  • UX Writing: Work with Design to provide copy and improve UX prototypes.

  • Manage Rolling Product Releases: We have continuous releases meaning teams push new features and updates any time throughout the quarter. You should feel comfortable managing and prioritizing 15-20 feature/update releases during a quarter.

  • Conduct rigorous technical validation: Test feature flags in the product, API endpoints, run sample code, and verify UI flows before publishing.

  • In-App Engagement: Design, deploy, and manage in-app onboarding flows, tooltips, and release announcements using Pendo (or similar platforms like Appcues/WalkMe).

    • AI Tooling & Workflow Optimization

  • Prompt Engineering: Design, test, and standardize custom prompts and prompt templates to accelerate process, information architecture, media, and content reformatting.

  • AI-Assisted Efficiency: Integrate AI assistants into daily workflows to drastically reduce time spent on repetitive tasks (e.g., generating initial drafts, converting legacy docs, auditing terminology etc).

  • Human Quality Control: Act as the final filter for AI-generated outputs, rigorously auditing content for technical accuracy, brand tone, hallucinations, and security compliance.

Requirements & Qualifications :

  • Experience: 4-7+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Engineer, or Product Content Strategy Specialist in a SaaS or tech environment.

  • GitHub & Docs-as-Code (Required): Proven mastery of GitHub (PRs, code reviews, branch management), Markdown, and Static Site Generators within a Docs-as-Code pipeline.

  • AI & Prompting Fluency: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants, etc) and a working knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.

  • Technical Depth: Ability to quickly contribute to the platform and new features quickly given highly technical, and nuanced specifications.

  • Critical Thinking: Strong editorial judgment. We want you to be able to catch subtle hallucinations, out-of-date parameters, or security risks in AI assisted drafts.

  • In-App Notification Tools (Required): Hands-on, demonstrated experience building and targeting in-app messaging, guides, and analytics using Pendo (or comparable tools like Appcues, Userpilot, WalkMe).

Additional Qualifications We Value :

  • Experience using Pendo to track documentation consumption and guide completion rates.

  • Experience training and refining AI models on internal style guides and technical glossaries.

  • Background in API design or developer-focused content strategy.

  • Ability to create JSON scripts.

    • Kindly share your portfolio while applying for the role. This can include documentation samples, AI prompts, demo video or video recordings of using AI to improve a process, examples of in-app notifications/announcements or onboarding flows, Git repositories etc.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Job Summary

The System Administrator is a hands-on, technical role that owns the day-to-day administration, security, performance, and reliability of our Microsoft Azure environment, with a heavy emphasis on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and FSLogix profile management. They must have an excellent understanding of IT infrastructure (both cloud and on-premise) and a demonstrated willingness to learn and apply new technology. They must also have a proven ability to handle multiple priorities with limited supervision and possess a high level of discipline while remaining flexible.

As we transition away from a Managed Service Provider (MSP) model in order to manage our Azure environment internally, this role is central to that transition and will be responsible for our Azure environment once operations are brought in-house — leading knowledge transfer from the MSP, documenting and standing up internal processes and runbooks, and then operating and continuously improving the environment as its primary administrator.

  • Administer and tune FSLogix profile and Office containers, including container storage on Azure Files/Azure NetApp Files, permissions, redirections and exclusions, and remediation of container corruption, bloat, and profile performance issues

  • Provide senior-level escalation support for helpdesk tickets and end-user issues across multiple locations and remote users

jobs.excerpt: Why should you consider joining Auvik? • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.
jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built—our latest NPS was 57 (phenomenal!). Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.


What’s this role about?

Hold the torch high! As a business development representative, you’ll play an integral role in Auvik’s success and growth, using your energy, smarts, resourcefulness, and charisma to develop sales opportunities. Excel in this role and there’s a clear growth path to Auvik account executive.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be responsible for identifying, qualifying, researching, and warming up prospective buyers for our network management software. Every day, you will focus on:

  • Researching and developing business intelligence for new and existing accounts
  • Conducting high-level conversations with senior executives
  • Delivering compelling explanations of Auvik’s capabilities to prospects
  • Achieving your monthly quota of qualified opportunities and meetings attended
  • Evangelizing Auvik’s network management software
  • Generating new business opportunities to fuel Auvik’s growth

What are we looking for?

  • A people person, with a friendly and positive manner, who loves the thought of getting paid to have conversations
  • The ability to quickly build rapport with almost anyone
  • Great communication skills, both verbally and in writing
  • Solid internet research skills
  • A passion for learning new things quickly and a strong technical aptitude
  • A tenacious self-starter with a drive to succeed
  • Post-secondary education in any field

Are there bonus points?

Yes! We’ll give your application extra credit if you have one or more of these:

  • Experience in any type of sales, business development, or fundraising role
  • Knowledge of Salesforce

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.


About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well. Don't have a working webcam? We will help you find a space you can conduct your interview from Have kids or pets in the background? Don’t worry about it. Just let us know what you need when we reach out to schedule and we will make it work!

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.
