jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Motorola Solutions Command Center Software Customer Success team plays a critical role in realizing Motorola Solutions’ mission to connect people in the moments that matter. Our team ensures that the Command Center Software portfolio delivers measurable value to public safety agencies and enterprises by driving deep product adoption, workflow optimization, and long-term customer loyalty.

Within this organization, Customer Success Advocates focus on acting as trusted advisors who align Motorola Solutions’ capabilities with each customer’s strategic priorities. Our team use data, product expertise, and a deep understanding of customer operations to guide stakeholders through advanced use cases, maximize the impact of our mission-critical solutions, and strengthen multi-year partnerships.

We partner closely with Sales, Product, Deployment, and Support teams across Motorola Solutions to translate our mission-critical technology into outcomes that protect communities and streamline operations. By being customer-obsessed and data-informed, the Customer Success organization helps customers fully integrate our solutions into daily operations, maximize their investment, and advocate for Motorola Solutions.


Job Description

We are looking for a scrappy, highly resourceful Video Content Manager to join our growing Customer Success team and own our short-form video and motion graphics production. Our customers are asking for fast, visually engaging, bite-sized content to help them onboard and adopt our product—and you will be our dedicated expert making that happen.

In this role, you’ll partner with our Campaign Strategists, Enablement leads, and CSAs to elevate our existing enablement ecosystem. Your main focus is converting customer touchpoints into high-impact, short-form video assets (15–90 seconds) and motion graphics that fit into automated email sequences, in-app guides, digital communities content and digital customer journeys. This position operates fully remotely across Latin America, though candidates based in Bogota, Colombia are highly preferred for team colocation purposes.


Because we operate in a fast-moving environment, you won't just follow static briefs—you will take ownership, solve problems, and help us refine our operational baseline for video production in scaled digital Customer Success.


What You’ll Do

  • Fuel Our Omnichannel Journeys: Work with our Campaign Strategist to turn customer journey blueprints into creative and clear video assets for key lifecycle moments (onboarding and adoption).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the visual bridge between CS and Marketing, ensuring video and motion content aligns with current product positioning and brand guidelines while staying utility-focused for customer success.
  • Outcome-Based Video Design: Ensure every video or motion asset is designed to drive a specific, measurable user action or product milestone—not just sit in a video library. Every action should be tied to a clear impact or outcome.
  • Own Short-Form Video & Motion Production: Script, record, edit, and animate concise, high-retention video content tailored for digital CS channels. This includes micro-learning reels, feature spotlights, UI walkthroughs, and small animated GIFs.
  • Trend & Data Monitoring: Track engagement metrics (completion rates, drop-offs, feature activation post-view) alongside customer and media trends to continuously refine our video formats.
  • Build Our Video Production Engine: Establish internal visual asset libraries, motion graphics templates, and streamlined editing workflows so our CS team can scale visual content fast. You will execute simple, effective animations inspired by best-in-class examples from companies like Adobe, Wistia, Figma, Slack, Pendo, Bitly, and Asana.
  • AI-Powered Workflow Efficiency: Leverage generative AI and automation tools (e.g., AI script generation, synthetic voice/audio enhancement, rapid editing, and generative asset design) to accelerate production cycles, iterate rapidly on video variants, and elevate content quality.


Basic Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years creating short-form video content, micro-learning clips, or motion graphics for tech or B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Portfolio: A proven portfolio demonstrating your video creation and motion graphics capabilities is mandatory.
  • Education: A bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required.
  • Location & Travel: The role is remote across Latin America. You must possess an active US visa to enable travel to the United States approximately once every 6 months for team meetings.
  • Language Proficiency: Full English proficiency is an absolute must, as this role involves presenting directly to US-based product managers.
  • Core Technical Stack: Proficiency with industry-standard editing software, strictly including Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, is mandatory.
  • Short-Form Storytelling: Demonstrated ability to script, record, edit, and animate high-retention, utility-focused video assets under 90 seconds (UI walkthroughs, feature spotlights, micro-learning reels).

Preferred Requirements

  • Domain Knowledge: Prior experience creating content or training materials for Public Safety, emergency response, or government tech sectors is highly desired.
  • Marketing Alignment: Background or prior experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or customer success serves as a strong plus.
  • Supplementary Tools: Familiarity with screen recording and hosting tools like Wistia (preferred) or Camtasia.
  • Graphic Design Capabilities: Hands-on experience with design tools outside of video editing software (e.g., Figma, Canva, or Adobe Illustrator/InDesign) to create custom supporting visual assets.
  • AI Tool Familiarity: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate video production workflows.
  • Process & System Building: Proven track record of building internal video production engines from scratch, including creating visual asset libraries, motion graphics templates, and scalable editing workflows.
  • Data & Analytics Literacy: Experience tracking and interpreting video engagement metrics (e.g., completion rates, post-view feature activation) to measure ROI and continuously refine content strategy.
  • Cross-Functional Enablement Experience: Prior experience collaborating directly with Customer Success, Campaign Strategists, or Enablement leads to map video assets into automated customer journeys and in-app triggers.



Travel Requirements

Under 10%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Tier 0 ServiceNow Administrator / Self-Service Specialist to manage and improve self-service capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Tier 0 ServiceNow Administrator / Self-Service Specialist to manage and improve self-service capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position administers the ServiceNow self-service experience, service catalog, knowledge content, ticket-routing rules, approved workflows, dashboards, and automation used to help customers resolve common issues or submit accurate service requests.

The Tier 0 ServiceNow Administrator / Self-Service Specialist works with the Service Desk, ITSM process owners, technical support teams, and Government stakeholders to convert recurring incidents and requests into reusable knowledge, guided self-service experiences, and approved automated resolutions. The position uses service data and customer behavior to identify opportunities to reduce avoidable tickets, improve routing accuracy, accelerate resolution, and strengthen the overall customer experience.

This role requires a combination of ServiceNow platform administration, service-desk knowledge, workflow analysis, technical writing, and continual improvement. The successful candidate will ensure that self-service capabilities are accurate, accessible, supportable, and aligned with Government-approved processes.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Tier 0 ServiceNow Administrator / Self-Service Specialist will:

  • Administer and maintain approved ServiceNow Tier 0 and customer self-service capabilities.
  • Configure and maintain the ServiceNow self-service portal or employee-facing service experience.
  • Maintain service-catalog items, record producers, request forms, variables, categories, descriptions, and fulfillment information.
  • Configure and maintain approved ticket-routing rules, assignment logic, notifications, and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure incidents and requests submitted through self-service channels are correctly categorized, prioritized, assigned, and routed.
  • Maintain approved workflows and automations supporting common service requests and recurring technical issues.
  • Coordinate with ServiceNow developers or platform engineers when a requested enhancement requires custom development, integration, or advanced scripting.
  • Work with technical support teams to identify recurring incidents that can be addressed through knowledge articles, guided troubleshooting, automation, or improved service-catalog content.
  • Convert technical procedures and subject-matter expert input into clear, reusable customer guidance.
  • Create, revise, publish, and retire knowledge articles in accordance with approved knowledge-management processes.
  • Maintain article ownership, review dates, version history, approvals, metadata, categories, keywords, and related content.
  • Review knowledge articles for accuracy, readability, consistency, security, accessibility, and customer usefulness.
  • Ensure self-service content does not expose sensitive system, security, operational, or personally identifiable information.
  • Monitor knowledge gaps and recommend new content based on incident trends, customer searches, unsuccessful searches, repeated requests, and technician feedback.
  • Link relevant knowledge articles and self-service guidance to incidents, requests, catalog items, and automated responses.
  • Develop reusable troubleshooting guides, frequently asked questions, decision trees, job aids, and guided-resolution content.
  • Configure and maintain ServiceNow dashboards and reports supporting Tier 0 and self-service performance.
  • Track self-service adoption, knowledge use, ticket deflection, search effectiveness, routing accuracy, request completion, abandonment, reassignment, and resolution trends.
  • Analyze tickets that were incorrectly routed or submitted with incomplete information and improve the associated forms, instructions, or assignment rules.
  • Identify high-volume, repetitive, and low-complexity requests that may be suitable for approved automation.
  • Document proposed workflow and automation changes, including business requirements, expected outcomes, dependencies, risks, and acceptance criteria.
  • Configure approved changes within authorized ServiceNow environments and established access boundaries.
  • Develop and execute test cases for catalog items, forms, routing rules, workflows, notifications, dashboards, and self-service functionality.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing with technical teams, service owners, process owners, and Government stakeholders.
  • Document test results, defects, corrective actions, approvals, release notes, and implementation outcomes.
  • Support the controlled release of approved self-service and workflow enhancements.
  • Validate functionality following releases, upgrades, patches, configuration changes, and platform maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot ServiceNow issues affecting knowledge, catalog items, customer submissions, workflows, routing, dashboards, and notifications.
  • Maintain configuration documentation, administration procedures, workflow diagrams, data definitions, and operating guides.
  • Follow established change-management, release-management, configuration-management, security, and quality-assurance processes.
  • Coordinate with the Service Desk Lead to ensure Tier 0 capabilities align with current operational procedures and escalation paths.
  • Coordinate with incident, request, problem, knowledge, service-level, change, and continual-improvement process owners.
  • Support problem-management activities by converting approved known errors and workarounds into searchable self-service guidance.
  • Gather feedback from users and service-desk personnel regarding the clarity and effectiveness of self-service content.
  • Recommend improvements to ServiceNow usability, search, navigation, forms, catalog structure, workflows, dashboards, and knowledge presentation.
  • Develop Tier 0 and self-service metrics for operational reports, Monthly Status Reports, and program reviews.
  • Provide training, demonstrations, and administrative guidance to content owners, service-desk personnel, and other authorized users.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience in ServiceNow administration, IT service management, service-desk operations, self-service delivery, knowledge management, or a related technical environment.
  • Current ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
  • Hands-on experience administering or configuring ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Experience maintaining self-service portals, service catalogs, knowledge articles, ticket-routing rules, approved workflows, or operational dashboards.
  • Experience translating recurring technical issues into reusable guidance, standardized service requests, or automated resolutions.
  • Experience gathering requirements and coordinating with technical teams, process owners, and operational stakeholders.

Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

Today, worldwide more than +11000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Bruker’s Microbiology & Infection Diagnostics (BMID) business is a global leader in infectious disease diagnostics, helping clinical laboratories deliver faster, more accurate results that improve patient care. Our MALDI Biotyper® platform has become the worldwide benchmark for microbial identification, enabling laboratories to rapidly identify pathogens and support timely clinical decision-making. Building on this leadership, Bruker continues to expand its portfolio with innovative solutions designed to accelerate diagnosis and optimize treatment of serious infections, including new technologies for sepsis management.

Driven by a commitment to provide life-saving technologies, Bruker empowers healthcare professionals with actionable diagnostic insights when time matters most. We are equally committed to supporting the global fight against antimicrobial resistance (AMR) through rapid identification, advanced susceptibility testing solutions, and stewardship-enabling technologies that help ensure patients receive the right therapy sooner while preserving the effectiveness of antibiotics for future generations.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Database and Application Support Engineer will diagnose database outages, application dependencies, connection failures, unavailable services, certificate problems, and API-related issues. This role will troubleshoot incidents across database, application, middleware, server, network, cloud, and security components.

The engineer will coordinate response activities with Task 4 enterprise IT operations personnel and work with Task 7 software teams when resolution requires application-code analysis or correction. This position focuses on production support, infrastructure integration, recovery, testing, and operational coordination rather than serving as the primary application developer.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Database and Application Support Engineer will:

  • Monitor and support the availability, performance, health, and recoverability of enterprise databases and applications.
  • Review operational alerts, service failures, database errors, application errors, performance degradation, and user-reported issues.
  • Diagnose database availability issues, failed services, connection failures, authentication problems, resource constraints, and performance issues.
  • Analyze application dependencies across databases, servers, services, middleware, APIs, certificates, networks, cloud platforms, storage, and external interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot database listeners, connection strings, connection pools, ports, drivers, service accounts, permissions, and network paths.
  • Investigate failed database connections, application timeouts, unavailable services, transaction errors, and data-access problems.
  • Review database, application, middleware, operating-system, web-server, API, and network logs to isolate faults.
  • Use monitoring data, alerts, logs, metrics, and traces to identify the source and scope of service disruptions.
  • Diagnose certificate expiration, trust-chain, hostname, binding, private-key, protocol, and encryption-related failures.
  • Support certificate installation, renewal, replacement, validation, and troubleshooting for applications, databases, APIs, and supporting services.
  • Diagnose REST, SOAP, API gateway, endpoint, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and connectivity issues.
  • Validate dependencies among APIs, backend services, databases, certificates, identity providers, and network controls.
  • Support approved relational database platforms and associated management, monitoring, backup, and recovery tools.
  • Support application servers, web servers, middleware, schedulers, integration services, background services, and runtime components.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving database or application degradation and service outages.
  • Perform technical triage, gather diagnostic information, and support implementation of approved mitigation and recovery actions.
  • Support development and validation of temporary workarounds when complete restoration cannot be achieved immediately.
  • Maintain incident timelines covering symptoms, technical findings, actions, dependencies, communications, and restoration results.
  • Escalate complex database, application, API, certificate, infrastructure, or code-related issues to senior engineers and responsible technical teams.
  • Coordinate with Task 4 operations teams on infrastructure, server, network, cloud, storage, certificate, identity, and platform issues.
  • Coordinate with Task 7 software teams when incidents require application-code review, defect correction, build changes, or software releases.
  • Provide logs, traces, error details, reproduction steps, configuration information, and impact assessments to software teams.
  • Support testing and validation of application-code corrections in applicable nonproduction and production environments.
  • Confirm that implemented corrections resolve the reported issue without negatively affecting application availability, integrations, or dependencies.
  • Support root-cause analysis and document technical findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and preventive recommendations.
  • Track assigned post-incident corrective actions through completion.
  • Support database, application, middleware, server, appliance, and supporting-component upgrades and refreshes.
  • Execute approved implementation plans, upgrade procedures, test steps, validation criteria, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Perform pre-implementation and post-implementation checks of database and application availability, connectivity, functionality, and performance.
  • Support backup, restoration, replication, failover, failback, high-availability, and disaster-recovery activities.
  • Validate database and application recovery following outages, maintenance, migrations, restorations, or continuity events.
  • Test service dependencies and end-to-end transaction paths after restoration or component upgrades.
  • Support capacity, performance, availability, and resource-utilization analysis.
  • Apply or coordinate approved operating-system, database, middleware, application, vendor, firmware, and security updates.
  • Support remediation of vulnerabilities, IAVAs, CND Directives, POA&M items, and security-control deficiencies.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, configuration, release, availability, and service-continuity processes.
  • Maintain database and application dependency diagrams, interface records, certificate inventories, configuration documentation, recovery procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Identify recurring issues, dependency risks, obsolete components, certificate risks, and potential points of failure.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant database support, application support, systems engineering, production operations, or enterprise IT experience.
  • Demonstrated experience diagnosing database availability, application dependencies, connection failures, services, certificates, and API-related outages.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise databases and applications in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS relational database services, Azure SQL, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with database clustering, replication, backup, restoration, failover, high availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience supporting application servers, middleware, web servers, integration platforms, schedulers, and background services.
  • Experience with Microsoft Internet Information Services, Apache, Tomcat, WebLogic, JBoss, .NET, Java, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting REST, SOAP, API gateway, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and endpoint-connectivity issues.
  • Experience supporting TLS certificates, trust stores, keystores, certificate bindings, and Public Key Infrastructure dependencies.
  • Experience using application-performance monitoring, database monitoring, logging, tracing, observability, and event-management tools.
  • Experience supporting production outages, incident bridges, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
  • Experience coordinating operational issues among infrastructure engineers, database administrators, application owners, and software-development teams.
  • Experience gathering logs, traces, reproduction steps, technical findings, and impact information for code-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience validating component upgrades, software releases, database changes, application fixes, and recovery procedures.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs and supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, vulnerability-remediation, and POA&M requirements.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform for incident, problem, change, configuration, and release management.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, SQL, Bash, or other scripting and query languages used for diagnostics and automation.
  • Database, cloud, middleware, application-server, or ITIL certifications.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and team-collaboration skills.
  • Ability to support after-hours outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities when required.

  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. Experience translating cloud networking practice into service provider environments is a strong advantage.

This role is based in North America.

  • Deep working knowledge of optical and IP networking architectures across DCI, metro and long-haul

  • Track record of converting a technical architecture position into a customer investment decision

Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

jobs.excerpt: Reports To: Chief of Staff, CPO’s Office Location: India (Remote) About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
Reports To: Chief of Staff, CPO’s Office
Location: India (Remote)

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role:

We’re hiring an Employee Experience & Internal Events Lead to design and deliver programs, communications, and experiences that strengthen connection, recognition, and culture across HighLevel’s global, remote-first workforce.

You’ll own the employee experience portfolio, including flagship internal events, recognition, gifting, employee campaigns, and culture-building initiatives. You’ll be responsible not just for strong ideas, but for turning those ideas into high-quality execution that feels distinctly HighLevel.

This is a senior, hands-on operator role. You’ll own the portfolio and personally execute meaningful work across strategy, planning, communications, vendor management, budgets, program design, and delivery, while also directing support from specialists, seasonal staff, agencies, and vendors. You should be equally comfortable shaping an initiative and experience concept, writing compelling employee communications, building a detailed event plan, solving an attendee issue onsite, and improving the process before the next cycle.

You’ll work closely with the Chief of Staff, Marketing, Finance, Legal, People Operations, and leaders across the business to create experiences employees want to participate in and remember.

What You'll Do:

Employee Experience

  • Own the Strategy for Employee Programs and Initiatives: Own the strategy for employee Programs and initiatives, recognition, and events aligned with HighLevel’s culture, values, and business priorities.
  • Design Culture Defining Experiences: Create programs and initiatives that strengthen connection, recognition, belonging, and pride across a remote and distributed workforce.
  • Build the Employee Experience Calendar: Own the annual calendar of employee experiences, recognition moments, campaigns, events, and cultural activations.
  • Drive Participation & Community: Develop creative ways to increase employee participation and create momentum around programs before, during, and after launch.
  • Measure What Resonates: Track program participation and feedback, and partner with the org effectiveness team to understand how programs connect to broader engagement results.

Signature Internal Events

  • Deliver Best-in-Class Internal Events: Lead end-to-end strategy and execution for Leadership Kickoff, HighLevel’s 1,700–2,000 person Global Retreat, and other flagship internal employee events.
  • Bring HighLevel’s Culture to Life: Ensure every internal event reflects our culture, brand, and values through the programming, environment, communications, content, and details.
  • Own the Employee Attendee Journey: Design the full attendee journey from the first announcement through travel, onsite participation, and post-event follow-up.
  • Lead Agencies & Vendors: Manage event agencies and partners across venues, production, A/V, travel, hotels, transportation, catering, and other internal event services.
  • Own Event Readiness & Execution: Build detailed plans, manage budgets and risks, establish readiness checkpoints, and lead onsite delivery and escalations for internal events.

Employee Communications & Storytelling

  • Write Employee Communications: Draft clear, compelling communications for events, recognition, employee programs, employee campaigns, and culture initiatives.
  • Build Excitement & Adoption: Create communications that do more than inform; they should generate interest, participation, and emotional connection.
  • Partner on Broader Internal Communications: Work closely with the Chief of Staff on company-wide messaging, executive communications, and channel strategy while owning communications for the programs in your portfolio.
  • Tell the Story of HighLevel’s Culture: Capture and share the moments, employee stories, and outcomes that bring HighLevel’s culture to life.

Social & Community Engagement

  • Leverage Social Channels: Use internal and external social media thoughtfully to amplify employee experiences, recognition, events, and culture in partnership with Marketing and Internal Communications.
  • Create Shareable Moments: Design events and programs with storytelling and social amplification in mind.
  • Activate Employee Voices: Identify opportunities for employees and leaders to authentically share their stories and celebrate the HighLevel community.
  • Stay Current on Engagement Trends: Bring fresh ideas from employee experience, events, social media, and community building into HighLevel’s programs.

Operational Excellence

  • Build Repeatable Playbooks: Create strong processes, SOPs, run-of-show documents, vendor briefs, and reusable frameworks for every major program.
  • Continuously Improve: Use employee feedback, participation, cost, and operational data to improve programs, vendors, and events each cycle.
  • Use AI & Automation: Apply AI and automation to improve planning, communications, attendee support, reporting, and repetitive workflows.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ Years of Relevant Experience: Progressive experience in employee engagement and culture programs, internal events, program management, or a related field, ideally in a high-growth or global organization.
  • Hands-On Operator: You’re comfortable moving between strategy and detailed execution, personally driving critical work while knowing when and how to leverage specialists, seasonal staff, agencies, and vendors.
  • Best-in-Class Internal Event Experience: Proven experience leading complex, multi-day corporate events through agency and vendor partners, with strong instincts for creating experiences that reflect company culture.
  • Employee Experience & Engagement Expertise: A track record of designing programs that strengthen connection, recognition, belonging, participation, and employee pride.
  • Strong Writing & Storytelling: You can write clear, compelling employee and event communications that inform, build excitement, and drive participation.
  • Social & Community Savvy: You understand how to use social media and community-building tactics to amplify employee programs, recognition, and culture in thoughtful, authentic ways.
  • Excellent Program Management: You can manage multiple interconnected workstreams, timelines, dependencies, budgets, risks, and stakeholders without losing momentum.
  • Vendor & Agency Leadership: Experience selecting, briefing, managing, and holding external partners accountable for scope, quality, service, timing, and cost.
  • Creative Judgment: You have strong instincts for what will feel engaging, memorable, and on-brand, while still being practical and scalable.
  • Global Mindset: You design with different countries, cultures, time zones, accessibility needs, and employee populations in mind.
  • Collaborative Influence: You work effectively across Internal Communications, Marketing, Finance, Legal, People Operations, and business leadership without relying on formal authority.
  • Builder Mindset: You’re energized by creating structure, fixing broken processes, and building repeatable programs and playbooks that improve with each cycle.
  • Customer Obsession & Empathy: You notice the details that create friction or delight and consistently design around the employee as your customer.
  • Comfort With Ambiguity: You can take an incomplete idea, create structure around it, make sound decisions, and drive it toward a clear outcome.
  • Availability: Able to overlap with US Eastern hours as needed and travel internationally for flagship internal events.

Why This Role Matters

In a global, remote-first company, the moments that bring people together have to be intentionally designed. Events, recognition, and shared rituals are a meaningful part of how employees connect with HighLevel’s culture.

This role turns that experience into action. You’ll create and execute programs, communications, and best-in-class internal events that feel distinctly HighLevel, while building the systems and playbooks that make them scalable and repeatable.

Your impact will be visible across the employee journey: stronger participation, more memorable moments, clearer communication, better recognition, and programs that help employees feel connected to the company and to each other.

jobs.title: Business Development Sales Representative (SDA101926)
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About the Role

Sales Development Advisor

Job Summary:

SelectQuote is seeking experienced, driven, resilient, and results-oriented sales professionals to join our Qualifications Team as a Sales Development Advisor (SDA).

The SDA is an unlicensed, outbound sales position responsible for contacting prospective customers, generating interest in SelectQuote's products, understanding customer needs, overcoming objections, and transferring qualified prospects to a licensed insurance agent.

This is not a customer service role. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven sales position. Successful candidates must be comfortable making hundreds of outbound calls each day, working from established scripts and processes, handling rejection, and consistently working toward performance goals.

This role provides paid training, a base salary plus bonus opportunity, and a potential career path into a licensed sales agent position. After demonstrating success in the role, SelectQuote will provide opportunities to enter a sales training program and assist with obtaining an insurance license.

Candidates who currently hold an insurance license will not be considered for this position.

After applying, qualified candidates will receive a phone call to complete our pre-screening questionnaire.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers, with activity of up to 800 calls per day.
  • Generate interest and create meaningful engagement with prospective customers.
  • Quickly establish rapport and communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

  • Identify customer needs and qualify prospects for transfer to a licensed insurance agent.

  • Handle and overcome objections, stalls, hesitation, and rejection throughout the sales conversation.

  • Confidently redirect conversations and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

  • Follow established sales scripts, processes, and instructions while maintaining a natural and engaging conversation.

  • Meet or exceed monthly transfer, contact-to-transfer, and other performance goals.

  • Accept coaching and demonstrate the ability to apply feedback to improve sales performance.

  • Work effectively with multiple monitors, software applications, and phone systems.

  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, productivity, and performance.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 1 year of telesales, inside sales, phone sales, or comparable sales experience required.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-volume, metrics-driven or commission-based sales environment preferred.

  • Demonstrated success working toward quotas, KPIs, conversion goals, or other measurable sales objectives.

  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills.

  • Confident, energetic, and conversational phone presence.

  • Strong active listening and communication skills.

  • Ability to follow scripts and established sales processes.

  • Ability to accept coaching and implement feedback.

  • Professional and reliable work habits.

  • Consistent employment history and demonstrated commitment to previous roles preferred.

  • Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain significant employment gaps, frequent job changes, or positions not reflected on their resume.

  • Current insurance licenses are not eligible for this position.

Compensation & Career Growth:

  • Paid training.

  • Base salary plus bonus opportunity.

  • Average first-year earnings of approximately $50,000, with top producers earning $80,000+.

  • Potential opportunity to enter SelectQuote's sales training program after six months of successful performance.

  • SelectQuote will support successful associates in pursuing an insurance license and progressing into a licensed sales role.

This Role Is a Good Fit for You If:

  • You have a genuine sales mindset and enjoy influencing customers toward a next step.
  • You are comfortable making a very high volume of outbound calls every day.
  • You don't get discouraged by rejection.
  • You can confidently handle "I'm not interested," "I need to think about it," and other common objections.
  • You enjoy working toward quotas, KPIs, and measurable sales goals.
  • You are comfortable using a sales script and can make it sound natural rather than robotic.
  • You can follow a structured sales process while still actively listening and responding to the customer.
  • You are competitive and motivated by improving your numbers.
  • You can stay engaged and energetic through repetitive, high-volume work.
  • You take coaching seriously and can demonstrate changes based on feedback.
  • You can provide specific examples of your past sales performance and accomplishments.
  • You are looking for a long-term sales career, with the potential to progress into a licensed sales role.
  • You are dependable and prepared to consistently work your assigned schedule.

This Role May Not Be a Good Fit for You If:

  • You are primarily looking for a customer service position.

  • You are primarily interested in working from home for flexibility rather than pursuing a sales career.

  • You dislike scripted sales environments or are unwilling to follow established sales processes.

  • You prefer conversations without sales goals, quotas, or performance expectations.

  • You become uncomfortable when customers object, hesitate, or say no.

  • You have difficulty redirecting a conversation or moving a prospect toward the next step.

  • You struggle to maintain energy and engagement during repetitive phone interactions.

  • You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • You prefer not to be coached or change your approach based on feedback.

  • You cannot provide specific examples of your sales accomplishments or performance.

  • You are unable to commit consistently to a set schedule, attendance expectations, and the demands of a full-time sales position.

Work-From-Home Requirements:

This is a full-time W-2 work-from-home position with an assigned schedule.

Employees must:

  • Be punctual and consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and attendance requirements.

  • Have a quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions.

  • Have reliable high-speed internet with minimum speeds of 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload through a hardwired connection.

  • Be able to remain fully engaged and available throughout scheduled work hours.

  • Be willing to work overtime, weekends, or schedule variations when business needs require it.

SelectQuote Core Values:

Service — We create positive customer experiences.
Entrepreneurship — We create, innovate, and take risks.
Leadership — We build and invest in high-performing teams.
Empowerment — We embrace a changing environment.
Courage — We challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.
Teamwork — We help, support, and celebrate each other.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements.

jobs.description:
Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • EST: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • PH Time: 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

Australian Christian College (ACC) is a non-denominational, Christian Education organisation, whose mission is to develop each and every student to be equipped spiritually, academically, socially and physically to flourish into their full potential, and be a positive influence on the world around them. ACC is wholeheartedly committed to excellence in education so that students are “well known, well loved, and well taught” by dedicated trained Christian staff.

ACC is part of Christian Education Ministries (CEM), with 17 schools in 5 states, and is also the largest non-government Distance Education provider in Australia.

About ACC Victoria Online

ACC Victoria Online is located at our ACC Casey campus in Cranbourne South (45 minutes south of Melbourne) and delivers online schooling from Year 5-11 in 2026. For more information please visit our website

We’re praying for the right staff to come and join this growing team for the exciting opportunities in ACC.

Statement of Commitment to Child Safety & Wellbeing

  • ACC Victoria Ltd is a child safe organisation that welcomes all children, young people and their families.
  • We are committed to providing environments where our students are safe and feel safe, where their participation is valued, their views respected, and their voices are heard about decisions that affect their lives. Core Responsibilities & Duties

  • Competent in the use of ICT learning platforms, in particular, Canvas;

The role requires strong curriculum judgement, careful organisation, confidence with digital learning tools, and a commitment to producing work that is accurate, consistent and ready for delivery.

About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

jobs.description:
Build & Release Support Engineer – CI/CD

Location: Remote | Time Zone: (US, Canada, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico) (8AM–5PM Pacific)

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company delivering large-scale cloud, data, and engineering solutions across 130+ countries. We partner with some of the world’s largest organizations to help them build, operate, and scale internal platforms used by tens of thousands of engineers.

For this role, you will be supporting one of the most advanced internal developer platforms in the world, powering products used by hundreds of millions of people. The problems you will solve are deep, complex, and essential to keeping a global-scale organization moving.

About Virtasant

Freedom to Grow. Power to Deliver.At Virtasant, talented people do their best work in an environment built on trust, autonomy, and continuous learning. With team members in 130+ countries, we are a remote-first, proudly diverse organization focused on meaningful work and real impact.

Role Overview

The Build & Release Support Engineer provides high-impact technical support for the customer’s build, release, and CI/CD systems, which every developer depends on to ship software.

This role is deeply developer-facing and centers on build pipelines, software supply chain workflows, and release tooling. You will help engineers resolve blockers across tools like Maven, Java build systems, Docker, Spinnaker, Artifactory, and Jenkins.

Success depends on strong troubleshooting skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple threads and tickets in parallel. You will be the front line, ensuring developers can deliver reliably, safely, and at high velocity.

Business Outcome

Become a deep expert in the customer’s build and release ecosystem and deliver fast, accurate support across Slack and tickets. Your work will maintain high developer velocity and minimize disruption across global engineering teams.


Success Measures

  • Healthy volume of threads and tickets handled with high-quality outcomes

  • Consistent achievement of time-based SLAs

  • High customer satisfaction through surveys

  • Accurate classification of issue type, severity, and patterns

What Will Be True When You Succeed

  • Developers ship faster with fewer build and release blockers

  • CI/CD and software supply chain tooling become more reliable and more usable

  • Escalations decrease due to strong frontline troubleshooting


Core Work Units

1. Frontline Support for Build & Release Systems

  • Manage Slack threads and tickets (roughly 50/50)

  • Triage build failures, broken pipelines, dependency issues, and configuration errors

  • Provide fast, accurate context before escalating

  • Handle multiple interactions in parallel without losing track

2. Deep-Dive Troubleshooting & Incident Support

  • Diagnose complex build, packaging, or artifact problems independently

  • Investigate issues involving Maven builds, Java compilation, Docker images, Artifactory repos, Jenkins jobs, and Spinnaker pipelines

  • Provide structured guidance throughout incidents

3. Escalation Management

  • Complete a thorough analysis before escalating

  • Gather all required details upfront to reduce back-and-forth

  • Produce clean, high-quality escalation tickets that downstream teams can act on immediately

4. Documentation & Knowledge Development

  • Maintain and refine FAQs and internal documentation

  • Create problem–solution one-pagers for recurring issues

  • Document newly solved problems instinctively and thoroughly

High-Quality Work — what top performance looks like

Frontline Support

  • Quickly identifies whether the issue is build-related, config-related, or infra-related

  • Moves smoothly from triage to deeper analysis

  • Juggles multiple developer inquiries without missing follow-ups

Deep-Dive & Incident Support

  • Resolves complex pipeline or build issues without escalation

  • Coordinates multi-user incidents involving large build failures

  • Communicates clearly during investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution

Escalations

  • Only escalates after a thorough investigation

  • Provides complete logs, reproduction steps, build metadata, and context

  • Saves downstream engineers time with clean, accurate handoffs

Documentation

  • Documentation is so clear that users avoid opening tickets

  • Proactively updates and refines materials for clarity and accuracy

  • Quickly turns real-world issues into reusable knowledge

Typical Day / Work Patterns

  • ~50% Slack support, ~50% ticket handling

  • Documentation and PRs during low ticket volume periods

  • Weekly team meeting to review escalated tickets

  • High rate of context switching and parallel issue management

Required Skills & Experience

Non-Negotiable Skills

  • Git proficiency

  • CI/CD tooling expertise (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

  • Build & Release engineering fundamentals

  • Maven and Java build tooling

  • Understanding of software supply chain lifecycle

  • Comfort supporting Artifact repositories (Artifactory, Nexus, etc.)

  • Experience with Spinnaker or similar deployment orchestration

  • Strong troubleshooting ability

  • Clear written and spoken communication

  • SDLC understanding

  • Unix command-line proficiency

  • Linux command-line proficiency

  • Scripting (Python/Bash)

  • Container knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Monitoring tools (Prometheus/Grafana)

  • Prior SRE experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in Build/Release Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or software development

  • Strong troubleshooting skills

  • Clear communication skills

  • Strong linux skills, scripting, Git, and containers

  • Solid Linux/Unix experience

  • Experience with build tools (Maven/Gradle), containers, and artifact management systems

  • Disqualifiers: no CI/CD experience, poor communication

What You’ll Love

  • Constant learning and rapid skill growth

  • Hands-on technical problem solving

  • Directly unblocking developers across a global organization

What May Be Challenging

  • High context switching

  • Repetitive problem patterns

  • Pressure from supporting high-visibility systems

Differentiation: Industry

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture

  • Global team across 130+ countries

  • High autonomy and respect for your time

  • Exposure across multiple clients and modern systems

  • Meaningful, impactful technical challenges

Differentiation: Internal

  • Supports the highest-visibility set of services at the customer

  • More direct developer-facing work than similar Virtasant roles
    • Deep specialization in CI/CD rather than broad platform coverage

jobs.description:
Associate Managing Editor

Job Purpose

The Associate Managing Editor is responsible for the end-to-end management and development of assigned journals, ensuring timely publication, operational excellence, and strong stakeholder engagement. The role works closely with editors, authors, reviewers, societies, and internal teams to support journal growth, publication quality, indexing objectives, and overall portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

Journal & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the end-to-end publication process for assigned journals, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of issues.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for journal-related operational matters and escalations.

  • Coordinate closely with editors, editorial boards, authors, reviewers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient journal operations.

  • Ensure a seamless transition of newly acquired journals from the acquisitions stage to editorial management.

  • Monitor publishing schedules and proactively address delays to maintain publication timelines.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journal editors, authors, reviewers, society partners, and internal teams.

  • Liaise regularly with Sage India, UK, and US colleagues to address editorial, production, and operational requirements.

  • Provide high-quality service and support to editors, societies, and contributors.

Journal Development & Performance

  • Identify opportunities to enhance journal performance, visibility, and impact.

  • Work closely with editors on manuscript flow, turnaround times, editorial planning, and publication strategies.

  • Drive initiatives related to journal indexing, abstracting, Impact Factor acquisition, and overall portfolio growth.

  • Educate and guide editors on indexing criteria, citation performance, and Impact Factor improvement strategies.

  • Identify and implement journal-specific development plans to improve performance and reach.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and execute journal-specific promotional activities, including:

    • Call for Papers campaigns

    • Impact Factor announcements

    • Special Issue promotions

    • Article-level marketing initiatives

    • Conference and event promotional support

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and present journal performance reports and publisher reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

  • Maintain accurate journal records, reports, and portfolio documentation.

  • Prepare personal performance reports aligned with departmental objectives.

Contract & Business Management

  • Support drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing journal contract renewals and addenda.

  • Develop an understanding of publishing business models and contractual frameworks.

  • Support onboarding, maintenance, and renewal of new publishing products and content solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on industry developments, publishing trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Work independently to achieve departmental objectives while escalating issues appropriately when required.

Key Accountabilities

  • Effective management of assigned journal portfolios.

  • Delivery of publication schedules and service-level commitments.

  • Enhanced journal visibility through indexing and abstracting achievements.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction and relationship management.

  • Accurate reporting and performance tracking.

  • Successful implementation of journal development initiatives.

  • Compliance with publishing standards, contracts, and internal policies.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Publishing, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 2-3 years of experience in scholarly journal publishing within an editorial or journal management environment.

  • Experience managing journals throughout the publication lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with journal development activities, indexing applications, and editorial workflows.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Scholarly publishing processes

    • Peer review management

    • Journal management and development

    • Publishing contracts and business models

    • Abstracting and Indexing (A&I) databases

    • Impact Factor and journal performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:

    • Excel

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Experience with peer review management systems is preferred.

Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced publishing environment.

Success Measures

  • Timely publication of assigned journals.

  • Improved journal performance and indexing outcomes.

  • High editor, author, reviewer, and society satisfaction.

  • Achievement of departmental and individual KPIs.

  • Effective management of journal portfolios and stakeholder relationships.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

jobs.description:
Job Ad (2026 05)

We're looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to run our production deployments and act as the operational point of contact for our US-based client team.

The role has two modes. During release cycles, you focus on planning and executing deployments alongside the client. Between releases, you focus on improving the infrastructure and tooling that supports them: CI/CD pipelines, runbooks, observability, automation.

The right person for this role is comfortable in Kubernetes and Helm, knows their way around a Linux shell, and is fine flexing into US working hours when there's a deployment in flight. You're someone who likes things to work, communicates clearly when they don't, and stays calm when production is on the line.

WHAT YOU'RE GOING TO DO

During deployment cycles:

● Plan, schedule, and execute production deployments in coordination with the client's engineering team

● Flex into US working hours (afternoon/evening Romania time) during deployment windows to align with the client on releases, change requests, and incident response

● Act as the day-to-day operational point of contact between our team and the client during release cycles

● Investigate and resolve deployment, networking, and infrastructure issues in production, escalating to the engineering team when needed

● Communicate deployment status, risks, and incidents clearly to both client and internal teams

Between deployment cycles:

● Improve the deployment infrastructure and tooling: CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, runbooks, observability, automation

● Work on broader cloud and Kubernetes operations: cluster maintenance, networking, secret management, cost and reliability improvements

● Help shape deployment processes and change management as the platform grows

Requirements

QUALITIES

● You take pride in clean, predictable deployments and good change discipline

● You enjoy working directly with a client team: writing tickets, joining their stand-ups when needed, being the single point of contact during deployment windows

● You're fine with a schedule that flexes (some weeks heavy US overlap, some weeks normal EU hours) instead of a fixed 9-to-5

● You stay composed during incidents and communicate clearly under pressure

● You ask questions when something looks wrong instead of pushing through

● You document what you do, so the next person (or you, three months from now) doesn't

have to reverse-engineer it

● Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) as part of your daily workflow

QUALIFICATIONS

● 3+ years of experience in operations, DevOps, SRE, or related hands-on infrastructure roles

● Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

● Solid Kubernetes experience: deployments, services, ingress, debugging pods and workloads.

● Helm charts: reading, editing, templating, and deploying them.

● Networking knowledge across cloud and Kubernetes: Load Balancers, Ingress controllers, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, Azure CNI.

● CI/CD experience with ArgoCD and GitLab CI

● Scripting and coding in bash, Python, or Go

● Solid Linux fundamentals: filesystem, CLI, log and process troubleshooting

● Strong written and spoken English (mandatory: you'll be in daily contact with the client)

NICE TO HAVE

● Prior experience working directly with US-based clients or distributed teams

● On-call or production support experience in an enterprise / regulated environment

● Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry)

● Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools

● Experience with secret management tools (Vault, CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)

● Completed technical university degree

WHAT WE OFFER

● A monthly amount dedicated to well-being needs

● A monthly subscription to medical services

● 21 vacation days / year; extra vacation days after 2 years within the company

● 3 personal days / year

● Referral bonus

● Access to learning platforms for continuous self-development
